variants.southern_text: yā bhāti lakṣmīr bhuvi mandarasthā । yathā pradoṣeṣu ca sāgarasthā । tathaiva toyeṣu ca puṣkarasthā । rarāja sā cāruniśākarasthā ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: sthitaḥ kakudmān iva tīkṣṇaśṛṅgo; mahācalaḥ śveta ivoccaśṛṅgaḥ hastīva jāmbūnadabaddhaśṛṅgo; vibhāti candraḥ paripūrṇaśṛṅgaḥ
variants.southern_text: sthitaḥ kakudmān iva tīkṣṇaśṛṅgo । mahācalaḥ śveta ivordhvaśṛṅgaḥ । hastīva jāmbūnadabaddhaśṛṅgo । vibhāti candraḥ paripūrṇaśṛṅgaḥ ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: prakāśacandrodayanaṣṭadoṣaḥ; pravṛddharakṣaḥ piśitāśadoṣaḥ rāmābhirāmeritacittadoṣaḥ; svargaprakāśo bhagavān pradoṣaḥ
variants.southern_text: prakāśacandrodayanaṣṭadoṣaḥ । pravṛddharakṣaḥpiśitāśadoṣaḥ । rāmābhirāmeritacittadoṣaḥ । svargaprakāśo bhagavān pradoṣaḥ ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: tantrī svanāḥ karṇasukhāḥ pravṛttāḥ; svapanti nāryaḥ patibhiḥ suvṛttāḥ naktaṃcarāś cāpi tathā pravṛttā; vihartum atyadbhutaraudravṛttāḥ
variants.southern_text: tantrīsvarāḥ karṇasukhāḥ pravṛttāḥ । svapanti nāryaḥ patibhiḥ suvṛttāḥ । naktaṃcarāś cāpi tathā pravṛttā । vihartum atyadbhutaraudravṛttāḥ ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: rakṣāṃsi vakṣāṃsi ca vikṣipanti; gātrāṇi kāntāsu ca vikṣipanti dadarśa kāntāś ca samālapanti; tathāparās tatra punaḥ svapanti
variants.southern_text: rakṣāṃsi vakṣāṃsi ca vikṣipanti । gātrāṇi kāntāsu ca vikṣipanti । rūpāṇi citrāṇi ca vikṣipanti । dṛḍhāni cāpāni ca vikṣipanti ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: mahāgajaiś cāpi tathā nadadbhiḥ; sūpūjitaiś cāpi tathā susadbhiḥ rarāja vīraiś ca viniḥśvasadbhir; hrado bhujaṅgair iva niḥśvasadbhiḥ
variants.southern_text: mahāgajaiś cāpi tathā nadadbhiḥ । sūpūjitaiś cāpi tathā susadbhiḥ । rarāja vīraiś ca viniḥśvasadbhir । hradā bhujaṅgair iva niḥśvasadbhiḥ ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: tato varārhāḥ suviśuddhabhāvās; teṣāṃ striyas tatra mahānubhāvāḥ priyeṣu pāneṣu ca saktabhāvā; dadarśa tārā iva suprabhāvāḥ
variants.southern_text: tato varārhāḥ suviśuddhabhāvās । teṣāṃ striyas tatra mahānubhāvāḥ । priyeṣu pāneṣu ca saktabhāvā । dadarśa tārā iva susvabhāvāḥ ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: śriyā jvalantīs trapayopagūḍhā; niśīthakāle ramaṇopagūḍhāḥ dadarśa kāś cit pramadopagūḍhā; yathā vihaṃgāḥ kusumopagūḍāḥ
variants.southern_text: striyo jvalantīs trapayopagūḍhā । niśīthakāle ramaṇopagūḍhāḥ । dadarśa kāś cit pramadopagūḍhā । yathā vihaṃgā vihagopagūḍāḥ ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: anyāḥ punar harmyatalopaviṣṭās; tatra priyāṅkeṣu sukhopaviṣṭāḥ bhartuḥ priyā dharmaparā niviṣṭā; dadarśa dhīmān manadābhiviṣṭāḥ
variants.southern_text: anyāḥ punar harmyatalopaviṣṭās । tatra priyāṅkeṣu sukhopaviṣṭāḥ । bhartuḥ parā dharmaparā niviṣṭā । dadarśa dhīmān madanopaviṣṭāḥ ॥19॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ priyān prāpya mano'bhirāmān; suprītiyuktāḥ prasamīkṣya rāmāḥ gṛheṣu hṛṣṭāḥ paramābhirāmā; haripravīraḥ sa dadarśa rāmāḥ
variants.southern_text: tataḥ priyān prāpya mano'bhirāmān । suprītiyuktāḥ sumano’bhirāmāḥ । gṛheṣu hṛṣṭāḥ paramābhirāmā । haripravīraḥ sa dadarśa rāmāḥ ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: candraprakāśāś ca hi vaktramālā; vakrākṣipakṣmāś ca sunetramālāḥ vibhūṣaṇānāṃ ca dadarśa mālāḥ; śatahradānām iva cārumālāḥ
variants.southern_text: candraprakāśāś ca hi vaktramālā । vakrāḥ supakṣmāś ca sunetramālāḥ । vibhūṣaṇānāṃ ca dadarśa mālāḥ । śatahradānām iva cārumālāḥ ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: sanātane vartmani saṃniviṣṭāṃ; rāmekṣaṇīṃ tāṃ madanābhiviṣṭām bhartur manaḥ śrīmad anupraviṣṭāṃ; strībhyo varābhyaś ca sadā viśiṣṭām
variants.southern_text: sanātane vartmani saṃniviṣṭāṃ । rāmekṣaṇīṃ tāṃ madanābhiviṣṭām । bhartur manaḥ śrīmad anupraviṣṭāṃ । strībhyaḥ parābhyaś ca sadā viśiṣṭām ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: avyaktalekhām iva candralekhāṃ; pāṃsupradigdhām iva hemalekhām kṣataprarūḍhām iva bāṇalekhāṃ; vāyuprabhinnām iva meghalekhām
variants.southern_text: avyaktarekhām iva candralekhāṃ । pāṃsupradigdhām iva hemarekhām । kṣataprarūḍhām iva varṇarekhāṃ । vāyuprabhinnām iva megharekhām ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: sītām apaśyan manujeśvarasya; rāmasya patnīṃ vadatāṃ varasya babhūva duḥkhābhihataś cirasya; plavaṃgamo manda ivācirasya
variants.southern_text: sītām apaśyan manujeśvarasya । rāmasya patnīṃ vadatāṃ varasya । babhūva duḥkhāpahataś cirasya । plavaṃgamo manda ivācirasya ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: āsasādātha lakṣmīvān rākṣasendraniveśanam prākāreṇārkavarṇena bhāsvareṇābhisaṃvṛtam
variants.southern_text: āsasāda ca lakṣmīvān rākṣasendraniveśanam । prākāreṇārkavarṇena bhāsvareṇābhisaṃvṛtam ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: siṃhavyāghratanutrāṇair dāntakāñcanarājataiḥ ghoṣavadbhir vicitraiś ca sadā vicaritaṃ rathaiḥ
variants.southern_text: siṃhavyāghratanutrāṇair dāntakāñcanarājatīḥ । ghoṣavadbhir vicitraiś ca sadā vicaritaṃ rathaiḥ ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: bahuratnasamākīrṇaṃ parārdhyāsanabhājanam mahārathasamāvāsaṃ mahārathamahāsanam
variants.southern_text: bahuratnasamākīrṇaṃ parārdhyāsanabhūṣitam । mahārathasamāvāpaṃ mahārathamahāsanam ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: muditapramadā ratnaṃ rākṣasendraniveśanam varābharaṇanirhrādaiḥ samudrasvananiḥsvanam
variants.southern_text: muditapramadāratnaṃ rākṣasendraniveśanam । varābharaṇasaṃhrādaiḥ samudrasvananiḥsvanam ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: tad rājaguṇasaṃpannaṃ mukhyaiś ca varacandanaiḥ bherīmṛdaṅgābhirutaṃ śaṅkhaghoṣavināditam
variants.southern_text: tad rājaguṇasampannaṃ mukhyaiś ca varacandanaiḥ । mahājanasamākīrṇaṃ siṃhair iva mahad vanam ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: gṛhād gṛhaṃ rākṣasānām udyānāni ca vānaraḥ vīkṣamāṇo hy asaṃtrastaḥ prāsādāṃś ca cacāra saḥ
variants.southern_text: gṛhād gṛhaṃ rākṣasānām udyānāni ca sarvaśaḥ । vīkṣamāṇo 'py asaṃtrastaḥ prāsādāṃś ca cacāra saḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: dhūmrākṣasya ca saṃpāter bhavanaṃ mārutātmajaḥ vidyudrūpasya bhīmasya ghanasya vighanasya ca
variants.southern_text: dhūmrākṣasyātha sampāter bhavanaṃ mārutātmajaḥ । vidyudrūpasya bhīmasya ghanasya vighanasya ca ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: śukanābhasya vakrasya śaṭhasya vikaṭasya ca hrasvakarṇasya daṃṣṭrasya romaśasya ca rakṣasaḥ
variants.southern_text: śukanābhasya cakrasya śaṭhasya kapaṭasya ca । hrasvakarṇasya daṃṣṭrasya lomaśasya ca rakṣasaḥ ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: yuddhonmattasya mattasya dhvajagrīvasya nādinaḥ vidyujjihvendrajihvānāṃ tathā hastimukhasya ca
variants.southern_text: yuddhonmattasya mattasya dhvajagrīvasya sādinaḥ । vidyujjihvadvijihvānāṃ tathā hastimukhasya ca ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: dadarśa vividhān gulmāṃs tasya rakṣaḥpater gṛhe
variants.southern_text: śūlamudgarahastāṃś ca śaktitomaradhāriṇaḥ । dadarśa vividhān gulmāṃs tasya rakṣaḥpater gṛhe ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: dadarśa rākṣasendrasya rāvaṇasya niveśane śibikā vividhākārāḥ sa kapir mārutātmajaḥ
variants.southern_text: dadarśa rākṣasendrasya rāvaṇasya niveśane । sa mandarasamaprakhyaṃ mayūrasthānasaṃkulam ॥38॥

variants.critical_text: kāmasya gṛhakaṃ ramyaṃ divāgṛhakam eva ca dadarśa rākṣasendrasya rāvaṇasya niveśane
variants.southern_text: hemajālair avicchinnās taruṇādityasaṃnibhāḥ । dadarśa rākṣasendrasya rāvaṇasya niveśane ॥35॥

variants.critical_text: anantaratnanicayaṃ nidhijālaṃ samantataḥ dhīraniṣṭhitakarmāntaṃ gṛhaṃ bhūtapater iva
variants.southern_text: dhvajayaṣṭibhir ākīrṇaṃ dadarśa bhavanottamam । anantaratnanicayaṃ nidhijālaṃ samantataḥ । dhīraniṣṭhitakarmāṅgaṃ gṛhaṃ bhūtapater iva ॥39॥

variants.critical_text: arcirbhiś cāpi ratnānāṃ tejasā rāvaṇasya ca virarājātha tad veśma raśmimān iva raśmibhiḥ
variants.southern_text: arcirbhiś cāpi ratnānāṃ tejasā rāvaṇasya ca । virarāja ca tad veśma raśmivān iva raśmibhiḥ ॥40॥

variants.critical_text: madhvāsavakṛtakledaṃ maṇibhājanasaṃkulam manoramam asaṃbādhaṃ kuberabhavanaṃ yathā
variants.southern_text: madhvāsavakṛtakledaṃ maṇibhājanasaṃkulam । manoramam asambādhaṃ kuberabhavanaṃ yathā ॥42॥

variants.critical_text: nūpurāṇāṃ ca ghoṣeṇa kāñcīnāṃ ninadena ca mṛdaṅgatalaghoṣaiś ca ghoṣavadbhir vināditam
variants.southern_text: nūpurāṇāṃ ca ghoṣeṇa kāñcīnāṃ niḥsvanena ca । mṛdaṅgatalaghoṣair ghoṣavadbhir vināditam ॥43॥

variants.critical_text: nārīpravekair iva dīpyamānaṃ; taḍidbhir ambhodavad arcyamānam haṃsapravekair iva vāhyamānaṃ; śriyā yutaṃ khe sukṛtāṃ vimānam
variants.southern_text: nārīpravekair iva dīpyamānaṃ । taḍidbhir ambhodharam arcyamānam । haṃsapravekair iva vāhyamānaṃ । śriyā yutaṃ khe sukṛtāṃ vimānam ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: yathā nagāgraṃ bahudhātucitraṃ; yathā nabhaś ca grahacandracitram dadarśa yuktīkṛtameghacitraṃ; vimānaratnaṃ bahuratnacitram
variants.southern_text: yathā nagāgraṃ bahudhātucitraṃ । yathā nabhaś ca grahacandracitram । dadarśa yuktīkṛtacārumeghacitraṃ । vimānam bahuratnacitram ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: kṛtāni veśmāni ca pāṇḍurāṇi; tathā supuṣpā api puṣkariṇyaḥ punaś ca padmāni sakesarāṇi; dhanyāni citrāṇi tathā vanāni
variants.southern_text: kṛtāni veśmāni ca pāṇḍurāṇi । tathā supuṣpāṇy api puṣkarāṇi । punaś ca padmāni sakesarāṇi । vanāni citrāṇi sarovarāṇi ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: puṣpāhvayaṃ nāma virājamānaṃ; ratnaprabhābhiś ca vivardhamānam veśmottamānām api coccamānaṃ; mahākapis tatra mahāvimānam
variants.southern_text: puṣpāhvayaṃ nāma virājamānaṃ । ratnaprabhābhiś ca vighūrṇamānam । veśmottamānām api coccamānaṃ । mahākapis tatra mahāvimānam ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: itīva tad gṛham abhigamya śobhanaṃ; savismayo nagam iva cāruśobhanam punaś ca tat paramasugandhi sundaraṃ; himātyaye nagam iva cārukandaram
variants.southern_text: itīva tad gṛham abhigamya śobhanaṃ । savismayo nagam iva cārukandaram । punaś ca tat paramasugandhi sundaraṃ । himātyaye nagam iva cārukandaram ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: tasyālayavariṣṭhasya madhye vipulam āyatam dadarśa bhavanaśreṣṭhaṃ hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ
variants.southern_text: tasyālayavariṣṭhasya madhye vimalam āyatam । dadarśa bhavanaśreṣṭhaṃ hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: ardhayojanavistīrṇam āyataṃ yojanaṃ hi tat bhavanaṃ rākṣasendrasya bahuprāsādasaṃkulam
variants.southern_text: ardhayojanavistīrṇam āyataṃ yojanaṃ mahat । bhavanaṃ rākṣasendrasya bahuprāsādasaṃkulam ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: yā hi vaiśvaraṇe lakṣmīr yā cendre harivāhane sā rāvaṇagṛhe sarvā nityam evānapāyinī
variants.southern_text: yā hi vaiśvaraṇe lakṣmīr yā candre harivāhane । sā rāvaṇagṛhe ramyā nityam evānapāyinī ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: yā ca rājñaḥ kuberasya yamasya varuṇasya ca tādṛśī tad viśiṣṭā vā ṛddhī rakṣo gṛheṣv iha
variants.southern_text: yā ca rājñaḥ kuberasya yamasya varuṇasya ca । tādṛśī tad viśiṣṭā vā ṛddhī rakṣogṛheṣv iha ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: tasya harmyasya madhyasthaṃ veśma cānyat sunirmitam bahuniryūha saṃkīrṇaṃ dadarśa pavanātmajaḥ
variants.southern_text: tasya harmyasya madhyasthaveśma cānyat sunirmitam । bahuniryūhasaṃyuktaṃ dadarśa pavanātmajaḥ ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: īhā mṛgasamāyuktaiḥ kāryasvarahiraṇmayaiḥ sukṛtair ācitaṃ stambhaiḥ pradīptam iva ca śriyā
variants.southern_text: īhāmṛgasamāyuktaiḥ kārtasvarahiraṇmayaiḥ । sukṛtair ācitaṃ stambhaiḥ pradīptam iva ca śriyā ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: merumandarasaṃkāśair ullikhadbhir ivāmbaram kūṭāgāraiḥ śubhākāraiḥ sarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtam
variants.southern_text: merumandarasaṃkāśair ullikhadbhir ivāmbaram । kūṭāgāraiḥ śubhāgāraiḥ sarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtam ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: jvalanārkapratīkāśaṃ sukṛtaṃ viśvakarmaṇā hemasopānasaṃyuktaṃ cārupravaravedikam
variants.southern_text: jvalanārkapratīkāśaiḥ sukṛtaṃ viśvakarmaṇā । hemasopānayuktaṃ ca cārupravaravedikam ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: jālavātāyanair yuktaṃ kāñcanaiḥ sthāṭikair api indranīlamahānīlamaṇipravaravedikam
variants.southern_text: jālavātāyanair yuktaṃ kāñcanaiḥ sphāṭikair api । indranīlamahānīlamaṇipravaravedikam ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: svargo 'yaṃ devaloko 'yam indrasyeyaṃ purī bhavet siddhir veyaṃ parā hi syād ity amanyata mārutiḥ
variants.southern_text: tarpayām āsa māteva tadā rāvaṇapālitā । svargo 'yaṃ devaloko 'yam indrasyāpi purī bhavet । siddhir veyaṃ parā hi syād ity amanyata mārutiḥ ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: parivṛtte 'rdharātre tu pānanidrāvaśaṃ gatam krīḍitvoparataṃ rātrau suṣvāpa balavat tadā
variants.southern_text: parivṛtte 'rdharātre tu pānanidrāvaśaṃgatam । krīḍitvoparataṃ rātrau prasuptaṃ balavat tadā ॥34॥

variants.critical_text: tāsāṃ saṃvṛtadantāni mīlitākṣāṇi mārutiḥ apaśyat padmagandhīni vadanāni suyoṣitām
variants.southern_text: tāsāṃ saṃvṛtadantāni mīlitākṣīṇi mārutiḥ । apaśyat padmagandhīni vadanāni suyoṣitām ॥36॥

variants.critical_text: prabuddhānīva padmāni tāsāṃ bhūtvā kṣapākṣaye punaḥsaṃvṛtapatrāṇi rātrāv iva babhus tadā
variants.southern_text: prabuddhānīva padmāni tāsāṃ bhūtvā kṣapākṣaye । punaḥ saṃvṛtapatrāṇi rātrāv iva babhus tadā ॥37॥

variants.critical_text: sa ca tābhiḥ parivṛtaḥ śuśubhe rākṣasādhipaḥ yathā hy uḍupatiḥ śrīmāṃs tārābhir abhisaṃvṛtaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa ca tābhiḥ parivṛtaḥ śuśubhe rākṣasādhipaḥ । yathā hy uḍupatiḥ śrīmāṃs tārābhir iva saṃvṛtaḥ ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: vyāvṛttagurupīnasrakprakīrṇavarabhūṣaṇāḥ pānavyāyāmakāleṣu nidrāpahṛtacetasaḥ
variants.southern_text: vyāvṛttakacapīnasrakprakīrṇavarabhūṣaṇāḥ । pānavyāyāmakāleṣu nidropahṛtacetasaḥ ॥44॥

variants.critical_text: mukhā hāravṛtāś cānyāḥ kāś cit prasrastavāsasaḥ vyāviddharaśanā dāmāḥ kiśorya iva vāhitāḥ
variants.southern_text: muktāhāravṛtāś cānyāḥ kāś cit prasrastavāsasaḥ । vyāviddharaśanādāmāḥ kiśorya iva vāhitāḥ ॥46॥

variants.critical_text: sukuṇḍaladharāś cānyā vicchinnamṛditasrajaḥ gajendramṛditāḥ phullā latā iva mahāvane
variants.southern_text: akuṇḍaladharāś cānyā vicchinnamṛditasrajaḥ । gajendramṛditāḥ phullā latā iva mahāvane ॥47॥

variants.critical_text: candrāṃśukiraṇābhāś ca hārāḥ kāsāṃ cid utkaṭāḥ haṃsā iva babhuḥ suptāḥ stanamadhyeṣu yoṣitām
variants.southern_text: candrāṃśukiraṇābhāś ca hārāḥ kāsāṃ cid udgaṭāḥ । haṃsā iva babhuḥ suptāḥ stanamadhyeṣu yoṣitām ॥48॥

variants.critical_text: vavalguś cātra kāsāṃ cit kuṇḍalāni śubhārciṣām mukhamārutasaṃsargān mandaṃ mandaṃ suyoṣitām
variants.southern_text: vavalguś cātra kāsāṃ cit kuṇḍalāni śubhārciṣām । mukhamārutasaṃkampair mandaṃ mandaṃ ca yoṣitām ॥55॥

variants.critical_text: rāvaṇānanaśaṅkāś ca kāś cid rāvaṇayoṣitaḥ mukhāni sma sapatnīnām upājighran punaḥ punaḥ
variants.southern_text: rāvaṇānanaśaṅkāś ca kāś cid rāvaṇayoṣitaḥ । mukhāni ca sapatnīnām upājighran punaḥ punaḥ ॥57॥

variants.critical_text: bāhūn upanidhāyānyāḥ pārihārya vibhūṣitāḥ aṃśukāni ca ramyāṇi pramadās tatra śiśyire
variants.southern_text: bāhūn upanidhāyānyāḥ pārihāryavibhūṣitān । aṃśukāni ca ramyāṇi pramadās tatra śiśyire ॥59॥

variants.critical_text: anyā vakṣasi cānyasyās tasyāḥ kā cit punar bhujam aparā tv aṅkam anyasyās tasyāś cāpy aparā bhujau
variants.southern_text: anyā vakṣasi cānyasyās tasyāḥ kā cit punar bhujam । aparā tv aṅkam anyasyās tasyāś cāpy aparā kucau ॥60॥

variants.critical_text: anyonyasyāṅgasaṃsparśāt prīyamāṇāḥ sumadhyamāḥ ekīkṛtabhujāḥ sarvāḥ suṣupus tatra yoṣitaḥ
variants.southern_text: anyonyasyāṅgasamsparśāt prīyamāṇāḥ sumadhyamāḥ । ekīkṛtabhujāḥ sarvāḥ suṣupus tatra yoṣitaḥ ॥62॥

variants.critical_text: anyonyabhujasūtreṇa strīmālāgrathitā hi sā māleva grathitā sūtre śuśubhe mattaṣaṭpadā
variants.southern_text: anyonyabhujasūtreṇa strīmālā grathitā hi sā । māleva grathitā sūtre śuśubhe mattaṣaṭpadā ॥63॥

variants.critical_text: vyativeṣṭitasuskantham anyonyabhramarākulam āsīd vanam ivoddhūtaṃ strīvanaṃ rāvaṇasya tat
variants.southern_text: prativeṣṭitasuskandham anyonyabhramarākulam । āsīd vanam ivoddhūtaṃ strīvanaṃ rāvaṇasya tat ॥65॥

variants.critical_text: rāvaṇe sukhasaṃviṣṭe tāḥ striyo vividhaprabhāḥ jvalantaḥ kāñcanā dīpāḥ prekṣantānimiṣā iva
variants.southern_text: rāvaṇe sukhasaṃviṣṭe tāḥ striyo vividhaprabhāḥ । jvalantaḥ kāñcanā dīpāḥ prekṣanto nimiṣā iva ॥67॥

variants.critical_text: rājarṣipitṛdaityānāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ ca yoṣitaḥ rakṣasāṃ cābhavan kanyās tasya kāmavaśaṃ gatāḥ
variants.southern_text: rājarṣivipradaityānāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ ca yoṣitaḥ । rakṣasāṃ cābhavan kanyās tasya kāmavaśaṃ gatāḥ ॥68॥

variants.critical_text: na cākulīnā na ca hīnarūpā; nādakṣiṇā nānupacāra yuktā bhāryābhavat tasya na hīnasattvā; na cāpi kāntasya na kāmanīyā
variants.southern_text: na cākulīnā na ca hīnarūpā । nādakṣiṇā nānupacārayuktā । bhāryābhavat tasya na hīnasattvā । na cāpi kāntasya na kāmanīyā ॥71॥

variants.critical_text: babhūva buddhis tu harīśvarasya; yadīdṛśī rāghavadharmapatnī imā yathā rākṣasarājabhāryāḥ; sujātam asyeti hi sādhubuddheḥ
variants.southern_text: babhūva buddhis tu harīśvarasya । yadīdṛśī rāghavadharmapatnī । imā mahārākṣasarājabhāryāḥ । sujātam asyeti hi sādhubuddheḥ ॥72॥

variants.critical_text: punaś ca so 'cintayad ārtarūpo; dhruvaṃ viśiṣṭā guṇato hi sītā athāyam asyāṃ kṛtavān mahātmā; laṅkeśvaraḥ kaṣṭam anāryakarma
variants.southern_text: punaś ca so 'cintayad āttarūpo । dhruvaṃ viśiṣṭā guṇato hi sītā । athāyam asyāṃ kṛtavān mahātmā । laṅkeśvaraḥ kaṣṭam anāryakarma ॥73॥

variants.critical_text: tasya caikatame deśe so 'gryamālyavibhūṣitam dadarśa pāṇḍuraṃ chatraṃ tārādhipatisaṃnibham
variants.southern_text: tasya caikatame deśe divyam ālopaśobhitam । dadarśa pāṇḍuraṃ chatraṃ tārādhipatisaṃnibham ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: bālavyajanahastābhir vījyamānaṃ samantataḥ gandhaiś ca vividhair juṣṭaṃ varadhūpena dhūpitam
variants.southern_text: vālavyajanahastābhir vījyamānaṃ samantataḥ । gandhaiś ca vividhair juṣṭaṃ varadhūpena dhūpitam ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: tasmiñ jīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ pradīptottamakuṇḍalam lohitākṣaṃ mahābāhuṃ mahārajatavāsasaṃ
variants.southern_text: tasmiñ jīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ pradīptojjvalakuṇḍalam । lohitākṣaṃ mahābāhuṃ mahārajatavāsasam ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: athārohaṇam āsādya vedikāntaram āśritaḥ suptaṃ rākṣasaśārdūlaṃ prekṣate sma mahākapiḥ
variants.southern_text: athārohaṇam āsādya vedikāntaram āśritaḥ । kṣībaṃ rākṣasaśārdūlaṃ prekṣate sma mahākapiḥ ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: śuśubhe rākṣasendrasya svapataḥ śayanottamam gandhahastini saṃviṣṭe yathāprasravaṇaṃ mahat
variants.southern_text: śuśubhe rākṣasendrasya svapataḥ śayanaṃ śubham । gandhahastini saṃviṣṭe yathāprasravaṇaṃ mahat ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: kāñcanāṅgadanaddhau ca dadarśa sa mahātmanaḥ vikṣiptau rākṣasendrasya bhujāv indradhvajopamau
variants.southern_text: kāñcanāṅgadanaddhau dadarśa sa mahātmanaḥ । vikṣiptau rākṣasendrasya bhujāv indradhvajopamau ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: pīnau samasujātāṃsau saṃgatau balasaṃyutau sulakṣaṇa nakhāṅguṣṭhau svaṅgulītalalakṣitau
variants.southern_text: pīnau samasujātāṃsau saṃgatau balasaṃyutau । sulakṣaṇanakhāṅguṣṭhau svaṅgulītalalakṣitau ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: dadarśa sa kapis tasya bāhū śayanasaṃsthitau mandarasyāntare suptau mahārhī ruṣitāv iva
variants.southern_text: dadarśa sa kapis tasya bāhū śayanasaṃsthitau । mandarasyāntare suptau mahāhī ruṣitāv iva ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: tābhyāṃ sa paripūrṇābhyāṃ bhujābhyāṃ rākṣasādhipaḥ śuśubhe 'calasaṃkāśaḥ śṛṅgābhyām iva mandaraḥ
variants.southern_text: tābhyāṃ sa paripūrṇābhyāṃ ubhābhyāṃ rākṣaseśvaraḥ । śuśubhe 'calasaṃkāśaḥ śṛṅgābhyām iva mandaraḥ ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: tasya rākṣasasiṃhasya niścakrāma mukhān mahān śayānasya viniḥśvāsaḥ pūrayann iva tad gṛham
variants.southern_text: tasya rākṣasarājasya niścakrāma mahāmukhāt । śayānasya viniḥśvāsaḥ pūrayann iva tad gṛham ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: raktacandanadigdhena tathā hāreṇa śobhitā pīnāyataviśālena vakṣasābhivirājitam
variants.southern_text: raktacandanadigdhena tathā hāreṇa śobhinā । pīnāyataviśālena vakṣasābhivirājitā ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: pāṇḍureṇāpaviddhena kṣaumeṇa kṣatajekṣaṇam mahārheṇa susaṃvītaṃ pītenottamavāsasā
variants.southern_text: pāṇḍureṇāpaviddhena kṣaumeṇa kṣatajekṣaṇam । mahārheṇa susaṃvītaṃ pītenottaravāsasā ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: caturbhiḥ kāñcanair dīpair dīpyamānaiś caturdiśam prakāśīkṛtasarvāṅgaṃ meghaṃ vidyudgaṇair iva
variants.southern_text: caturbhiḥ kāñcanair dīpair dīpyamānam caturdiśam । prakāśīkṛtasarvāṅgaṃ meghaṃ vidyudgaṇair iva ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: śaśiprakāśavadanā varakuṇḍalabhūṣitāḥ amlānamālyābharaṇā dadarśa hariyūthapaḥ
variants.southern_text: śaśiprakāśavadanā varakuṇḍalabhūṣaṇāḥ । amlānamālyābharaṇā dadarśa hariyūthapaḥ ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: nṛttavāditrakuśalā rākṣasendrabhujāṅkagāḥ varābharaṇadhāriṇyo niṣannā dadṛśe kapiḥ
variants.southern_text: nṛttavāditrakuśalā rākṣasendrabhujāṅkagāḥ । varābharaṇadhāriṇyo niṣaṇṇā dadṛśe kapiḥ ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: tāsāṃ candropamair vaktraiḥ śubhair lalitakuṇḍalaiḥ virarāja vimānaṃ tan nabhas tārāgaṇair iva
variants.southern_text: tāsāṃ candropamair vaktraiḥ śubhalalitakuṇḍalaiḥ । virarāja vimānaṃ tan nabhas tārāgaṇair iva ॥34॥

variants.critical_text: paṭahaṃ cārusarvāṅgī pīḍya śete śubhastanī cirasya ramaṇaṃ labdhvā pariṣvajyeva kāminī
variants.southern_text: paṭahaṃ cārusarvāṅgī nyasya śete śubhastanī । cirasya ramaṇaṃ labdhvā pariṣvajyeva kāminī ॥39॥

variants.critical_text: kā cid aṃśaṃ pariṣvajya suptā kamalalocanā nidrāvaśam anuprāptā sahakānteva bhāminī
variants.southern_text: kā cid vīṇāṃ pariṣvajya suptā kamalalocanā । varaṃ priyatamaṃ gṛhya sakāmeva hi kāminī ॥40॥

variants.critical_text: anyā kanakasaṃkāśair mṛdupīnair manoramaiḥ mṛdaṅgaṃ paripīḍyāṅgaiḥ prasuptā mattalocanā
variants.southern_text: anyā kanakasaṃkāśair mṛdupīnair manoramaiḥ । mṛdaṅgaṃ parividdhyāṅgaiḥ prasuptā mattalocanā ॥42॥

variants.critical_text: bhujapārśvāntarasthena kakṣageṇa kṛśodarī paṇavena sahānindyā suptā madakṛtaśramā
variants.southern_text: bhujapāśāntarasthena kakṣageṇa kṛśodarī । paṇavena sahānindyā suptā madakṛtaśramā ॥43॥

variants.critical_text: tāsām ekāntavinyaste śayānāṃ śayane śubhe dadarśa rūpasaṃpannām aparāṃ sa kapiḥ striyam
variants.southern_text: tāsām ekāntavinyaste śayānāṃ śayane śubhe । dadarśa rūpasampannām atha tāṃ sa kapiḥ striyam ॥50॥

variants.critical_text: gaurīṃ kanakavarṇābhām iṣṭām antaḥpureśvarīm kapir mandodarīṃ tatra śayānāṃ cārurūpiṇīm
variants.southern_text: gaurīṃ kanakavarṇābhām iṣṭām antaḥpureśvarīm । kapir mandodarīṃ tatra śayānāṃ cārurūpiṇīm । sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mahābāhur bhūṣitāṃ mārutātmajaḥ ॥52॥

variants.critical_text: āshpoṭayām āsa cucumba pucchaṃ; nananda cikrīḍa jagau jagāma stambhān arohan nipapāta bhūmau; nidarśayan svāṃ prakṛtiṃ kapīnām
variants.southern_text: āsphoṭayām āsa cucumba pucchaṃ । nananda cikrīḍa jagau jagāma । stambhān arohan nipapāta bhūmau । nidarśayan svāṃ prakṛtiṃ kapīnām ॥54॥

variants.critical_text: krīḍitenāparāḥ klāntā gītena ca tathā parāḥ nṛttena cāparāḥ klāntāḥ pānaviprahatās tathā
variants.southern_text: krīḍitenāparāḥ klāntā gītena ca tathā parāḥ । nṛtyena cāparāḥ klāntāḥ pānaviprahatās tathā ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: murajeṣu mṛdaṅgeṣu pīṭhikāsu ca saṃsthitāḥ tathāstaraṇamukhyyeṣu saṃviṣṭāś cāparāḥ striyaḥ
variants.southern_text: murajeṣu mṛdaṅgeṣu celikāsu ca saṃsthitāḥ । tathāstaraṇamukhyeṣu saṃviṣṭāś cāparāḥ striyaḥ ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: deśakālābhiyuktena yuktavākyābhidhāyinā ratābhiratasaṃsuptaṃ dadarśa hariyūthapaḥ
variants.southern_text: deśakālābhiyuktam tu yuktavākyābhidhāyi tat । ratāviratasaṃsuptaṃ dadarśa hariyūthapaḥ ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: sa rākṣasendraḥ śuśubhe tābhiḥ parivṛtaḥ svayam kareṇubhir yathāraṇyaṃ parikīrṇo mahādvipaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa rākṣasendraḥ śuśubhe tābhiḥ parivṛtaḥ svayam । kareṇubhir yathāraṇye parikīrṇo mahādvipaḥ ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: raukmeṣu ca viśaleṣu bhājaneṣv ardhabhakṣitān dadarśa kapiśārdūla mayūrān kukkuṭāṃs tathā
variants.southern_text: raukmeṣu ca viśaleṣu bhājaneṣv ardhabhakṣitān । dadarśa kapiśārdūlo mayūrān kukkuṭāṃs tathā ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: varāhavārdhrāṇasakān dadhisauvarcalāyutān śalyān mṛgamayūrāṃś ca hanūmān anvavaikṣata
variants.southern_text: varāhavādhrīṇasakān dadhisauvarcalāyutān । śalyān mṛgamayūrāṃś ca hanūmān anvavaikṣata ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: kṛkarān vividhān siddhāṃś cakorān ardhabhakṣitān mahiṣān ekaśalyāṃś ca chāgāṃś ca kṛtaniṣṭhitān
variants.southern_text: kṛkalān vividhāṃś chāgāñchaśakān ardhabhakṣitān । mahiṣān ekaśalyāṃś ca meṣāṃś ca kṛtaniṣṭhitān ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: saṃtatā śuśubhe bhūmir mālyaiś ca bahusaṃsthitaiḥ hiraṇmayaiś ca karakair bhājanaiḥ sphāṭikair api
variants.southern_text: saṃtatā śuśubhe bhūmir mālyaiś ca bahusaṃsthitaiḥ । hiraṇmayaiś ca kalaśair bhājanaiḥ sphāṭikair api ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: śayanāny atra nārīṇāṃ śūnyāni bahudhā punaḥ parasparaṃ samāśliṣya kāś cit suptā varāṅganāḥ
variants.southern_text: kva cid ardhāvaśeṣāṇi paśyan vai vicacāra ha । śayanāny atra nārīṇāṃ śūnyāni bahudhā punaḥ । parasparaṃ samāśliṣya kāś cit suptā varāṅganāḥ ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: candanasya ca śītasya śīdhor madhurasasya ca vividhasya ca mālyasya puṣpasya vividhasya ca
variants.southern_text: candanasya ca śītasya sīdhor madhurasasya ca । vividhasya ca mālyasya puṣpasya vividhasya ca ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: bahudhā mārutas tatra gandhaṃ vividham udvahan snānānāṃ candanānāṃ ca dhūpānāṃ caiva mūrchitaḥ
variants.southern_text: bahudhā mārutas tasya gandhaṃ vividham udvahan । snānānāṃ candanānāṃ ca dhūpānāṃ caiva mūrchitaḥ ॥33॥

variants.critical_text: evaṃ sarvam aśeṣeṇa rāvaṇāntaḥpuraṃ kapiḥ dadarśa sumahātejā na dadarśa ca jānakīm
variants.southern_text: padminīnāṃ prasuptānāṃ rūpam āsīd yathaiva hi । evaṃ sarvam aśeṣeṇa rāvaṇāntaḥpuraṃ kapiḥ । dadarśa sa mahātejā na dadarśa ca jānakīm ॥36॥

variants.critical_text: nirīkṣamāṇaś ca tatas tāḥ striyaḥ sa mahākapiḥ jagāma mahatīṃ cintāṃ dharmasādhvasaśaṅkitaḥ
variants.southern_text: nirīkṣamāṇaś ca tatas tāḥ striyaḥ sa mahākapiḥ । jagāma mahatīṃ śaṅkāṃ dharmasādhvasaśaṅkitaḥ ॥37॥

variants.critical_text: tasya prādurabhūc cintāpunar anyā manasvinaḥ niścitaikāntacittasya kāryaniścayadarśinī
variants.southern_text: tasya prādurabhūc cintā punar anyā manasvinaḥ । niścitaikāntacittasya kāryaniścayadarśinī ॥40॥

variants.critical_text: kāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā mayā sarvā viśvastā rāvaṇastriyaḥ na tu me manasaḥ kiṃ cid vaikṛtyam upapadyate
variants.southern_text: kāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā mayā sarvā viśvastā rāvaṇastriyaḥ । na tu me manasā kiṃ cid vaikṛtyam upapadyate ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: nānyatra hi mayā śakyā vaidehī parimārgitum striyo hi strīṣu dṛśyante sadā saṃparimārgaṇe
variants.southern_text: nānyatra hi mayā śakyā vaidehī parimārgitum । striyo hi strīṣu dṛśyante sadā samparimārgaṇe ॥43॥

variants.critical_text: tad idaṃ mārgitaṃ tāvac chuddhena manasā mayā rāvaṇāntaḥpuraṃ saraṃ dṛśyate na ca jānakī
variants.southern_text: tad idaṃ mārgitaṃ tāvac chuddhena manasā mayā । rāvaṇāntaḥpuraṃ sarvaṃ dṛśyate na ca jānakī ॥45॥

variants.critical_text: tām apaśyan kapis tatra paśyaṃś cānyā varastriyaḥ apakramya tadā vīraḥ pradhyātum upacakrame
variants.southern_text: tām apaśyan kapis tatra paśyaṃś cānyā varastriyaḥ । apakramya tadā vīraḥ prasthātum upacakrame ॥47॥

variants.critical_text: sa tasya madhye bhavanasya vānaro; latāgṛhāṃś citragṛhān niśāgṛhān jagāma sītāṃ prati darśanotsuko; na caiva tāṃ paśyati cārudarśanām
variants.southern_text: sa tasya madhye bhavanasya saṃsthito । latāgṛhāṃś citragṛhān niśāgṛhān । jagāma sītāṃ pratidarśanotsuko । na caiva tāṃ paśyati cārudarśanāṃ ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: sa cintayām āsa tato mahākapiḥ; priyām apaśyan raghunandanasya tām dhruvaṃ nu sītā mriyate yathā na me; vicinvato darśanam eti maithilī
variants.southern_text: sa cintayām āsa tato mahākapiḥ । priyām apaśyan raghunandanasya tām । dhruvaṃ na sītā dhriyate yathā na me । vicinvato darśanam eti maithilī ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: sā rākṣasānāṃ pravareṇa bālā; svaśīlasaṃrakṣaṇa tat parā satī anena nūnaṃ pratiduṣṭakarmaṇā; hatā bhaved āryapathe pare sthitā
variants.southern_text: sā rākṣasānāṃ pravareṇa jānakī । svaśīlasaṃrakṣaṇatatparā satī । anena nūnaṃ prati duṣṭakarmaṇā । hatā bhaved āryapathe pare sthitā ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: virūparūpā vikṛtā vivarcaso; mahānanā dīrghavirūpadarśanāḥ samīkṣya sā rākṣasarājayoṣito; bhayād vinaṣṭā janakeśvarātmajā
variants.southern_text: virūparūpā vikṛtā vivarcaso । mahānanā dīrghavirūpadarśanāḥ । samīkṣya tā rākṣasarājayoṣito । bhayād vinaṣṭā janakeśvarātmajā ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: dṛṣṭam antaḥpuraṃ sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇayoṣitaḥ na sītā dṛśyate sādhvī vṛthā jāto mama śramaḥ
variants.southern_text: dṛṣṭam antaḥpuraṃ sarvaṃ dṛṣṭā rāvaṇayoṣitaḥ । na sītā dṛśyate sādhvī vṛthā jāto mama śramaḥ ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: adṛṣṭvā kiṃ pravakṣyāmi tām ahaṃ janakātmajām dhruvaṃ prāyam upeṣyanti kālasya vyativartane
variants.southern_text: adṛṣṭvā kiṃ pravakṣyāmi tām ahaṃ janakātmajām । dhruvaṃ prāyam upāsiṣye kālasya vyativartane ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: anirvedaḥ śriyo mūlam anirvedaḥ paraṃ sukham bhūyas tāvad viceṣyāmi na yatra vicayaḥ kṛtaḥ
variants.southern_text: anirvedaḥ śriyo mūlam anirvedaḥ paraṃ sukham । bhūyas tatra viceṣyāmi na yatra vicayaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: tasmād anirveda kṛtaṃ yatnaṃ ceṣṭe 'ham uttamam adṛṣṭāṃś ca viceṣyāmi deśān rāvaṇapālitān
variants.southern_text: tasmād anirvedakaraṃ yatnaṃ ceṣṭe 'ham uttamam । adṛṣṭāṃś ca viceṣyāmi deśān rāvaṇapālitān ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: āpānaśālāvicitās tathā puṣpagṛhāṇi ca citraśālāś ca vicitā bhūyaḥ krīḍāgṛhāṇi ca
variants.southern_text: āpānaśālā vicitās tathā puṣpagṛhāṇi ca । citraśālāś ca vicitā bhūyaḥ krīḍāgṛhāṇi ca ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: apāvṛṇvaṃś ca dvārāṇi kapāṭāny avaghaṭṭayan praviśan niṣpataṃś cāpi prapatann utpatann api
variants.southern_text: apāvṛṇvaṃś ca dvārāṇi kapāṭāny avaghaṭṭayan । praviśan niṣpataṃś cāpi prapatann utpatann iva ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: caturaṅgulamātro 'pi nāvakāśaḥ sa vidyate rāvaṇāntaḥpure tasmin yaṃ kapir na jagāma saḥ
variants.southern_text: sarvam apy avakāśaṃ sa vicacāra mahākapiḥ । caturaṅgulamātro 'pi nāvakāśaḥ sa vidyate । rāvaṇāntaḥpure tasmin yaṃ kapir na jagāma saḥ ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: prākarāntararathyāś ca vedikaś caityasaṃśrayāḥ śvabhrāś ca puṣkariṇyaś ca sarvaṃ tenāvalokitam
variants.southern_text: prākarāntaravīthyāś ca vedikāś caityasaṃśrayāḥ । śvabhrāś ca puṣkariṇyaś ca sarvaṃ tenāvalokitam ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: rūpeṇāpratimā loke varā vidyādhara striyaḥ dṛṭā hanūmatā tatra na tu rāghavanandinī
variants.southern_text: rūpeṇāpratimā loke varā vidyādharastriyaḥ । dṛṣṭā hanūmatā tatra na tu rāghavanandinī ॥20॥

variants.critical_text: nāgakanyā varārohāḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanāḥ dṛṣṭā hanūmatā tatra na tu sītā sumadhyamā
variants.southern_text: nāgakanyā varārohāḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanāḥ । dṛṣṭā hanūmatā tatra na tu sā janakātmajā ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: udyogaṃ vānarendrāṇaṃ plavanaṃ sāgarasya ca vyarthaṃ vīkṣyānilasutaś cintāṃ punar upāgamat
variants.southern_text: udyogaṃ vānarendrāṇāṃ plavanaṃ sāgarasya ca । vyarthaṃ vīkṣyānilasutaś cintāṃ punar upāgamat ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: vimānāt tu susaṃkramya prākāraṃ hariyūthapaḥ hanūmān vegavān āsīd yathā vidyudghanāntare
variants.southern_text: vimānāt tu sa saṃkramya prākāraṃ hariyūthapaḥ । hanūmān vegavān āsīd yathā vidyud ghanāntare ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: saṃparikramya hanumān rāvaṇasya niveśanān adṛṣṭvā jānakīṃ sītām abravīd vacanaṃ kapiḥ
variants.southern_text: samparikramya hanumān rāvaṇasya niveśanān । adṛṣṭvā jānakīṃ sītām abravīd vacanaṃ kapiḥ ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: bhūyiṣṭhaṃ loḍitā laṅkā rāmasya caratā priyam na hi paśyāmi vaidehīṃ sītāṃ sarvāṅgaśobhanām
variants.southern_text: bhūyiṣṭhaṃ lolitā laṅkā rāmasya caratā priyam । na hi paśyāmi vaidehīṃ sītāṃ sarvāṅgaśobhanām ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: iha saṃpātinā sītā rāvaṇasya niveśane ākhyātā gṛdhrarājena na ca paśyāmi tām aham
variants.southern_text: lolitā vasudhā sarvā na ca paśyāmi jānakīm । iha sampātinā sītā rāvaṇasya niveśane । ākhyātā gṛdhrarājena na ca sā dṛśyate na kim ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: kiṃ nu sītātha vaidehī maithilī janakātmajā upatiṣṭheta vivaśā rāvaṇaṃ duṣṭacāriṇam
variants.southern_text: kiṃ nu sītātha vaidehī maithilī janakātmajā । upatiṣṭheta vivaśā rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: atha vā hriyamāṇāyāḥ pathi siddhaniṣevite manye patitam āryāyā hṛdayaṃ prekṣya sāgaram
variants.southern_text: athavā hriyamāṇāyāḥ pathi siddhaniṣevite । manye patitam āryāyā hṛdayaṃ prekṣya sāgaram ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: upary upari vā nūnaṃ sāgaraṃ kramatas tadā viveṣṭamānā patitā samudre janakātmajā
variants.southern_text: upary upari vā nūnaṃ sāgaraṃ kramatas tadā । viceṣṭamānā patitā samudre janakātmajā ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: saṃpūrṇacandrapratimaṃ padmapatranibhekṣaṇam rāmasya dhyāyatī vaktraṃ pañcatvaṃ kṛpaṇā gatā
variants.southern_text: sampūrṇacandrapratimaṃ padmapatranibhekṣaṇam । rāmasya dhyāyatī vaktraṃ pañcatvaṃ kṛpaṇā gatā ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: hā rāma lakṣmaṇety eva hāyodhyeti ca maithilī vilapya bahu vaidehī nyastadehā bhaviṣyati
variants.southern_text: hā rāma lakṣmaṇety evaṃ hāyodhye ceti maithilī । vilapya bahu vaidehī nyastadehā bhaviṣyati ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: atha vā nihitā manye rāvaṇasya niveśane nūnaṃ lālapyate mandaṃ pañjarastheva śārikā
variants.southern_text: atha vā nihitā manye rāvaṇasya niveśane । bhṛśam lālapyate bālā pañjarastheva sārikā ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: mamedaṃ laṅghanaṃ vyarthaṃ sāgarasya bhaviṣyati praveśaś civa laṅkāyā rākṣasānāṃ ca darśanam
variants.southern_text: mamedaṃ laṅghanaṃ vyarthaṃ sāgarasya bhaviṣyati । praveśaś caiva laṅkāyāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca darśanam ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: kiṃ vā vakṣyati sugrīvo harayo va samāgatāḥ kiṣkindhāṃ samanuprāptau tau vā daśarathātmajau
variants.southern_text: kiṃ vā vakṣyati sugrīvo harayo vāpi saṃgatāḥ । kiṣkindhāṃ anusamprāptaṃ tau vā daśarathātmajau ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: gatvā tu yadi kākutsthaṃ vakṣyāmi param apriyam na dṛṣṭeti mayā sītā tatas tyakṣyanti jīvitam
variants.southern_text: gatvā tu yadi kākutsthaṃ vakṣyāmi paruṣam vacaḥ । na dṛṣṭeti mayā sītā tatas tyakṣyati jīvitam ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: paruṣaṃ dāruṇaṃ krūraṃ tīkṣṇam indriyatāpanam sītānimittaṃ durvākyaṃ śrutvā sa na bhaviṣyati
variants.southern_text: paruṣaṃ dāruṇaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ krūram indriyatāpanam । sītānimittaṃ durvākyaṃ śrutvā sa na bhaviṣyati ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: taṃ tu kṛcchragataṃ dṛṣṭvā pañcatvagatamānasaṃ bhṛśānurakto medhāvī na bhaviṣyati lakṣmaṇaḥ
variants.southern_text: taṃ tu kṛcchragataṃ dṛṣṭvā pañcatvagatamānasaṃ । bhṛśānuraktamedhāvī na bhaviṣyati lakṣmaṇaḥ ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: kṛtajñaḥ satyasaṃdhaś ca sugrīvaḥ plavagādhipaḥ rāmaṃ tathā gataṃ dṛṣṭvā tatas tyakṣyanti jīvitam
variants.southern_text: kṛtajñaḥ satyasaṃdhaś ca sugrīvaḥ plavagādhipaḥ । rāmaṃ tathā gataṃ dṛṣṭvā tatas tyakṣyati jīvitam ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: vālijena tu duḥkhena pīḍitā śokakarśitā pañcatvagamane rājñas tārāpi na bhaviṣyati
variants.southern_text: vālijena tu duḥkhena pīḍitā śokakarśitā । pañcatvam agatā rājñī tārāpi na bhaviṣyati ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: mātāpitror vināśena sugrīva vyasanena ca kumāro 'py aṅgadaḥ kasmād dhārayiṣyati jīvitam
variants.southern_text: mātāpitror vināśena sugrīvavyasanena ca । kumāro 'py aṅgadas tasmād vijāhiṣyati jīvitam ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: sāntvenānupradānena mānena ca yaśasvinā lālitāḥ kapirājena prāṇāṃs tyakṣyanti vānarāḥ
variants.southern_text: sāntvenānupradānena mānena ca yaśasvinā । lālitāḥ kapināthena prāṇāṃs tyakṣyanti vānarāḥ ॥33॥

variants.critical_text: saputradārāḥ sāmātyā bhartṛvyasanapīḍitāḥ śailāgrebhyaḥ patiṣyanti sametya viṣameṣu ca
variants.southern_text: saputradārāḥ sāmātyā bhartṛvyasanapīḍitāḥ । śailāgrebhyaḥ patiṣyanti sameṣu viṣameṣu ca ॥35॥

variants.critical_text: mayy agacchati cehasthe dharmātmānau mahārathau āśayā tau dhariṣyete vanarāś ca manasvinaḥ
variants.southern_text: mayy agacchati cehasthe dharmātmānau mahārathau । āśayā tau dhariṣyete vanarāś ca tarasvinaḥ ॥39॥

variants.critical_text: hastādāno mukhādāno niyato vṛkṣamūlikaḥ vānaprastho bhaviṣyāmi adṛṣṭvā janakātmajām
variants.southern_text: hastādāno mukhādāno niyato vṛkṣamūlikaḥ । vānaprastho bhaviṣyāmi hy adṛṣṭvā janakātmajām ॥40॥

variants.critical_text: sāgarānūpaje deśe bahumūlaphalodake citāṃ kṛtvā pravekṣyāmi samiddham araṇīsutam
variants.southern_text: sāgarānūpaje deśe bahumūlaphalodake । citiṃ kṛtvā pravekṣyāmi samiddham araṇīsutam ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: sujātamūlā subhagā kīrtimālāyaśasvinī prabhagnā cirarātrīyaṃ mama sītām apaśyataḥ
variants.southern_text: sujātamūlā subhagā kīrtimālā yaśasvinī । prabhagnā cirarātrāya mama sītām apaśyataḥ ॥44॥

variants.critical_text: yadītaḥ pratigacchāmi sītām anadhigamya tām aṅgadaḥ sahitaiḥ sarvair vānarair na bhaviṣyati
variants.southern_text: yadi tu pratigacchāmi sītām anadhigamya tām । aṅgadaḥ sahitaiḥ sarvair vānarair na bhaviṣyati ॥46॥

variants.critical_text: evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ duḥkhaṃ manasā dhārayan muhuḥ nādhyagacchat tadā pāraṃ śokasya kapikuñjaraḥ
variants.southern_text: evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ duḥkhaṃ manasā dhārayan bahu । nādhyagacchat tadā pāraṃ śokasya kapikuñjaraḥ ॥48॥

variants.critical_text: rāvaṇaṃ vā vadhiṣyāmi daśagrīvaṃ mahābalam kāmam astu hṛtā sītā pratyācīrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati
variants.southern_text: tato vikramamāsādya dhairyavān kapikuñjaraḥ । rāvaṇaṃ vā vadhiṣyāmi daśagrīvaṃ mahābalam । kāmam astu hṛtā sītā pratyācīrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥49॥

variants.critical_text: iti cintā samāpannaḥ sītām anadhigamya tām dhyānaśokā parītātmā cintayām āsa vānaraḥ
variants.southern_text: iti cintāsamāpannaḥ sītām anadhigamya tām । dhyānaśokaparītātmā cintayām āsa vānaraḥ ॥51॥

variants.critical_text: saṃpāti vacanāc cāpi rāmaṃ yady ānayāmy aham apaśyan rāghavo bhāryāṃ nirdahet sarvavānarān
variants.southern_text: sampātivacanāc cāpi rāmaṃ yady ānayāmy aham । apaśyan rāghavo bhāryāṃ nirdahet sarvavānarān ॥53॥

variants.critical_text: jitvā tu rākṣasān devīm ikṣvākukulanandinīm saṃpradāsyāmi rāmāyā yathāsiddhiṃ tapasvine
variants.southern_text: jitvā tu rākṣasān devīm ikṣvākukulanandinīm । sampradāsyāmi rāmāyā siddhīm iva tapasvine ॥57॥

variants.critical_text: sa tebhyas tu namaskṛtvā sugrīvāya ca mārutiḥ diśaḥ sarvāḥ samālokya aśokavanikāṃ prati
variants.southern_text: sa tebhyas tu namaskṛtvā sugrīvāya ca mārutiḥ । diśaḥ sarvāḥ samālokya so 'śokavanikāṃ prati ॥60॥

variants.critical_text: dhruvaṃ tu rakṣobahulā bhaviṣyati vanākulā aśokavanikā cintyā sarvasaṃskārasaṃskṛtā
variants.southern_text: dhruvaṃ tu rakṣobahulā bhaviṣyati vanākulā । aśokavanikā puṇyā sarvasaṃskārasaṃskṛtā ॥62॥

variants.critical_text: rakṣiṇaś cātra vihitā nūnaṃ rakṣanti pādapān bhagavān api sarvātmā nātikṣobhaṃ pravāyati
variants.southern_text: rakṣiṇaś cātra vihitā nūnaṃ rakṣanti pādapān । bhagavān api viśvātmā nātikṣobhaṃ pravāyati ॥63॥

variants.critical_text: saṃkṣipto 'yaṃ mayātmā ca rāmārthe rāvaṇasya ca siddhiṃ me saṃvidhāsyanti devāḥ sarṣigaṇās tv iha
variants.southern_text: saṃkṣipto 'yaṃ mayātmā ca rāmārthe rāvaṇasya ca । siddhiṃ diśantu me sarve devāḥ sarṣigaṇās tv iha ॥64॥

variants.critical_text: brahmā svayambhūr bhagavān devāś caiva diśantu me siddhim agniś ca vāyuś ca puruhūtaś ca vajradhṛt
variants.southern_text: brahmā svayambhūr bhagavān devāś caiva tapasvinaḥ । siddhim agniś ca vāyuś ca puruhūtaś ca vajradhṛt ॥65॥

variants.critical_text: varuṇaḥ pāśahastaś ca somādityai tathaiva ca aśvinau ca mahātmānau marutaḥ sarva eva ca
variants.southern_text: varuṇaḥ pāśahastaś ca somādityau tathaiva ca । aśvinau ca mahātmānau marutaḥ sarva eva ca ॥66॥

variants.critical_text: siddhiṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhūtānāṃ caiva yaḥ prabhuḥ dāsyanti mama ye cānye adṛṣṭāḥ pathi gocarāḥ
variants.southern_text: siddhiṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhūtānāṃ caiva yaḥ prabhuḥ । dāsyanti mama ye cānye 'py adṛṣṭāḥ pathi gocarāḥ ॥67॥

variants.critical_text: tad unnasaṃ pāṇḍuradantam avraṇaṃ; śucismitaṃ padmapalāśalocanam drakṣye tad āryāvadanaṃ kadā nv ahaṃ; prasannatārādhipatulyadarśanam
variants.southern_text: tad unnasaṃ pāṇḍuradantam avraṇaṃ; । śucismitaṃ padmapalāśalocanam । drakṣye tad āryāvadanaṃ kadā nv ahaṃ; । prasannatārādhipatulyavarcasam ॥68॥

variants.critical_text: kṣudreṇa pāpena nṛśaṃsakarmaṇā; sudāruṇālāṃkṛtaveṣadhāriṇā balābhibhūtā abalā tapasvinī; kathaṃ nu me dṛṣṭapathe 'dya sā bhavet
variants.southern_text: kṣudreṇa hīnena nṛśaṃsamūrtiṇā; । sudāruṇālāṃkṛtaveṣadhāriṇā । balābhibhūtā abalā tapasvinī । kathaṃ nu me dṛṣṭipathe 'dya sā bhavet ॥69॥

variants.critical_text: athāmravaṇasaṃchannāṃ latāśatasamāvṛtām jyāmukta iva nārācaḥ pupluve vṛkṣavāṭikām
variants.southern_text: tathāmravaṇasaṃchannāṃ latāśatasamāvṛtām । jyāmukta iva nārācaḥ pupluve vṛkṣavāṭikām ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: sa praviṣya vicitrāṃ tāṃ vihagair abhināditām rājataiḥ kāñcanaiś caiva pādapaiḥ sarvatovṛtām
variants.southern_text: sa praviṣya vicitrāṃ tāṃ vihagair abhināditām । rājataiḥ kāñcanaiś caiva pādapaiḥ sarvato vṛtām ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: prahṛṣṭamanuje kale mṛgapakṣisamākule mattabarhiṇasaṃghuṣṭāṃ nānādvijagaṇāyutām
variants.southern_text: prahṛṣṭamanujāṃ kale mṛgapakṣisamākulām । mattabarhiṇasaṃghuṣṭāṃ nānādvijagaṇāyutām ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: utpatadbhir dvijagaṇaiḥ pakṣaiḥ sālāḥ samāhatāḥ anekavarṇā vividhā mumucuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ
variants.southern_text: utpatadbhir dvijagaṇaiḥ pakṣair vātaiḥ samāhatāḥ । anekavarṇā vividhā mumucuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: diśaḥ sarvābhidāvantaṃ vṛkṣaṣaṇḍagataṃ kapim dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi bhūtāni vasanta iti menire
variants.southern_text: diśaḥ sarvābhidhāvantaṃ vṛkṣakhaṇḍagataṃ kapim । dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi bhūtāni vasanta iti menire ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: tarasvinā te taravas tarasābhiprakampitāḥ kusumāni vicitrāṇi sasṛjuḥ kapinā tadā
variants.southern_text: tarasvinā te taravas tarasā bahu kampitāḥ । kusumāni vicitrāṇi sasṛjuḥ kapinā tadā ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: hanūmatā vegavatā kampitās te nagottamāḥ puṣpaparṇaphalāny āśu mumucuḥ puṣpaśālinaḥ
variants.southern_text: hanūmatā vegavatā kampitās te nagottamāḥ । puṣpaparṇaphalāny āśu mumucuḥ phalaśālinaḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: vihaṃgasaṃghair hīnās te skandhamātrāśrayā drumāḥ babhūvur agamāḥ sarve māruteneva nirdhutāḥ
variants.southern_text: vihaṃgasaṃghair hīnās te skandhamātrāśrayā drumāḥ । babhūvur agamāḥ sarve mārutena vinirdhutāḥ ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: vidhūtakeśī yuvatir yathā mṛditavarṇikā niṣpītaśubhadantauṣṭhī nakhair dantaiś ca vikṣatā
variants.southern_text: vidhūtakeśī yuvatir yathā mṛditavarṇikā । nipītaśubhadantoṣṭhī nakhair dantaiś ca vikṣatā ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: tathā lāṅgūlahastaiś ca caraṇābhyāṃ ca marditā babhūvāśokavanikā prabhagnavarapādapā
variants.southern_text: tathā lāṅgūlahastais tu caraṇābhyāṃ ca marditā । tathaivāśokavanikā prabhagnavanapādapā ॥19॥

variants.critical_text: mahālatānāṃ dāmāni vyadhamat tarasā kapiḥ yathā prāvṛṣi vindhyasya meghajālāni mārutaḥ
variants.southern_text: mahālatānāṃ dāmāni vyadhamat tarasā kapiḥ । yathā prāvṛṣi vegena meghajālāni mārutaḥ ॥20॥

variants.critical_text: muktāpravālasikatā sphaṭikāntarakuṭṭimāḥ kāñcanais tarubhiś citrais tīrajair upaśobhitāḥ
variants.southern_text: muktāpravālasikatāḥ sphaṭikāntarakuṭṭimāḥ । kāñcanais tarubhiś citrais tīrajair upaśobhitāḥ ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: phullapadmotpalavanāś cakravākopakūjitāḥ natyūharutasaṃghuṣṭā haṃsasārasanāditāḥ
variants.southern_text: buddhapadmotpalavanāś cakravākopakūjitāḥ । natyūharutasaṃghuṣṭā haṃsasārasanāditāḥ ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: latāśatair avatatāḥ santānakasamāvṛtāḥ nānāgulmāvṛtavanāḥ karavīrakṛtāntarāḥ
variants.southern_text: latāśatair avatatāḥ saṃtānakasamāvṛtāḥ । nānāgulmāvṛtavanāḥ karavīrakṛtāntarāḥ ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: śilāgṛhair avatataṃ nānāvṛkṣaiḥ samāvṛtam dadarśa kapiśārdūlo ramyaṃ jagati parvatam
variants.southern_text: śilāgṛhair avatataṃ nānāvṛkṣasamāvṛtam । dadarśa kapiśārdūlo ramyaṃ jagati parvatam ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: so 'paśyad bhūmibhāgāṃś ca gartaprasravaṇāni ca suvarṇavṛkṣān aparān dadarśa śikhisaṃnibhān
variants.southern_text: so 'paśyad bhūmibhāgāṃś ca nagaprasravaṇāni ca । suvarṇavṛkṣān aparān dadarśa śikhisaṃnibhān ॥38॥

variants.critical_text: teṣāṃ drumāṇāṃ prabhayā meror iva mahākapiḥ amanyata tadā vīraḥ kāñcano 'smīti vānaraḥ
variants.southern_text: teṣāṃ drumāṇāṃ prabhayā meror iva mahākapiḥ । amanyata tadā vīraḥ kāñcano 'smīti sarvataḥ ॥39॥

variants.critical_text: tāṃ kāñcanais tarugaṇair mārutena ca vījitām kiṅkiṇīśatanirghoṣāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayam āgamat
variants.southern_text: tān kāñcanān vṛkṣagaṇān marutena prakampitān । kiṅkiṇīśatanirghoṣāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayam āgamat ॥40॥

variants.critical_text: supuṣpitāgrāṃ rucirāṃ taruṇāṅkurapallavām tām āruhya mahāvegaḥ śiṃśapāṃ parṇasaṃvṛtām
variants.southern_text: supuṣpitāgrāṃ rucirāṃs taruṇāṅkurapallavām । tām āruhya mahāvegaḥ śiṃśapāṃ parṇasaṃvṛtām ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: ito drakṣyāmi vaidehīṃ rāma darśanalālasām itaś cetaś ca duḥkhārtāṃ saṃpatantīṃ yadṛcchayā
variants.southern_text: ito drakṣyāmi vaidehīṃ rāmadarśanalālasām । itaś cetaś ca duḥkhārtāṃ sampatantīṃ yadṛcchayā ॥42॥

variants.critical_text: aśokavanikā ceyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ ramyā durātmanaḥ campakaiś candanaiś cāpi bakulaiś ca vibhūṣitā
variants.southern_text: aśokavanikā ceyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ ramyā durātmanaḥ । candanaiś campakaiś cāpi bakulaiś ca vibhūṣitā ॥43॥

variants.critical_text: sā rāma rāmamahiṣī rāghavasya priyā sadā vanasaṃcārakuśalā nūnam eṣyati jānakī
variants.southern_text: sā rāmā rāmamahiṣī rāghavasya priyā satī । vanasaṃcārakuśalā dhrūvam eṣyati jānakī ॥45॥

variants.critical_text: atha vā mṛgaśāvākṣī vanasyāsya vicakṣaṇā vanam eṣyati sā ceha rāmacintānukarśitā
variants.southern_text: atha vā mṛgaśāvākṣī vanasyāsya vicakṣaṇā । vanam eṣyati sādyeha rāmacintāsukarśitā ॥46॥

variants.critical_text: tasyāś cāpy anurūpeyam aśokavanikā śubhā śubhā yā pārthivendrasya patnī rāmasya saṃmitā
variants.southern_text: tasyāś cāpy anurūpeyam aśokavanikā śubhā । śubhā yā pārthivendrasya patnī rāmasya sammatā ॥50॥

variants.critical_text: santāna kalatābhiś ca pādapair upaśobhitām divyagandharasopetāṃ sarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtām
variants.southern_text: saṃtānakalatābhiś ca pādapair upaśobhitām । divyagandharasopetāṃ sarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtām ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: tāṃ sa nandanasaṃkāśāṃ mṛgapakṣibhir āvṛtām harmyaprāsādasaṃbādhāṃ kokilākulaniḥsvanām
variants.southern_text: tāṃ sa nandanasaṃkāśāṃ mṛgapakṣibhir āvṛtām । harmyaprāsādasambādhāṃ kokilākulaniḥsvanām ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: vrīḍitāṃ duḥkhasaṃtaptāṃ parimlānāṃ tapasvinīm graheṇāṅgārakeṇaiva pīḍitām iva rohiṇīm
variants.southern_text: pīḍitāṃ duḥkhasaṃtaptāṃ parikṣīṇāṃ tapasvinīm । graheṇāṅgārakeṇeva pīḍitām iva rohiṇīm ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: aśrupūrṇamukhīṃ dīnāṃ kṛśām ananaśena ca śokadhyānaparāṃ dīnāṃ nityaṃ duḥkhaparāyaṇām
variants.southern_text: aśrupūrṇamukhīṃ dīnāṃ kṛśām anaśanena ca । śokadhyānaparāṃ dīnāṃ nityaṃ duḥkhaparāyaṇām ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: priyaṃ janam apaśyantīṃ paśyantīṃ rākṣasīgaṇam svagaṇena mṛgīṃ hīnāṃ śvagaṇābhivṛtām iva
variants.southern_text: priyaṃ janam apaśyantīṃ paśyantīṃ rākṣasīgaṇam । svagaṇena mṛgīṃ hīnāṃ śvagaṇenāvṛtām iva ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: nīlanāgābhayā veṇyā jaghanaṃ gatayaikayā sukhārhāṃ duḥkhasaṃtaptāṃ vyasanānām akodivām
variants.southern_text: nīlanāgābhayā veṇyā jaghanaṃ gatayaikayā । nīlayā nīradāpāye vanarājyā mahīmiva ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: tasya saṃdidihe buddhir muhuḥ sītāṃ nirīkṣya tu āmnāyānām ayogena vidyāṃ praśithilām iva
variants.southern_text: tasya saṃdidihe buddhis tathā sītāṃ nirīkṣya ca । āmnāyānām ayogena vidyāṃ praśithilām iva ॥38॥

variants.critical_text: duḥkhena bubudhe sītāṃ hanumān analaṃkṛtām saṃskāreṇa yathāhīnāṃ vācam arthāntaraṃ gatām
variants.southern_text: duḥkhena bubudhe sītāṃ hanumān analaṃkṛtām । saṃskāreṇa yathā hīnāṃ vācam arthāntaraṃ gatām ॥39॥

variants.critical_text: śyāmāni cirayuktatvāt tathā saṃsthānavanti ca tāny evaitāni manye 'haṃ yāni rāmo 'vnakīrtayat
variants.southern_text: śyāmāni cirayuktatvāt tathā saṃsthānavanti ca । tāny evaitāni manye 'haṃ yāni rāmo 'nvakīrtayat ॥43॥

variants.critical_text: idaṃ ciragṛhītatvād vasanaṃ kliṣṭavattaram tathā hi nūnaṃ tad varṇaṃ tathā śrīmad yathetarat
variants.southern_text: idaṃ ciragṛhītatvād vasanaṃ kliṣṭavattaram । tathāpyanūnaṃ tadvarṇaṃ tathā śrīmad yathetarat ॥47॥

variants.critical_text: iyaṃ sā yat kṛte rāmaś caturbhiḥ paritapyate kāruṇyenānṛśaṃsyena śokena madanena ca
variants.southern_text: iyaṃ sā yat kṛte rāmaś caturbhir iha tapyate । kāruṇyenānṛśaṃsyena śokena madanena ca ॥49॥

variants.critical_text: asyā devyā yathā rūpam aṅgapratyaṅgasauṣṭhavam rāmasya ca yathārūpaṃ tasyeyam asitekṣaṇā
variants.southern_text: asyā devyā yathā rūpam aṅgapratyaṅgasauṣṭhavam । rāmasya ca tathā rūpaṃ tasyeyam asitekṣaṇā ॥51॥

variants.critical_text: evaṃ sītāṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭaḥ pavanasaṃbhavaḥ jagāma manasā rāmaṃ praśaśaṃsa ca taṃ prabhum
variants.southern_text: evaṃ sītāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭaḥ pavanasambhavaḥ । jagāma manasā rāmaṃ praśaśaṃsa ca taṃ prabhum ॥54॥

variants.critical_text: mānyā guruvinītasya lakṣmaṇasya gurupriyā yadi sītāpi duḥkhārtā kālo hi duratikramaḥ
variants.southern_text: mānyā guruvinītasya lakṣmaṇasya gurupriyā । yadi sītā hi duḥkhārtā kālo hi duratikramaḥ ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: caturdaśasahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām nihatāni janasthāne śarair agniśikhopamaiḥ
variants.southern_text: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām । nihatāni janasthāne śarair agniśikhopamaiḥ ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: aiśvaryaṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca durlabhaṃ vālipālitam asyā nimitte sugrīvaḥ prāptavāṃl lokasatkṛtam
variants.southern_text: aiśvaryaṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca durlabhaṃ vālipālitam । asyā nimitte sugrīvaḥ prāptavāṃl lokaviśrutaḥ ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: sāgaraś ca mayā krāntaḥ śrīmān nadanadīpatiḥ asyā hetor viśālākṣyāḥ purī ceyaṃ nirīkṣitā
variants.southern_text: sāgaraś ca mayākrāntaḥ śrīmān nadanadīpatiḥ । asyā hetor viśālākṣyāḥ purī ceyaṃ nirīkṣitā ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: iyaṃ sā dharmaśīlasya maithilasya mahātmanaḥ sutā janakarājasya sītā bhartṛdṛḍhavratā
variants.southern_text: iyaṃ sā dharmaśīlasya janakasya mahātmanaḥ । sutā maithilarājasya sītā bhartṛdṛḍhavratā ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: dharmajñasya kṛtajñasya rāmasya viditātmanaḥ iyaṃ sā dayitā bhāryā rākṣasī vaśam āgatā
variants.southern_text: dharmajñasya kṛtajñasya rāmasya viditātmanaḥ । iyaṃ sā dayitā bhāryā rākṣasīvaśam āgatā ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: sarvān bhogān parityajya bhartṛsnehabalāt kṛtā acintayitvā duḥkhāni praviṣṭā nirjanaṃ vanam
variants.southern_text: sarvān bhogān parityajya bhartṛsnehabalāt kṛtā । acintayitvā kaṣṭāni praviṣṭā nirjanaṃ vanam ॥19॥

variants.critical_text: saṃtuṣṭā phalamūlena bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇe ratā yā parāṃ bhajate prītiṃ vane 'pi bhavane yathā
variants.southern_text: saṃtuṣṭā phalamūlena bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇāparā । yā parāṃ bhajate prītiṃ vane 'pi bhavane yathā ॥20॥

variants.critical_text: bhartā nāma paraṃ nāryā bhūṣaṇaṃ bhūṣaṇād api eṣā hi rahitā tena śobhanārhā na śobhate
variants.southern_text: bhartā nāma paraṃ nāryāḥ śobhanaṃ bhūṣaṇād api । eṣā hi rahitā tena śobhanārhā na śobhate ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: imām asitakeśāntāṃ śatapatranibhekṣaṇām sukhārhāṃ duḥkhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā mamāpi vyathitaṃ manaḥ
variants.southern_text: imām asitakeśāntāṃ śatapatranibhekṣaṇām । sukhārhāṃ duḥkhitāṃ jñātvā mamāpi vyathitaṃ manaḥ ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: kṣitikṣamā puṣkarasaṃnibhākṣī; yā rakṣitā rāghavalakṣmaṇābhyām sā rākṣasībhir vikṛtekṣaṇābhiḥ; saṃrakṣyate saṃprati vṛkṣamūle
variants.southern_text: kṣitikṣamā puṣkarasaṃnibhekṣaṇā । yā rakṣitā rāghavalakṣmaṇābhyām । sā rākṣasībhir vikṛtekṣaṇābhiḥ । saṃrakṣyate samprati vṛkṣamūle ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: asyā hi puṣpāvanatāgraśākhāḥ; śokaṃ dṛḍhaṃ vai janayaty aśokāḥ himavyapāyena ca mandaraśmir; abhyutthito naikasahasraraśmiḥ
variants.southern_text: asyā hi puṣpāvanatāgraśākhāḥ । śokaṃ dṛḍhaṃ vai janayaty aśokāḥ । himavyapāyena ca śītaraśmir । abhyutthito naikasahasraraśmiḥ ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: ity evam arthaṃ kapir anvavekṣya; sīteyam ity eva niviṣṭabuddhiḥ saṃśritya tasmin niṣasāda vṛkṣe; balī harīṇām ṛṣabhas tarasvī
variants.southern_text: ity evam arthaṃ kapir anvavekṣya । sīteyam ity eva tu jātabuddhiḥ । saṃśritya tasmin niṣasāda vṛkṣe । balī harīṇām ṛṣabhas tarasvī ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ kumudaṣaṇḍābho nirmalaṃ nirmalaḥ svayam prajagāma nabhaś candro haṃso nīlam ivodakam
variants.southern_text: tataḥ kumudakhaṇḍābho nirmalaṃ nirmalodayaḥ । prajagāma nabhaś candro haṃso nīlam ivodakam ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: lambakarṇalalāṭāṃ ca lambodarapayodharām lambauṣṭhīṃ cibukauṣṭhīṃ ca lambāsyāṃ lambajānukām
variants.southern_text: lambakarṇalalāṭāṃ ca lambodarapayodharām । lamboṣṭhīṃ cibukoṣṭhīṃ ca lambāsyāṃ lambajānukām ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: hrasvāṃ dīrghāṃ ca kubjāṃ ca vikaṭāṃ vāmanāṃ tathā karālāṃ bhugnavastrāṃ ca piṅgākṣīṃ vikṛtānanām
variants.southern_text: hrasvāṃ dīrghāṃ ca kubjāṃ ca vikaṭāṃ vāmanāṃ tathā । karālāṃ bhugnavaktrāṃ ca piṅgākṣīṃ vikṛtānanām ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: anāsā atināsāś ca tiryan nāsā vināsikāḥ gajasaṃnibhanāsāś ca lalāṭocchvāsanāsikāḥ
variants.southern_text: atināsāś ca kaścic ca tiryaṅnāsā anāsikāḥ । gajasaṃnibhanāsāś ca lalāṭocchvāsanāsikāḥ ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: atimātrāsya netrāś ca dīrghajihvānakhās tathā ajāmukhīr hastimukhīr gomukhīḥ sūkarīmukhīḥ
variants.southern_text: atimātrāsyanetrāś ca dīrghajihvānakhās tathā । ajāmukhīr hastimukhīr gomukhīḥ sūkarīmukhīḥ ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: karālā dhūmrakeśīś ca rakṣasīr vikṛtānanāḥ pibantīḥ satataṃ pānaṃ sadā māṃsasurāpriyāḥ
variants.southern_text: karālā dhūmrakeśinyo rakṣasīr vikṛtānanāḥ । pibantīḥ satataṃ pānaṃ surāmaṃsasadāpriyāḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: kṣīṇapuṇyāṃ cyutāṃ bhūmau tārāṃ nipatitām iva cāritrya vyapadeśāḍhyāṃ bhartṛdarśanadurgatām
variants.southern_text: kṣīṇapuṇyāṃ cyutāṃ bhūmau tārāṃ nipatitām iva । cāritravyapadeśāḍhyāṃ bhartṛdarśanadurgatām ॥20॥

variants.critical_text: viyūthāṃ siṃhasaṃruddhāṃ baddhāṃ gajavadhūm iva candralekhāṃ payodānte śāradābhrair ivāvṛtām
variants.southern_text: viyūthāṃ siṃhasaṃruddhāṃ baddhāṃ gajavadhūm iva । candrarekhāṃ payodānte śāradābhrair ivāvṛtām ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: kliṣṭarūpām asaṃsparśād ayuktām iva vallakīm sītāṃ bhartṛhite yuktām ayuktāṃ rakṣasāṃ vaśe
variants.southern_text: kliṣṭarūpām asaṃsparśād ayuktām iva vallakīm । sītāṃ bhartṛhite yuktām ayuktāṃ rakṣasāṃ vase ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: dadarśa hanumān devīṃ latām akusumām iva sā malena ca digdhāṅgī vapuṣā cāpy alaṃkṛtā
variants.southern_text: dadarśa hanumāṃs tatra latām akusumam iva । sā malena ca digdhāṅgī vapuṣā cāpy alaṃkṛtā । mṛṇālī paṅkadigdheva vibhāti ca na bhāti ca ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: sītādarśanasaṃhṛṣṭo hanūmān saṃvṛto 'bhavat
variants.southern_text: namaskṛtvā ca rāmāya lakṣmaṇāya ca vīryavān । sītādarśanasaṃhṛṣṭo hanūmān saṃvṛto 'bhavat ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: ṣaḍaṅgavedaviduṣāṃ kratupravarayājinām śuśrāva brahmaghoṣāṃś ca virātre brahmarakṣasām
variants.southern_text: ṣaḍaṅgavedaviduṣāṃ kratupravarayājinām । śuśrāva brahmaghoṣān sa virātre brahmarakṣasām ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: vibudhya tu yathākālaṃ rākṣasendraḥ pratāvapān srastamālyāmbaradharo vaidehīm anvacintayat
variants.southern_text: vibudhya tu mahābhago rākṣasendraḥ pratāpavān । srastamālyāmbaradharo vaidehīm anvacintayat ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: vṛtāṃ puṣkariṇībhiś ca nānāpuṣpopaśobhitām sadāmadaiś ca vihagair vicitrāṃ paramādbhutām
variants.southern_text: vṛtāṃ puṣkariṇībhiś ca nānāpuṣpopaśobhitām । sadā mattaiś ca vihagair vicitrāṃ paramādbhutaiḥ ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: īhāmṛgaiś ca vividhaiś vṛtāṃ dṛṣṭimanoharaiḥ vīthīḥ saṃprekṣamāṇaś ca maṇikāñcanatoraṇāḥ
variants.southern_text: īhāmṛgaiś ca vividhaiś vṛtāṃ dṛṣṭimanoharaiḥ । vīthīḥ samprekṣamāṇaś ca maṇikāñcanatoraṇām ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: aṅganāśatamātraṃ tu taṃ vrajantam anuvrajat mahendram iva paulastyaṃ devagandharvayoṣitaḥ
variants.southern_text: aṅganāḥ śatamātraṃ tu taṃ vrajantam anuvrajan । mahendram iva paulastyaṃ devagandharvayoṣitaḥ ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: dīpikāḥ kāñcanīḥ kāś cij jagṛhus tatra yoṣitaḥ bālavyajanahastāś ca tālavṛntāni cāparāḥ
variants.southern_text: dīpikāḥ kāñcanīḥ kāś cij jagṛhus tatra yoṣitaḥ । vālavyajanahastāś ca tālavṛntāni cāparāḥ ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: kāñcanair api bhṛṅgārair jahruḥ salilam agrataḥ maṇḍalāgrān asīṃś caiva gṛhyānyāḥ pṛṣṭhato yayuḥ
variants.southern_text: kāñcanaiś caiva bhṛṅgārair jahruḥ salilam agrataḥ । maṇḍalāgrā bṛsīś caiva gṛhyānyāḥ pṛṣṭhato yayuḥ ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: kā cid ratnamayīṃ pātrīṃ pūrṇāṃ pānasya bhāminī dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇenaiva tadā jagrāha pāṇinā
variants.southern_text: kā cid ratnamayīṃ pātrīṃ pūrṇāṃ pānasya bhrājatīm । dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇenaiva tadā jagrāha pāṇinā ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ kāñcīninādaṃ ca nūpurāṇāṃ ca niḥsvanam śuśrāva paramastrīṇāṃ sa kapir mārutātmajaḥ
variants.southern_text: tataḥ kāñcīninādaṃ ca nūpurāṇāṃ ca niḥsvanam । śuśrāva paramastrīṇāṃ sa kapir mārutanandanaḥ ॥20॥

variants.critical_text: kāmadarpamadair yuktaṃ jihmatāmrāyatekṣaṇam samakṣam iva kandarpam apaviddha śarāsanam
variants.southern_text: kāmadarpamadair yuktaṃ jihmatāmrāyatekṣaṇam । samakṣam iva kandarpam apaviddhaśarāsanam ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: mathitāmṛtaphenābham arajo vastram uttamam salīlam anukarṣantaṃ vimuktaṃ saktam aṅgade
variants.southern_text: mathitāmṛtaphenābham arajovastram uttamam । sapuṣpam avakarṣantaṃ vimuktaṃ saktam aṅgade ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: taṃ patraviṭape līnaḥ patrapuṣpaghanāvṛtaḥ samīpam upasaṃkrāntaṃ nidhyātum upacakrame
variants.southern_text: taṃ patraviṭape līnaḥ patrapuṣpaśatāvṛtaḥ । samīpam upasaṃkrāntaṃ nidhyātum upacakrame ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: avekṣamāṇaś ca tato dadarśa kapikuñjaraḥ rūpayauvanasaṃpannā rāvaṇasya varastriyaḥ
variants.southern_text: avekṣamāṇas tu tadā dadarśa kapikuñjaraḥ । rūpayauvanasampannā rāvaṇasya varastriyaḥ ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: rāvaṇo 'yaṃ mahābāhur iti saṃcintya vānaraḥ avapluto mahātejā hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ
variants.southern_text: rāvaṇo 'yaṃ mahābāhur iti saṃcintya vānaraḥ । so’yameva purā śete puramadhye gṛhottame । avapluto mahātejā hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: sa tathāpy ugratejāḥ san nirdhūtas tasya tejasā patraguhyāntare sakto hanūmān saṃvṛto 'bhavat
variants.southern_text: sa tathāpy ugratejāḥ sa nirdhūtas tasya tejasā । patre guhyāntare sakto hanūmān saṃvṛto 'bhavat ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: tasminn eva tataḥ kāle rājaputrī tv aninditā rūpayauvanasaṃpannaṃ bhūṣaṇottamabhūṣitam
variants.southern_text: tasminn eva tataḥ kāle rājaputrī tv aninditā । rūpayauvanasampannaṃ bhūṣaṇottamabhūṣitam ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: daśagrīvas tu vaidehīṃ rakṣitāṃ rākṣasīgaṇaiḥ dadarśa dīnāṃ duḥkhārtaṃ nāvaṃ sannām ivārṇave
variants.southern_text: daśagrīvas tu vaidehīṃ rakṣitāṃ rākṣasīgaṇaiḥ । dadarśa dīnāṃ duḥkhārtāṃ nāvaṃ sannām ivārṇave ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: veṣṭamānām athāviṣṭāṃ pannagendravadhūm iva dhūpyamānāṃ graheṇeva rohiṇīṃ dhūmaketunā
variants.southern_text: ceṣṭamānām athāviṣṭāṃ pannagendravadhūm iva । dhūpyamānāṃ graheṇeva rohiṇīṃ dhūmaketunā ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: āyatīm iva vidhvastām ājñāṃ pratihatām iva dīptām iva diśaṃ kāle pūjām apahṛtām iva
variants.southern_text: āyatīm iva vidhvastām ājñāṃ pratihatām iva । dīptām iva diśaṃ kāle pūjām apahatām iva ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: utkṛṣṭaparṇakamalāṃ vitrāsitavihaṃgamām hastihastaparāmṛṣṭām ākulāṃ padminīm iva
variants.southern_text: utkṛṣṭaparṇakamalāṃ vitrāsitavihaṃgamām । hastihastaparāmṛṣṭām ākulām iva padminīm ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: gṛhītāmālitāṃ stambhe yūthapena vinākṛtām niḥśvasantīṃ suduḥkhārtāṃ gajarājavadhūm iva
variants.southern_text: gṛhītām ālitāṃ stambhe yūthapena vinākṛtām । niḥśvasantīṃ suduḥkhārtāṃ gajarājavadhūm iva ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: māṃ dṛṣṭvā nāganāsorugūhamānā stanodaram adarśanam ivātmānaṃ bhayān netuṃ tvam icchasi
variants.southern_text: māṃ dṛṣṭvā nāganāsoru gūhamānā stanodaram । adarśanam ivātmānaṃ bhayān netuṃ tvam icchasi ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: kāmaye tvāṃ viśālākṣi bahumanyasva māṃ priye sarvāṅgaguṇasaṃpanne sarvalokamanohare
variants.southern_text: kāmaye tvāṃ viśālākṣi bahu manyasva māṃ priye । sarvāṅgaguṇasampanne sarvalokamanohare ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: svadharme rakṣasāṃ bhīru sarvathaiṣa na saṃśayaḥ gamanaṃ vā parastrīṇāṃ haraṇaṃ saṃpramathya vā
variants.southern_text: svadharmo rakṣasāṃ bhīru sarvadaiva na saṃśayaḥ । gamanaṃ vā parastrīṇāṃ haraṇaṃ sampramathya vā ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: evaṃ caitad akāmāṃ ca na tvāṃ sprakṣyāmi maithili kāmaṃ kāmaḥ śarīre me yathākāmaṃ pravartatām
variants.southern_text: evaṃ caivam akāmāṃ tvāṃ na ca sprakṣyāmi maithili । kāmaṃ kāmaḥ śarīre me yathākāmaṃ pravartatām ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: ekaveṇī dharāśayyā dhyānaṃ malinam ambaram asthāne 'py upavāsaś ca naitāny aupayikāni te
variants.southern_text: ekaveṇī adhaḥśayyā dhyānaṃ malinam ambaram । asthāne 'py upavāsaś ca naitāny aupayikāni te ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: mahārhāṇi ca pānāni yānāni śayanāni ca gītaṃ nṛttaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca labha māṃ prāpya maithili
variants.southern_text: mahārhāṇi ca pānāni śayanāny āsanāni ca । gītaṃ nṛttaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca labha māṃ prāpya maithili ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: strīratnam asi maivaṃ bhūḥ kuru gātreṣu bhūṣaṇam māṃ prāpya tu kathaṃ hi syās tvam anarhā suvigrahe
variants.southern_text: strīratnam asi maivaṃ bhūḥ kuru gātreṣu bhūṣaṇam । māṃ prāpya hi kathaṃ vā syās tvam anarhā suvigrahe ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: idaṃ te cārusaṃjātaṃ yauvanaṃ vyativartate yad atītaṃ punar naiti srotaḥ śīghram apām iva
variants.southern_text: idaṃ te cāru saṃjātaṃ yauvanaṃ hy ativartate । yad atītaṃ punar naiti srotaḥ srotasvinām iva ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: tvāṃ samāsādya vaidehi rūpayauvanaśālinīm kaḥ pumān ativarteta sākṣād api pitāmahaḥ
variants.southern_text: tvāṃ samāsādya vaidehi rūpayauvanaśālinīm । kaḥ punar nātivarteta sākṣād api pitāmahaḥ ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: bhava maithili bhāryā me moham enaṃ visarjaya bahvīnām uttamastrīṇāṃ mamāgramahiṣī bhava
variants.southern_text: bhava maithili bhāryā me moham etaṃ visarjaya । bahvīnām uttamastrīṇāṃ mamāgramahiṣī bhava ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: lokebhyo yāni ratnāni saṃpramathyāhṛtāni me tāni te bhīru sarvāṇi rājyaṃ caitad ahaṃ ca te
variants.southern_text: lokebhyo yāni ratnāni sampramathyāhṛtāni me । tāni te bhīru sarvāṇi rājyaṃ caiva dadāmi te ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: iccha māṃ kriyatām adya pratikarma tavottamam saprabhāṇy avasajjantāṃ tavāṅge bhūṣaṇāni ca
variants.southern_text: iccha māṃ kriyatām adya pratikarma tavottamam । suprabhāṇy avasajjantāṃ tavāṅge bhūṣaṇāni hi ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: lalasva mayi visrabdhā dhṛṣṭam ājñāpayasva ca matprabhāvāl lalantyāś ca lalantāṃ bāndhavās tava
variants.southern_text: lalasva mayi visrabdhā dhṛṣṭam ājñāpayasva ca । matprasādāl lalantyāś ca lalantāṃ bāndhavās tava ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: ṛddhiṃ mamānupaśya tvaṃ śriyaṃ bhadre yaśaś ca me kiṃ kariṣyasi rāmeṇa subhage cīravāsasā
variants.southern_text: ṛddhiṃ mamānupaśya tvaṃ śriyaṃ bhadre yaśasvini । kiṃ kariṣyasi rāmeṇa subhage cīravāsinā ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: na hi vaidehi rāmas tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ vāpy upalapsyate puro balākair asitair meghair jyotsnām ivāvṛtām
variants.southern_text: na hi vaidehi rāmas tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ vāpy upalabhyate । purobalākair asitair meghair jyotsnām ivāvṛtām ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: kliṣṭakauśeyavasanāṃ tanvīm apy analaṃkṛtām tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sveṣu dāreṣu ratiṃ nopalabhāmy aham
variants.southern_text: kliṣṭakauśeyavasanāṃ tanvīm apy analaṃkṛtām । tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā sveṣu dāreṣu ratiṃ nopalabhāmy aham ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: antaḥpuranivāsinyaḥ striyaḥ sarvaguṇānvitāḥ yāvantyo mama sarvāsām aiśvaryaṃ kuru jānaki
variants.southern_text: antaḥpuranivāsinyaḥ striyaḥ sarvaguṇānvitāḥ । yāvatyo mama sarvāsām aiśvaryaṃ kuru jānaki ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: mama hy asitakeśānte trailokyapravarāḥ striyaḥ tās tvāṃ paricariṣyanti śriyam apsaraso yathā
variants.southern_text: mama hy asitakeśānte trailokyapravarastriyaḥ । tās tvāṃ paricariṣyanti śriyam apsaraso yathā ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: yāni vaiśravaṇe subhru ratnāni ca dhanāni ca tāni lokāṃś ca suśroṇi māṃ ca bhuṅkṣva yathāsukham
variants.southern_text: yāni vaiśravaṇe subhru ratnāni ca dhanāni ca । tāni lokāṃś ca suśroṇi mayā bhuṅkṣva yathāsukham ॥33॥

variants.critical_text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sītā raudrasya rakṣasaḥ ārtā dīnasvarā dīnaṃ pratyuvāca śanair vacaḥ
variants.southern_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā sītā raudrasya rakṣasaḥ । ārtā dīnasvarā dīnaṃ pratyuvāca tataḥ śanaiḥ ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: tṛṇam antarataḥ kṛtvā pratyuvāca śucismitā nivartaya mano mattaḥ svajane kriyatāṃ manaḥ
variants.southern_text: tṛṇam antarataḥ kṛtvā pratyuvāca śucismitā । nivartaya mano mattaḥ svajane prīyatāṃ manaḥ ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: atuṣṭaṃ sveṣu dāreṣu capalaṃ calitendriyam nayanti nikṛtiprajñāṃ paradārāḥ parābhavam
variants.southern_text: ātmānam upamāṃ kṛtvā sveṣu dāreṣu ramyatām । atuṣṭaṃ sveṣu dāreṣu capalaṃ calitendriyam । nayanti nikṛtiprajñaṃ paradārāḥ parābhavam ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: iha santo na vā santi sato vā nānuvartase vaco mithyā praṇītātmā pathyam uktaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ
variants.southern_text: iha santo na vā santi sato vā nānuvartase । yatha hi viparītā te buddhirācāravarjitā ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: tatheyaṃ tvāṃ samāsādya laṅkā ratnaugha saṃkulā aparādhāt tavaikasya nacirād vinaśiṣyati
variants.southern_text: tathaiva tvāṃ samāsādya laṅkā ratnaughasaṃkulā । aparādhāt tavaikasya nacirād vinaśiṣyati ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: evaṃ tvāṃ pāpakarmāṇaṃ vakṣyanti nikṛtā janāḥ diṣṭyaitad vyasanaṃ prāpto raudra ity eva harṣitāḥ
variants.southern_text: evaṃ tvāṃ pāpakarmāṇaṃ vakṣyanti nikṛtā janāḥ । diṣṭyaitad vyasanaṃ prāpto raudra ityeva harṣitāḥ ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: śakyā lobhayituṃ nāham aiśvaryeṇa dhanena vā ananyā rāghaveṇāhaṃ bhāskareṇa prabhā yathā
variants.southern_text: śakyā lobhayituṃ nāham aiśvaryeṇa dhanena vā । ananyā rāghaveṇāhaṃ bhāskareṇa yathā prabhā ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: aham aupayikī bhāryā tasyaiva vasudhāpateḥ vratasnātasya viprasya vidyeva viditātmanaḥ
variants.southern_text: aham aupayikī bhāryā tasyaiva ca dharāpateḥ । vratasnātasya vidyeva viprasya viditātmanaḥ ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: sādhu rāvaṇa rāmeṇa māṃ samānaya duḥkhitām vane vāśitayā sārdhaṃ kareṇveva gajādhipam
variants.southern_text: sādhu rāvaṇa rāmeṇa māṃ samānaya duḥkhitām । vane vāsitayā sārdhaṃ kareṇveva gajādhipam ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: mitram aupayikaṃ kartuṃ rāmaḥ sthānaṃ parīpsatā vadhaṃ cānicchatā ghoraṃ tvayāsau puruṣarṣabhaḥ
variants.southern_text: mitram aupayikaṃ kartuṃ rāmaḥ sthānaṃ parīpsatā । bandhaṃ cānicchatā ghoraṃ tvayāsau puruṣarṣabhaḥ ॥19॥

variants.critical_text: iha śīghraṃ suparvāṇo jvalitāsyā ivoragāḥ iṣavo nipatiṣyanti rāmalakṣmaṇalakṣaṇāḥ
variants.southern_text: iha śīghraṃ suparvāṇo jvalitāsyā ivoragāḥ । iṣavo nipatiṣyanti rāmalakṣmaṇalakṣitāḥ ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: rakṣāṃsi parinighnantaḥ puryām asyāṃ samantataḥ asaṃpātaṃ kariṣyanti patantaḥ kaṅkavāsasaḥ
variants.southern_text: rakṣāṃsi nihaniṣyantaḥ puryām asyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ । asaṃpātaṃ kariṣyanti patantaḥ kaṅkavāsasaḥ ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: āśramaṃ tu tayoḥ śūnyaṃ praviśya narasiṃhayoḥ gocaraṃ gatayor bhrātror apanītā tvayādhama
variants.southern_text: āśramaṃ tattayoḥ śūnyaṃ praviśya narasiṃhayoḥ । gocaraṃ gatayor bhrātror apanītā tvayādhama ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: tasya te vigrahe tābhyāṃ yugagrahaṇam asthiram vṛtrasyevendrabāhubhyāṃ bāhor ekasya nigrahaḥ
variants.southern_text: tasya te vigrahe tābhyāṃ yugagrahaṇam asthiram । vṛtrasyevendrabāhubhyāṃ bāhor ekasya vigrahe ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: kṣipraṃ tava sa nātho me rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha toyam alpam ivādityaḥ prāṇān ādāsyate śaraiḥ
variants.southern_text: kṣipraṃ tava sa nātho me rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha । toyam alpam ivādityaḥ prānān ādāsyate śaraiḥ ॥33॥

variants.critical_text: giriṃ kuberasya gato 'thavālayaṃ; sabhāṃ gato vā varuṇasya rājñaḥ asaṃśayaṃ dāśarather na mokṣyase; mahādrumaḥ kālahato 'śaner iva
variants.southern_text: giriṃ kuberasya gato 'thavālayaṃ; । sabhāṃ gato vā varuṇasya rājñaḥ । asaṃśayaṃ dāśarather vimokṣyase । mahādrumaḥ kālahato 'śaner iva ॥34॥

variants.critical_text: etasmāt kāraṇān na tāṃ ghatayāmi varānane vadhārhām avamānārhāṃ mithyāpravrajite ratām
variants.southern_text: etasmāt kāraṇān na tvāṃ ghātayāmi varānane । vadhārhām avamānārhāṃ mithyā pravrajane ratām ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: dvābhyām ūrdhvaṃ tu māsābhyāṃ bhartāraṃ mām anicchatīm mama tvāṃ prātarāśārtham ārabhante mahānase
variants.southern_text: dvābhyām ūrdhvaṃ tu māsābhyāṃ bhartāraṃ mām anicchatīm । mama tvāṃ prātarāśārthe sūdāścchetsyanti khaṇḍaśaḥ ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: tāṃ tarjyamānāṃ saṃprekṣya rākṣasendreṇa jānakīm devagandharvakanyās tā viṣedur vipulekṣaṇāḥ
variants.southern_text: tāṃ bhartsyamānām saṃprekṣya rākṣasendreṇa jānakīm । devagandharvakanyās tā viṣedur vikṛtekṣaṇāḥ ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: tābhir āśvāsitā sītā rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam uvācātmahitaṃ vākyaṃ vṛttaśauṇḍīryagarvitam
variants.southern_text: tābhir āśvāsitā sītā rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam । uvācātmahitaṃ vākyaṃ vṛttaśauṭīryagarvitam ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: sa tvam ikṣvākunāthaṃ vai kṣipann iha na lajjase cakṣuṣo viṣayaṃ tasya na tāvad upagacchasi
variants.southern_text: sa tvam ikṣvākunāthaṃ vai kṣipann iha na lajjase । cakṣuṣo viṣaye tasya na yāvad upagacchasi ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: ime te nayane krūre virūpe kṛṣṇapiṅgale kṣitau na patite kasmān mām anāryanirīkṣitaḥ

variants.southern_text: сalāgramukuṭaprāṃśuś citramālyānulepanaḥ । raktamālyāmbaradharas taptāṅgadavibhūṣaṇaḥ ॥25॥

variants.southern_text: ityuktvā maithilīṃ rājā rāvaṇaḥ śatrurāvaṇaḥ । saṃdiśya ca tataḥ sarvā rākṣasīr nirjagāma ha ॥1॥

variants.southern_text: niṣkrante rākṣasendre tu punar antaḥpuraṃ gate । rākṣasyo bhīmarūpās tāḥ sītāṃ samabhidudruvuḥ ॥2॥

variants.southern_text: yasya sūryo na tapati bhīto yasya sa mārutaḥ । na vāti smāyatāpāṅge kiṃ tvaṃ tasya na tiṣṭhase ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: chinnā bhinnā vibhaktā vā dīpte vāgnau pradīpitā rāvaṇaṃ nopatiṣṭheyaṃ kiṃ pralāpena vaś ciram

variants.critical_text: rākṣasānāṃ janasthāne sahasrāṇi caturdaśa yenaikena nirastāni sa māṃ kiṃ nābhipadyate

variants.critical_text: kiṃ nu tat kāraṇaṃ yena rāmo dṛḍhaparākramaḥ rakṣasāpahṛtāṃ bhāryām iṣṭāṃ nābhyavapadyate
variants.southern_text: kiṃ nu tat kāraṇaṃ yena rāmo dṛḍhaparākramaḥ । rakṣasāpahṛtāṃ bhāryām iṣṭāṃ yo nābhipadyate ॥16॥

variants.southern_text: yadi nāma sa śūro māṃ rāmo raktāntalocanaḥ । jānīyād vartamānāṃ yaṃ rākṣasasya niveśane ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: yadi kaś cit pradātā me viṣasyādya bhaved iha kṣipraṃ vaivasvataṃ devaṃ paśyeyaṃ patinā vinā
variants.southern_text: rāmaṃ raktāntanayanam apaśyantī suduḥkhitā । kṣipraṃ vaivasvataṃ devaṃ paśyeyaṃ patinā vinā ॥36॥

variants.critical_text: nājānāj jīvatīṃ rāmaḥ sa māṃ lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ jānantau tau na kuryātāṃ norvyāṃ hi mama mārgaṇam
variants.southern_text: nājānāj jīvatīṃ rāmaḥ sa māṃ lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ । jānantau tu na kuryātāṃ norvyāṃ hi mama mārgaṇam ॥37॥

variants.critical_text: dhanyā devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāś ca paramarṣayaḥ mama paśyanti ye nāthaṃ rāmaṃ rājīvalocanam
variants.southern_text: dhanyā devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāś ca paramarṣayaḥ । mama paśyanti ye vīraṃ rāmaṃ rājīvalocanam ॥39॥

variants.critical_text: dṛśyamāne bhavet prītaḥ sauhṛdaṃ nāsty apaśyataḥ nāśayanti kṛtaghrās tu na rāmo nāśayiṣyati
variants.southern_text: dṛśyamāne bhavet prītiḥ sauhṛdaṃ nāsty apaśyataḥ । nāśayanti kṛtaghnās tu na rāmo nāśayiṣyati ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: kiṃ nu me na guṇāḥ ke cit kiṃ vā bhāgya kṣayo hi me yāhaṃ sītā varārheṇa hīnā rāmeṇa bhāminī
variants.southern_text: kiṃ vā mama guṇāḥ ke cit kiṃ vā bhāgya kṣayo hi me । yāhaṃ sītā varārheṇa hīnā rāmeṇa bhāminī ॥42॥

variants.critical_text: atha vā nyastaśastrau tau vane mūlaphalāśanau bhrātarau hi nara śreṣṭhau carantau vanagocarau
variants.southern_text: atha vā nyastaśastrau tau vane mūlaphalāśanau । bhrātarau hi naraśreṣṭhau carantau vanagocarau ॥44॥

variants.critical_text: sāham evaṃgate kāle martum icchāmi sarvathā na ca me vihito mṛtyur asmin duḥkhe 'pi vartati
variants.southern_text: sāham evaṃgate kāle martum icchāmi sarvathā । na ca me vihito mṛtyur asmin duḥkhe 'tivartati ॥46॥

variants.critical_text: dhanyāḥ khalu mahātmāno munayaḥ satyasaṃmatāḥ jitātmāno mahābhāgā yeṣāṃ na staḥ priyāpriye
variants.southern_text: dhanyāḥ khalu mahātmāno munayaḥ satyasammatāḥ । jitātmāno mahābhāgā yeṣāṃ na staḥ priyāpriye ॥47॥

variants.critical_text: priyān na saṃbhaved duḥkham apriyād adhikaṃ bhayam tābhyāṃ hi ye viyujyante namas teṣāṃ mahātmanām
variants.southern_text: priyān na saṃbhaved duḥkham apriyād adhikaṃ bhavet । tābhyāṃ hi ye viyujyante namas teṣāṃ mahātmanām ॥48॥

variants.critical_text: sāhaṃ tyaktā priyeṇeha rāmeṇa viditātmanā prāṇāṃs tyakṣyāmi pāpasya rāvaṇasya gatā vaśam
variants.southern_text: sāhaṃ tyaktā priyeṇaiva rāmeṇa viditātmanā । prāṇāṃs tyakṣyāmi pāpasya rāvaṇasya gatā vaśam ॥49॥

variants.critical_text: ity uktāḥ sītayā ghoraṃ rākṣasyaḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ kāś cij jagmus tad ākhyātuṃ rāvaṇasya tarasvinaḥ
variants.southern_text: ity uktāḥ sītayā ghoraṃ rākṣasyaḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ । kāś cij jagmus tad ākhyātuṃ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ sītām upāgamya rākṣasyo ghoradarśanāḥ punaḥ paruṣam ekārtham anarthārtham athābruvan
variants.southern_text: tataḥ sītām upāgamya rākṣasyo bhīmadarśanāḥ । punaḥ paruṣam ekārtham anarthārtham athābruvan ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: hantedānīṃ tavānārye sīte pāpaviniścaye rākṣasyo bhakṣayiṣyanti māṃsam etad yathāsukham
variants.southern_text: adyedānīṃ tavānārye sīte pāpaviniścaye । rākṣasyo bhakṣayiṣyanti māṃsam etad yathāsukham ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: sītāṃ tābhir anāryābhir dṛṣṭvā saṃtarjitāṃ tadā rākṣasī trijaṭāvṛddhā śayānā vākyam abravīt
variants.southern_text: sītāṃ tābhir anāryābhir dṛṣṭvā saṃtarjitāṃ tadā । rākṣasī trijaṭā vṛddhā prabuddhā vākyam abravīt ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: kathayasva tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ svapne 'yaṃ kīdṛśo niśi
variants.southern_text: kathayasva tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ svapno 'yaṃ kīdṛśo niśi । tāsāṃ śrutvā tu vacanaṃ rākṣasīnāṃ mukhodgatam ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tābhyāṃ kumārābhyām āsthitaḥ sa gajottamaḥ sītayā ca viśālākṣyā laṅkāyā upari sthitaḥ
variants.southern_text: candrasūryau mayā dṛṣṭā pāṇibhyāṃ parimārjatī । tatas tābhyāṃ kumārābhyām āsthitaḥ sa gajottamaḥ । sītayā ca viśālākṣyā laṅkāyā upari sthitaḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: pāṇḍurarṣabhayuktena rathenāṣṭayujā svayam śuklamālyāmbaradharo lakṣmaṇena samāgataḥ
variants.southern_text: pāṇḍurarṣabhayuktena rathenāṣṭa yujā svayam । ihopayātaḥ kākutsthaḥ sītayā saha bhāryayā ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: pītva tailaṃ pranṛttāś ca prahasantyo mahāsvanāḥ laṅkāyāṃ bhasmarūkṣāyāṃ sarvā rākṣasayoṣitaḥ
variants.southern_text: pītva tailaṃ pramattāś ca prahasantyo mahāsvanāḥ । laṅkāyāṃ bhasmarūkṣāyāṃ sarvā rākṣasayoṣitaḥ ॥39॥

variants.critical_text: kumbhakarṇādayaś ceme sarve rākṣasapuṃgavāḥ raktaṃ nivasanaṃ gṛhya praviṣṭā gomayahrade
variants.southern_text: kumbhakarṇādayaś ceme sarve rākṣasapuṃgavāḥ । raktaṃ nivasanaṃ gṛhya praviṣṭā gomayahradam ॥40॥

variants.critical_text: apagacchata naśyadhvaṃ sītām āpnoti rāghavaḥ ghātayet paramāmarṣī sarvaiḥ sārdhaṃ hi rākṣasaiḥ
variants.southern_text: apagacchata naśyadhvaṃ sītām āpnoti rāghavaḥ । ghātayet paramāmarṣī yuṣmān sarvaṃ hi rākṣasaiḥ ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: tad alaṃ krūravākyair vaḥ sāntvam evābhidhīyatām abhiyācāma vaidehīm etad dhi mama rocate
variants.southern_text: tad alaṃ krūravākyaiś ca sāntvam evābhidhīyatām । abhiyācāma vaidehīm etaddhi mama rocate ॥43॥

variants.critical_text: bhartsitām api yācadhvaṃ rākṣasyaḥ kiṃ vivakṣayā rāghavād dhi bhayaṃ ghoraṃ rākṣasānām upasthitam
variants.southern_text: bhartsitām api yācadhvaṃ rākṣasyaḥ kiṃ vivakṣayā । rāghavāddhi bhayaṃ ghoraṃ rākṣasānām upasthitam ॥45॥

variants.critical_text: praṇipāta prasannā hi maithilī janakātmajā alam eṣā paritrātuṃ rākṣasyo mahato bhayāt
variants.southern_text: praṇipātaprasannā hi maithilī janakātmajā । alam eṣā paritrātuṃ rākṣasyo mahato bhayāt ॥46॥

variants.critical_text: api cāsyā viśālākṣyā na kiṃ cid upalakṣaye viruddham api cāṅgeṣu susūkṣmam api lakṣmaṇam
variants.southern_text: api cāsyā viśālākṣyā na kiṃ cid upalakṣaye । virūpam api cāṅgeṣu susūkṣmam api lakṣmaṇam ॥47॥

variants.critical_text: chāyā vaiguṇya mātraṃ tu śaṅke duḥkham upasthitam aduḥkhārhām imāṃ devīṃ vaihāyasam upasthitām
variants.southern_text: chāyāvaiguṇyamātraṃ tu śaṅke duḥkham upasthitam । aduḥkhārhām imāṃ devīṃ vaihāyasam upasthitām ॥48॥

variants.critical_text: īṣac ca hṛṣito vāsyā dakṣiṇāyā hy adakṣiṇaḥ akasmād eva vaidehyā bāhur ekaḥ prakampate
variants.southern_text: īṣaddhi hṛṣito vāsyā dakṣiṇāyā hy adakṣiṇaḥ । akasmād eva vaidehyā bāhur ekaḥ prakampate ॥51॥

variants.critical_text: kareṇuhastapratimaḥ savyaś corur anuttamaḥ vepan sūcayatīvāsyā rāghavaṃ purataḥ sthitam
variants.southern_text: kareṇuhastapratimaḥ savyaś corur anuttamaḥ । vepan kathayatīvāsyā rāghavaṃ purataḥ sthitam ॥52॥

variants.critical_text: pakṣī ca śākhā nilayaṃ praviṣṭaḥ; punaḥ punaś cottamasāntvavādī sukhāgatāṃ vācam udīrayāṇaḥ; punaḥ punaś codayatīva hṛṣṭaḥ
variants.southern_text: pakṣī ca śākhānilayaṃ praviṣṭaḥ । punaḥ punaś cottamasāntvavādī । sukhāgatāṃ vācam udīrayāṇaḥ । punaḥ punaś codayatīva hṛṣṭaḥ ॥53॥

variants.critical_text: sā rākṣasendrasya vaco niśamya; tad rāvaṇasyāpriyam apriyārtā sītā vitatrāsa yathā vanānte; siṃhābhipannā gajarājakanyā
variants.southern_text: sā rākṣasendrasya vaco niśamya । tad rāvaṇasyāpriyamapriyārtā । sītā vitatrāsa yathā vanānte । siṃhābhipannā gajarājakanyā ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: satyaṃ batedaṃ pravadanti loke; nākālamṛtyur bhavatīti santaḥ yatrāham evaṃ paribhartsyamānā; jīvāmi kiṃ cit kṣaṇam apy apuṇyā
variants.southern_text: satyaṃ batedaṃ pravadanti loke । nākālamṛtyur bhavatīti santaḥ । yatrāham evaṃ paribhartsyamānā; । jīvāmi yasmāt kṣaṇam apy apuṇyā ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: duḥkhaṃ batedaṃ mama duḥkhitāyā; māsau cirāyābhigamiṣyato dvau baddhasya vadhyasya yathā niśānte; rājāparādhād iva taskarasya
variants.southern_text: duḥkhaṃ batedaṃ nanu duḥkhitāyā । māsau cirāyābhigamiṣyato dvau । baddhasya vadhyasya yathā niśānte । rājoparodhād iva taskarasya ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: hā rāma hā lakṣmaṇa hā sumitre; hā rāma mātaḥ saha me jananyā eṣā vipadyāmy aham alpabhāgyā; mahārṇave naur iva mūḍha vātā
variants.southern_text: hā rāma hā lakṣmaṇa hā sumitre । hā rāmamātaḥ saha me jananyaḥ । eṣā vipadyāmy aham alpabhāgyā । mahārṇave naur iva mūḍhavātā ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: nūnaṃ sa kālo mṛgarūpadhārī; mām alpabhāgyāṃ lulubhe tadānīm yatrāryaputraṃ visasarja mūḍhā; rāmānujaṃ lakṣmaṇapūrvakaṃ ca
variants.southern_text: nūnaṃ sa kālo mṛgarūpadhārī । mām alpabhāgyāṃ lulubhe tadānīm । yatrāryaputrau visasarja mūḍhā । rāmānujaṃ lakṣmaṇapūrvajaṃ ca ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: hā rāma satyavrata dīrghavāho; hā pūrṇacandrapratimānavaktra hā jīvalokasya hitaḥ priyaś ca; vadhyāṃ na māṃ vetsi hi rākṣasānām
variants.southern_text: hā rāma satyavrata dīrghabāho । hā pūrṇacandrapratimānavaktra । hā jīvalokasya hitaḥ priyaś ca । vadhyāṃ na māṃ vetsi hi rākṣasānām ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: mogho hi dharmaś carito mamāyaṃ; tathaikapatnītvam idaṃ nirartham yā tvāṃ na paśyāmi kṛśā vivarṇā; hīnā tvayā saṃgamane nirāśā
variants.southern_text: mogho hi dharmaś carito mamāyaṃ । tathaikapalītvam idaṃ nirartham । yā tvāṃ na paśyāmi kṛśā vivarṇā । hīnā tvayā saṅgamane nirāśā ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: śokābhitaptā bahudhā vicintya; sītātha veṇyudgrathanaṃ gṛhītvā udbadhya veṇyudgrathanena śīghram; ahaṃ gamiṣyāmi yamasya mūlam
variants.southern_text: śokābhitaptā bahudhā vicintya; sītātha veṇīgrathanaṃ gṛhītvā । udbaddhya veṇyudgrathanena śīghram; ahaṃ gamiṣyāmi yamasya mūlam ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: upasthitā sā mṛdur sarvagātrī; śākhāṃ gṛhītvātha nagasya tasya tasyās tu rāmaṃ pravicintayantyā; rāmānujaṃ svaṃ ca kulaṃ śubhāṅgyāḥ
variants.southern_text: upasthitā sā mṛdusarvagātrī; śākhāṃ gṛhītvātha nagasya tasya । tasyās tu rāmaṃ pravicintayantyā; rāmānujaṃ svaṃ ca kulaṃ śubhāṅgyāḥ ॥19॥

variants.critical_text: śokānimittāni tadā bahūni; dhairyārjitāni pravarāṇi loke prādurnimittāni tadā babhūvuḥ; purāpi siddhāny upalakṣitāni
variants.southern_text: tasyā viśokāni tadā bahūni । dhairyārjitāni pravarāṇi loke । prādurnimittāni tadā babhūvuḥ । purāpi siddhāny upalakṣitāni ॥20॥

variants.critical_text: tathāgatāṃ tāṃ vyathitām aninditāṃ; vyapetaharṣāṃ paridīnamānasām śubhāṃ nimittāni śubhāni bhejire; naraṃ śriyā juṣṭam ivopajīvinaḥ
variants.southern_text: tathāgatāṃ tāṃ vyathitām aninditāṃ । vyatitaharṣāṃ paridīnamānasām । śubhāṃ nimittāni śubhāni bhejire । naraṃ śriyā juṣṭam ivopasevinaḥ ॥1॥
