variants.critical_text: tasyāḥ śubhaṃ vāmam arālapakṣma; rājīvṛtaṃ kṛṣṇaviśālaśuklam prāspandataikaṃ nayanaṃ sukeśyā; mīnāhataṃ padmam ivābhitāmram
variants.southern_text: tasyāḥ śubhaṃ vāmam arālapakṣmarājīvṛtaṃ kṛṣṇaviśālaśuklam । prāspandataikaṃ nayanaṃ sukeśyā mīnāhataṃ padmam ivābhitāmram ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: bhujaś ca cārvañcitapīnavṛttaḥ; parārdhya kālāgurucandanārhaḥ anuttamenādhyuṣitaḥ priyeṇa; cireṇa vāmaḥ samavepatāśu
variants.southern_text: bhujaś ca cārvañcitavṛttapīnaḥ । parārdhyakālāgurucandanārhaḥ । anuttamenādhyuṣitaḥ priyeṇa । cireṇa vāmaḥ samavepatāśu ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: gajendrahastapratimaś ca pīnas; tayor dvayoḥ saṃhatayoḥ sujātaḥ praspandamānaḥ punar ūrur asyā; rāmaṃ purastāt sthitam ācacakṣe
variants.southern_text: gajendrahastapratimaś ca pīnas । tayor dvayoḥ saṃhatayos sujātaḥ । praspandamānaḥ punar ūrur asyā । rāmaṃ purastāt sthitam ācacakṣe ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: śubhaṃ punar hemasamānavarṇam; īṣadrajodhvastam ivāmalākṣyāḥ vāsaḥ sthitāyāḥ śikharāgradantyāḥ; kiṃ cit parisraṃsata cārugātryāḥ
variants.southern_text: śubhaṃ punar hemasamānavarṇam । īṣadrajodhvastam ivātulākṣyāḥ । vāsaḥ sthitāyāḥ śikharāgradantyāḥ । kiṃ cit parisraṃsata cārugātryāḥ ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: etair nimittair aparaiś ca subhrūḥ; saṃbodhitā prāg api sādhusiddhaiḥ vātātapaklāntam iva pranaṣṭaṃ; varṣeṇa bījaṃ pratisaṃjaharṣa
variants.southern_text: etair nimittair aparaiś ca subhrūḥ । saṃcoditā prāg api sādhusiddhaiḥ । vātātapaklāntam iva pranaṣṭaṃ । varṣeṇa bījaṃ pratisaṃjaharṣa ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: tasyāḥ punar bimbaphalopamauṣṭhaṃ; svakṣibhrukeśāntam arālapakṣma vaktraṃ babhāse sitaśukladaṃṣṭraṃ; rāhor mukhāc candra iva pramuktaḥ
variants.southern_text: tasyāḥ punar bimbaphalopamoṣṭhaṃ । svakṣibhrukeśāntam arālapakṣma । vaktraṃ babhāse sitaśukladaṃṣṭraṃ । rāhor mukhāc candra iva pramuktaḥ ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: sā vītaśokā vyapanītatandrī; śāntajvarā harṣavibuddhasattvā aśobhatāryā vadanena śukle; śītānśunā rātrir ivoditena
variants.southern_text: sā vītaśokā vyapanītatandrā । śāntajvarā harṣavibuddhasattvā । aśobhatāryā vadanena śukle । śītāṃśunā rātrir ivoditena ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: hanumān api vikrāntaḥ sarvaṃ śuśrāva tattvataḥ sītāyās trijaṭāyāś ca rākṣasīnāṃ ca tarjanam
variants.southern_text: hanumān api vikrāntaḥ sarvaṃ śuśrāva tattvataḥ । sītāyās trijaṭāyāś ca rākṣasīnāṃ ca tarjitam ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: yāṃ kapīnāṃ sahasrāṇi subahūny ayutāni ca dikṣu sarvāsu mārgante seyam āsāditā mayā
variants.southern_text: yā kapīnāṃ sahasrāṇi subahūny ayutāni ca । dikṣu sarvāsu mārgante seyam āsāditā mayā ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: yadi hy aham imāṃ devīṃ śokopahatacetanām anāśvāsya gamiṣyāmi doṣavad gamanaṃ bhavet
variants.southern_text: yadi hy aham satīm enāṃ śokopahatacetanām । anāśvāsya gamiṣyāmi doṣavad gamanaṃ bhavet ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: gate hi mayi tatreyaṃ rājaputrī yaśasvinī paritrāṇam avindantī jānakī jīvitaṃ tyajet
variants.southern_text: gate hi mayi tatreyaṃ rājaputrī yaśasvinī । paritrāṇam apaśyantī jānakī jīvitaṃ tyajet ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: niśācarīṇāṃ pratyakṣam akṣamaṃ cābhibhāṣaṇam kathaṃ nu khalu kartavyam idaṃ kṛcchra gato hy aham
variants.southern_text: niśācarīṇāṃ pratyakṣam akṣamaṃ cābhibhāṣitam । kathaṃ nu khalu kartavyam idaṃ kṛcchragato hy aham ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: rāmaś ca yadi pṛcchen māṃ kiṃ māṃ sītābravīd vacaḥ kim ahaṃ taṃ pratibrūyām asaṃbhāṣya sumadhyamām
variants.southern_text: rāmas tu yadi pṛcchen māṃ kiṃ māṃ sītābravīd vacaḥ । kim ahaṃ taṃ pratibrūyām asaṃbhāṣya sumadhyamām ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: yadi ced yojayiṣyāmi bhartāraṃ rāmakāraṇāt vyartham āgamanaṃ tasya sasainyasya bhaviṣyati
variants.southern_text: yadi vodyojayiṣyāmi bhartāraṃ rāmakāraṇāt । vyartham āgamanaṃ tasya sasainyasya bhaviṣyati ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: antaraṃ tv aham āsādya rākṣasīnām iha sthitaḥ śanair āśvāsayiṣyāmi saṃtāpabahulām imām
variants.southern_text: antaraṃ tv aham āsādya rākṣasīnām iha sthitaḥ । śanair āśvāsayāmy adya saṃtāpabahulām imām ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: ahaṃ hy atitanuś caiva vanaraś ca viśeṣataḥ vācaṃ codāhariṣyāmi mānuṣīm iha saṃskṛtām
variants.southern_text: ahaṃ hy atitanuś caiva vānaraś ca viśeṣataḥ । vācaṃ codāhariṣyāmi mānuṣīm iha saṃskṛtām ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: seyam ālokya me rūpaṃ jānakī bhāṣitaṃ tathā rakṣobhis trāsitā pūrvaṃ bhūyas trāsaṃ gamiṣyati
variants.southern_text: seyam ālokya me rūpaṃ jānakī bhāṣitaṃ tathā । rakṣobhis trāsitā pūrvaṃ bhūyas trāsaṃ upaiṣyati ॥20॥

variants.critical_text: tato jātaparitrāsā śabdaṃ kuryān manasvinī jānamānā viśālākṣī rāvaṇaṃ kāmarūpiṇam
variants.southern_text: tato jātaparitrāsā śabdaṃ kuryān manasvinī । jānānā māṃ viśālākṣī rāvaṇaṃ kāmarūpiṇam ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: tato māṃ saṃparikṣipya sarvato vikṛtānanāḥ vadhe ca grahaṇe caiva kuryur yatnaṃ yathābalam
variants.southern_text: tato māṃ samparikṣipya sarvato vikṛtānanāḥ । vadhe ca grahaṇe caiva kuryur yatnaṃ mahābalāḥ ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: taṃ māṃ śākhāḥ praśākhāś ca skandhāṃś cottamaśākhinām dṛṣṭvā viparidhāvantaṃ bhaveyur bhayaśaṅkitāḥ
variants.southern_text: taṃ māṃ śākhāḥ praśākhāś ca skandhāṃś cottamaśākhinām । dṛṣṭvā ca paridhāvantaṃ bhaveyur pariśaṅkitāḥ ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: mama rūpaṃ ca saṃprekṣya vanaṃ vicarato mahat rākṣasyo bhayavitrastā bhaveyur vikṛtānanāḥ
variants.southern_text: mama rūpaṃ ca saṃprekṣya vane vicarato mahat । rākṣasyo bhayavitrastā bhaveyur vikṛtānanāḥ ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: te śūlaśaranistriṃśa vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ āpateyur vimarde 'smin vegenodvignakāriṇaḥ
variants.southern_text: te śūlaśaranistriṃśa vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ । āpateyur vimarde 'smin vegenodvignakāraṇāt ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: saṃkruddhas tais tu parito vidhaman rakṣasāṃ balam śaknuyaṃ na tu saṃprāptuṃ paraṃ pāraṃ mahodadheḥ
variants.southern_text: saṃruddhas tais tu parito vidhame rakṣasāṃ balam । śaknuyaṃ na tu samprāptuṃ paraṃ pāraṃ mahodadheḥ ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: māṃ vā gṛhṇīyur āplutya bahavaḥ śīghrakāriṇaḥ syād iyaṃ cāgṛhītārthā mama ca grahaṇaṃ bhavet
variants.southern_text: māṃ vā gṛhṇīyur āvṛttya bahavaḥ śīghrakāriṇaḥ । syād iyaṃ cāgṛhītārthā mama ca grahaṇaṃ bhavet ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: kāmaṃ hantuṃ samartho 'smi sahasrāṇy api rakṣasām na tu śakṣyāmi saṃprāptuṃ paraṃ pāraṃ mahodadheḥ
variants.southern_text: kāmaṃ hantuṃ samartho 'smi sahasrāṇy api rakṣasām । na tu śakṣyāmy ahaṃ prāptuṃ paraṃ pāraṃ mahodadheḥ ॥34॥

variants.critical_text: na vinaśyet kathaṃ kāryaṃ vaiklavyaṃ na kathaṃ bhavet laṅghanaṃ ca samudrasya kathaṃ nu na vṛthā bhavet
variants.southern_text: na vinaśyet kathaṃ kāryaṃ vaiklavyaṃ na kathaṃ mama । laṅghanaṃ ca samudrasya kathaṃ nu na vṛthā bhavet ॥39॥

variants.critical_text: rāmam akliṣṭakarmāṇaṃ svabandhum anukīrtayan nainām udvejayiṣyāmi tad bandhugatamānasām
variants.southern_text: rāmam akliṣṭakarmāṇaṃ subandhum anukīrtayan । nainām udvejayiṣyāmi tad bandhugatacetanām ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: śrāvayiṣyāmi sarvāṇi madhurāṃ prabruvan giram śraddhāsyati yathā hīyaṃ tathā sarvaṃ samādadhe
variants.southern_text: śrāvayiṣyāmi sarvāṇi madhurāṃ prabruvan giram । śraddhāsyati yathā sītā tathā sarvaṃ samādadhe ॥43॥

variants.critical_text: iti sa bahuvidhaṃ mahānubhāvo; jagatipateḥ pramadām avekṣamāṇaḥ madhuram avitathaṃ jagāda vākyaṃ; drumaviṭapāntaram āsthito hanūmān
variants.southern_text: iti sa bahuvidhaṃ mahānubhāvo । jagatipateḥ pramadām avekṣamāṇaḥ । madhuram avitathaṃ jagāda vākyaṃ । drumaviṭapāntaram āsthito hanuman ॥44॥

variants.critical_text: evaṃ bahuvidhāṃ cintāṃ cintayitva mahākapiḥ saṃśrave madhuraṃ vākyaṃ vaidehyā vyājahāra ha
variants.southern_text: evaṃ bahuvidhāṃ cintāṃ cintayitva mahāmatiḥ । saṃśrave madhuraṃ vākyaṃ vaidehyā vyājahāra ha ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: rājā daśaratho nāma rathakuñjaravājinām puṇyaśīlo mahākīrtir ṛjur āsīn mahāyaśāḥ
variants.southern_text: rājā daśaratho nāma rathakuñjaravājinām । puṇyaśīlo mahākīrtir ikṣvākūṇām mahāyaśāḥ ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: ahiṃsāratir akṣudro ghṛṇī satyaparākramaḥ mukhyaś cekṣvākuvaṃśasya lakṣmīvāṃl lakṣmivardhanaḥ
variants.southern_text: ahiṃsāratir akṣudro ghṛṇī satyaparākramaḥ । mukhyaś сekṣvākuvaṃśasya lakṣmīvāṃl lakṣmivardhanaḥ ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: tena tatra mahāraṇye mṛgayāṃ paridhāvatā janasthānavadhaṃ śrutvā hatau ca kharadūṣaṇau
variants.southern_text: tena tatra mahāraṇye mṛgayāṃ paridhāvatā । rākṣasā nihatāḥ śūrā bahavaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ sā vakrakeśāntā sukeśī keśasaṃvṛtam unnamya vadanaṃ bhīruḥ śiṃśapāvṛkṣam aikṣata
variants.southern_text: jānakī cāpi tac chrutvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatā । tataḥ sā vakrakeśāntā sukeśī keśasaṃvṛtam । unnamya vadanaṃ bhīruḥ śiṃśapām anvavaikṣata ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: sā tiryag ūrdhvaṃ ca tathāpy adhastān; nirīkṣamāṇā tam acintya buddhim dadarśa piṅgādhipater amātyaṃ; vātātmajaṃ sūryam ivodayastham
variants.southern_text: sā tiryagūrdhvaṃ ca tathā hyadhastān । nirīkṣamāṇā tam acintyabuddhim । dadarśa piṅgādhipater amātyaṃ । vātātmajaṃ sūryamivodayastham ॥19॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ śākhāntare līnaṃ dṛṣṭvā calitamānasā sā dadarśa kapiṃ tatra praśritaṃ priyavādinam
variants.southern_text: tataḥ śākhāntare līnaṃ dṛṣṭvā calitamānasā । veṣṭitārjunavastraṃ taṃ vidyutsaṃghātapiṅgalam ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: sā tu dṛṣṭvā hariśreṣṭhaṃ vinītavad upasthitam maithilī cintayām āsa svapno 'yam iti bhāminī
variants.southern_text: sātha dṛṣṭvā hariśreṣṭhaṃ vinītavad upasthitam । maithilī cintayām āsa svapno 'yam paraṃ gatā ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: sā taṃ samīkṣyaiva bhṛśaṃ visaṃjñā; gatāsukalpeva babhūva sītā cireṇa saṃjñāṃ pratilabhya caiva; vicintayām āsa viśālanetrā
variants.southern_text: sā taṃ samīkṣyaiva bhṛśaṃ vipannā । gatāsukalpeva babhūva sītā । cireṇa saṃjñāṃ pratilabhya caivaṃ । vicintayām āsa viśālanetrā ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: svapno 'pi nāyaṃ na hi me 'sti nidrā; śokena duḥkhena ca pīḍitāyāḥ sukhaṃ hi me nāsti yato 'smi hīnā; tenendupūrṇapratimānanena
variants.southern_text: svapno hi nāyaṃ na hi me 'sti nidrā । śokena duḥkhena ca pīḍitāyāḥ । sukhaṃ hi me nāsti yato vihīnā । tenendupūrṇapratimānanena ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: ahaṃ hi tasyādya mano bhavena; saṃpīḍitā tad gatasarvabhāvā vicintayantī satataṃ tam eva; tathaiva paśyāmi tathā śṛṇomi
variants.southern_text: ahaṃ hi tasyādya manobhavena । sampīḍitā tad gatasarvabhāvā । vicintayantī satataṃ tam eva । tathaiva paśyāmi tathā śṛṇomi ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: manorathaḥ syād iti cintayāmi; tathāpi buddhyā ca vitarkayāmi kiṃ kāraṇaṃ tasya hi nāsti rūpaṃ; suvyaktarūpaś ca vadaty ayaṃ mām
variants.southern_text: manorathaḥ syād iti cintayāmi । tathāpi buddhyāpi vitarkayāmi । kiṃ kāraṇaṃ tasya hi nāsti rūpaṃ । suvyaktarūpaś ca vadaty ayaṃ mām ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: kā nu padmapalāśākṣī kliṣṭakauśeyavāsinī drumasya śākhām ālambya tiṣṭhasi tvam aninditā
variants.southern_text: kā nu padmapalāśākṣi kliṣṭakauśeyavāsini । drumasya śākhām ālambya tiṣṭhasi tvam anindite ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: kiṃ nu candramasā hīnā patitā vibudhālayāt rohiṇī jyotiṣāṃ śreṣṭhā śreṣṭhā sarvaguṇānvitā
variants.southern_text: kiṃ nu candramasā hīnā patitā vibudhālayāt । rohiṇī jyotiṣāṃ śreṣṭhā śreṣṭhā sarvaguṇādhikā ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: kopād vā yadi vā mohād bhartāram asitekṣaṇā vasiṣṭhaṃ kopayitvā tvaṃ nāsi kalyāṇy arundhatī
variants.southern_text: kopād vā yadi vā mohād bhartāram asitekṣaṇe । vasiṣṭhaṃ kopayitvā tvaṃ vāsi kalyāṇy arundhatī ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: ko nau putraḥ pitā bhrāta bhartā vā te sumadhyame asmāl lokād amuṃ lokaṃ gataṃ tvam anuśocasi
variants.southern_text: ko nu putraḥ pitā bhrāta bhartā vā te sumadhyame । asmāl lokād amuṃ lokaṃ gataṃ tvam anuśocasi ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: vyañjanāni hi te yāni lakṣaṇāni ca lakṣaye mahiṣī bhūmipālasya rājakanyāsi me matā
variants.southern_text: vyañjanāni hi te yāni lakṣaṇāni ca lakṣaye । mahiṣī bhūmipālasya rājakanyā ca me matā ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: rāvaṇena janasthānād balād apahṛtā yadi sītā tvam asi bhadraṃ te tan mamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ
variants.southern_text: rāvaṇena janasthānād balāt pramathitā yadi । sītā tvam asi bhadraṃ te tan mamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: duhitā janakasyāhaṃ vaidehasya mahātmanaḥ sītā ca nāma nāmnāhaṃ bhāryā rāmasya dhīmataḥ
variants.southern_text: duhitā janakasyāhaṃ vaidehasya mahātmanaḥ । sīteti nāmnā coktāhaṃ bhāryā rāmasya dhīmataḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: tatas trayodaśe varṣe rājyenekṣvākunandanam abhiṣecayituṃ rājā sopādhyāyaḥ pracakrame
variants.southern_text: tatas trayodaśe varṣe rājye cekṣvākunandanam । abhiṣecayituṃ rājā sopādhyāyaḥ pracakrame ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: tasmin saṃbhriyamāṇe tu rāghavasyābhiṣecane kaikeyī nāma bhartāraṃ devī vacanam abravīt
variants.southern_text: tasmin sambhriyamāṇe tu rāghavasyābhiṣecane । kaikeyī nāma bhartāraṃ idaṃ vacanam abravīt ॥19॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tu sthaviro rājā satyadharme vyavasthitaḥ jyeṣṭhaṃ yaśasvinaṃ putraṃ rudan rājyam ayācata
variants.southern_text: tatas taṃ sthaviro rājā satyadharme vyavasthitaḥ । jyeṣṭhaṃ yaśasvinaṃ putraṃ rudan rājyam ayācata ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: dadyān na pratigṛhṇīyān na brūyat kiṃ cid apriyam api jīvitahetor hi rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ
variants.southern_text: dadyān na pratigṛhṇīyāt satyaṃ brūyan na cānṛtam । api jīvitahetor hi rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: prāg eva tu mahābhāgaḥ saumitrir mitranandanaḥ pūrvajasyānuyātrārthe drumacīrair alaṃkṛtaḥ
variants.southern_text: prāg eva tu mahābhāgaḥ saumitrir mitranandanaḥ । pūrvajasyānuyātrārthe kuśacīrair alaṃkṛtaḥ ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: te vayaṃ bhartur ādeśaṃ bahu mānyadṛḍhavratāḥ praviṣṭāḥ sma purād dṛṣṭaṃ vanaṃ gambhīradarśanam
variants.southern_text: te vayaṃ bhartur ādeśaṃ bahumānya dṛḍhavratāḥ । praviṣṭāḥ sma purādṛṣṭaṃ vanaṃ gambhīradarśanam ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: tasyās tadvacanaṃ śrutvā hanūmān hariyūthapaḥ duḥkhād duḥkhābhibhūtāyāḥ sāntam uttaram abravīt
variants.southern_text: tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā hanūmān haripuṃgavaḥ । duḥkhād duḥkhābhibhūtāyāḥ sāntvam uttaram abravīt ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: ahaṃ rāmasya saṃdeśād devi dūtas tavāgataḥ vaidehi kuśalī rāmas tvāṃ ca kauśalam abravīt
variants.southern_text: ahaṃ rāmasya saṃdeśād devi dūtas tavāgataḥ । vaidehi kuśalī rāmaḥ sa tvāṃ kauśalam abravīt ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: yo brāhmam astraṃ vedāṃś ca veda vedavidāṃ varaḥ sa tvāṃ dāśarathī rāmo devi kauśalam abravīt
variants.southern_text: yo brāhmam astraṃś ca veda vedavidāṃ varaḥ । sa tvāṃ dāśarathī rāmo devi kauśalam abravīt ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: lakṣmaṇaś ca mahātejā bhartus te 'nucaraḥ priyaḥ kṛtavāñ śokasaṃtaptaḥ śirasā te 'bhivādanam
variants.southern_text: lakṣmaṇaś ca mahātejā bhartus te 'nucaraḥ priyaḥ । kṛtavāñ chokasaṃtaptaḥ śirasā te 'bhivādanam ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: kalyāṇī bata gatheyaṃ laukikī pratibhāti me ehi jīvantam ānado naraṃ varṣaśatād api
variants.southern_text: kalyāṇī bata gātheyaṃ laukikī pratibhāti mā । eti jīvantam ānando naraṃ varṣaśatād api ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: tasyās tadvacanaṃ śrutvā hanūmān hariyūthapaḥ sītāyāḥ śokadīnāyāḥ samīpam upacakrame
variants.southern_text: tasyās tadvacanaṃ śrutvā hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ । sītāyāḥ śokataptāyāḥ samīpam upacakrame ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: tām aśokasya śākhāṃ sā vimuktvā śokakarśitā tasyām evānavadyāṅgī dharaṇyāṃ samupāviśat
variants.southern_text: tām aśokasya śākhāṃ tu vimuktvā śokakarśitā । tasyām evānavadyāṅgī dharaṇyāṃ samupāviśat ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: svaṃ parityajya rūpaṃ yaḥ parivrājakarūpadhṛt janasthāne mayā dṛṣṭas tvaṃ sa evāsi rāvaṇaḥ
variants.southern_text: svaṃ parityajya rūpaṃ yaḥ parivrājakarūpadhṛt । janasthāne mayā dṛṣṭas tvaṃ sa eva hi rāvaṇaḥ ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: yadi rāmasya dūtas tvam āgato bhadram astu te pṛcchāmi tvāṃ hariśreṣṭha priyā rāma kathā hi me
variants.southern_text: yadi rāmasya dūtas tvam āgato bhadram astu te । pṛcchāmi tvāṃ hariśreṣṭha priyā rāmakathā hi me ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: ity evaṃ bahudhā sītā saṃpradhārya balābalam rakṣasāṃ kāmarūpatvān mene taṃ rākṣasādhipam
variants.southern_text: ity evaṃ bahudhā sītā sampradhārya balābalam । rakṣasāṃ kāmarūpatvān mene taṃ rākṣasādhipam ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: sītāyāś cintitaṃ buddhvā hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ śrotrānukūlair vacanais tadā tāṃ saṃpraharṣayat
variants.southern_text: sītāyā niścitaṃ buddhvā hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ । śrotrānukūlair vacanais tadā tāṃ sampraharṣayat ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: rūpavān subhagaḥ śrīmān kandarpa iva mūrtimān sthānakrodhaprahartā ca śreṣṭho loke mahārathaḥ
variants.southern_text: rūpavān subhagaḥ śrīmān kandarpa iva mūrtimān । sthānakrodhe prahartā ca śreṣṭho loke mahārathaḥ ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: nāham asmi tathā devi yathā mām avagacchasi viśaṅkā tyajyatām eṣā śraddhatsva vadato mama
variants.southern_text: tvāṃ draṣṭum upayāto 'haṃ samāśritya parākramam । nāham asmi tathā devi yathā mām avagacchasi । viśaṅkā tyajyatām eṣā śraddhatsva vadato mama ॥40॥

variants.critical_text: tāṃ tu rāma kathāṃ śrutvā vaidehī vānararṣabhāt uvāca vacanaṃ sāntvam idaṃ madhurayā girā
variants.southern_text: tāṃ tu rāmakathāṃ śrutvā vaidehī vānararṣabhāt । uvāca vacanaṃ sāntvam idaṃ madhurayā girā ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: yāni rāmasya liṅgāni lakṣmaṇasya ca vānara tāni bhūyaḥ samācakṣva na māṃ śokaḥ samāviśet
variants.southern_text: yāni rāmasya cihnāni lakṣmaṇasya ca vānara । tāni bhūyaḥ samācakṣva na māṃ śokaḥ samāviśet ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: kīdṛśaṃ tasya saṃsthānaṃ rūpaṃ rāmasya kīdṛśam katham ūrū kathaṃ bāhū lakṣmaṇasya ca śaṃsa me
variants.southern_text: kīdṛśaṃ tasya saṃsthānaṃ rūpaṃ tasya ca kīdṛśam । katham ūrū kathaṃ bāhū lakṣmaṇasya ca śaṃsa me ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: rāmaḥ kamalapatrākṣaḥ sarvabhūtamanoharaḥ rūpadākṣiṇyasaṃpannaḥ prasūto janakātmaje
variants.southern_text: rāmaḥ kamalapatrākṣaḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanaḥ । rūpadākṣiṇyasaṃpannaḥ prasūto janakātmaje ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: rājavidyāvinītaś ca brāhmaṇānām upāsitā śrutavāñ śīlasaṃpanno vinītaś ca paraṃtapaḥ
variants.southern_text: rājanītyāṃ vinītaś ca brāhmaṇānām upāsakaḥ । jñānavāñ śīlasaṃpanno vinītaś ca paraṃtapaḥ ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: vipulāṃso mahābāhuḥ kambugrīvaḥ śubhānanaḥ gūḍhajatruḥ sutāmrākṣo rāmo devi janaiḥ śrutaḥ
variants.southern_text: vipulāṃso mahābāhuḥ kambugrīvaḥ śubhānanaḥ । gūḍhajatruḥ sutāmrākṣo rāmo nāma janaiḥ śrutaḥ ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: dundubhisvananirghoṣaḥ snigdhavarṇaḥ pratāpavān samaḥ samavibhaktāṅgo varṇaṃ śyāmaṃ samāśritaḥ
variants.southern_text: dundubhisvananirghoṣaḥ snigdhavarṇaḥ pratāpavān । samaś ca suvibhaktāṅgo varṇaṃ śyāmaṃ samāśritaḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: tristhiras tripralambaś ca trisamas triṣu connataḥ trivalīvāṃs tryavaṇataś caturvyaṅgas triśīrṣavān
variants.southern_text: tristhiras tripralambaś ca trisamas triṣu connataḥ । tritāmrastriṣu ca snigdho gambhirastriṣu nityaśaḥ ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: satyadharmaparaḥ śrīmān saṃgrahānugrahe rataḥ deśakālavibhāgajñaḥ sarvalokapriyaṃvadaḥ
variants.southern_text: satyadharmarataḥ śrīmān saṃgrahānugrahe rataḥ । deśakālavibhāgajñaḥ sarvalokapriyaṃvadaḥ ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: bhrātā ca tasya dvaimātraḥ saumitrir aparājitaḥ anurāgeṇa rūpeṇa guṇaiś caiva tathāvidhaḥ
variants.southern_text: bhrātā cāsya ca vaimātraḥ saumitrir amitaprabhaḥ । anurāgeṇa rūpeṇa guṇaiś cāpi tathāvidhaḥ ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: paśyatas tasyā rudatas tāmyataś ca punaḥ punaḥ prādīpayan dāśarathes tāni śokahutāśanam
variants.southern_text: prādīpayan dāśarathes tāni śokahutāśanam ॥42॥

variants.critical_text: tāni dṛṣṭvā mahārhāṇi darśayitvā muhur muhuḥ rāghavaḥ sahasaumitriḥ sugrīve sa nyavedayat
variants.southern_text: tāni dṛṣṭvā mahā rhāṇi darśayitvā muhur muhuḥ । rāghavaḥ sahasaumitriḥ sugrīve saṃnyaveśayat ॥44॥

variants.critical_text: tvatkṛte tam anidrā ca śokaś cintā ca rāghavam tāpayanti mahātmānam agnyagāram ivāgnayaḥ
variants.southern_text: tvatkṛte tam anidrā ca śokaścintā ca rāghavam । tāpayanti mahātmānam agnyagāram ivāgnayaḥ ॥46॥

variants.critical_text: tavādarśanaśokena rāghavaḥ pravicālyate mahatā bhūmikampena mahān iva śiloccayaḥ
variants.southern_text: tavādarśanaśokena rāghavaḥ paricālyate । mahatā bhūmikampena mahān iva śiloccayaḥ ॥47॥

variants.critical_text: kānānāni suramyāṇi nadīprasravaṇāni ca caran na ratim āpnoti tvam apaśyan nṛpātmaje
variants.southern_text: kānānāni suramyāṇi nadīprasravaṇāni ca । caran na ratim āpnoti tvām apaśyan nṛpātmaje ॥48॥

variants.critical_text: sahitau rāmasugrīvāv ubhāv akurutāṃ tadā samayaṃ vālinaṃ hantuṃ tava cānveṣaṇaṃ tathā
variants.southern_text: sahitau rāmasugrīvāv ubhāv akurutāṃ tadā । samayaṃ vālinaṃ hantuṃ tava cānveṣaṇaṃ prati ॥50॥

variants.critical_text: rāmasugrīvayor aikyaṃ devy evaṃ samajāyata hanūmantaṃ ca māṃ viddhi tayor dūtam ihāgatam
variants.southern_text: rāmasugrīvayor aikyaṃ devy evaṃ samajāyata । hanūmantaṃ ca māṃ viddhi tayor dūtam upāgatam ॥53॥

variants.critical_text: svarājyaṃ prāpya sugrīvaḥ samanīya mahāharīn tvadarthaṃ preṣayām āsa diśo daśa mahābalān
variants.southern_text: svaṃ rājyaṃ prāpya sugrīvaḥ svān ānīya mahākapīn । tvadarthaṃ preṣayām āsa diśo daśa mahābalān ॥54॥

variants.critical_text: te vayaṃ kāryanairāśyāt kālasyātikrameṇa ca bhayāc ca kapirājasya prāṇāṃs tyaktuṃ vyavasthitāḥ
variants.southern_text: te vayaṃ kāryanairāśyāt kālasyātikrameṇa ca । bhayāc ca kapirājasya prāṇāṃs tyaktuṃ upasthitāḥ ॥59॥

variants.critical_text: vicitya vanadurgāṇi giriprasravaṇāni ca anāsādya padaṃ devyāḥ prāṇāṃs tyaktuṃ vyavasthitāḥ
variants.southern_text: vicitya giridurgāṇi nadīprasravaṇāni ca । anāsādya padaṃ devyāḥ prāṇāṃs tyaktuṃ vyavasthitāḥ ॥60॥

variants.critical_text: sa ca devarṣibhir dṛṣṭaḥ pitā mama mahākapiḥ tīrthe nadīpateḥ puṇye śambasādanam uddharat
variants.southern_text: tato gacchati gokarṇaṃ parvataṃ kesarī hariḥ । sa ca devarṣibhir diṣṭaḥ pitā mama mahākapiḥ । tīrthe nadīpateḥ puṇye śambasādanam uddharat ॥82॥

variants.critical_text: evaṃ viśvāsitā sītā hetubhiḥ śokakarśitā upapannair abhijñānair dūtaṃ tam avagacchati
variants.southern_text: evaṃ viśvāsitā sītā hetu bhiḥ śokakarśitā । upapannair abhijñānair dūtaṃ tam avagacchati ॥85॥

variants.critical_text: cāru tac cānanaṃ tasyās tāmraśuklāyatekṣaṇam aśobhata viśālākṣyā rāhumukta ivoḍurāṭ
variants.southern_text: cāru tad vadanaṃ tasyās tāmraśuklāyatekṣaṇam । aśobhata viśālākṣyā rāhumukta ivoḍurāṭ ॥87॥

variants.critical_text: athovāca hanūmāṃs tām uttaraṃ priyadarśanām
variants.southern_text: hanūmantaṃ kapiṃ vyaktaṃ manyate nānyatheti sā । athovāca hanūmāṃs tām uttaraṃ priyadarśanām ॥88॥

variants.critical_text: bhūya eva mahātejā hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ abravīt praśritaṃ vākyaṃ sītāpratyayakāraṇāt
variants.southern_text: bhūya eva mahātejā hanūmān pavanātmajaḥ । abravīt praśritaṃ vākyaṃ sītāpratyayakāraṇāt ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: gṛhītvā prekṣamāṇā sā bhartuḥ karavibhūṣaṇam bhartāram iva saṃprāptā jānakī muditābhavat
variants.southern_text: gṛhītvā prekṣamāṇā sā bhartuḥ karavibhūṣaṇam । bhartāram iva saṃprāptaṃ jānakī muditābhavat ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ sā hrīmatī bālā bhartuḥ saṃdeśaharṣitā parituṭṣā priyaṃ śrutvā prāśaṃsata mahākapim
variants.southern_text: tataḥ sā hrīmatī bālā bhartuḥ saṃdeśaharṣitā । parituṣṭā priyaṃ śrutvā praśaśaṃsa mahākapim ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: na hi tvāṃ prākṛtaṃ manye vanaraṃ vanararṣabha yasya te nāsti saṃtrāso rāvaṇān nāpi saṃbhramaḥ
variants.southern_text: na hi tvāṃ prākṛtaṃ manye vanaraṃ vanararṣabha । yasya te nāsti saṃtrāso rāvaṇād api saṃbhramaḥ ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: diṣṭyā ca kuśalī rāmo dharmātmā dharmavatsalaḥ lakṣmaṇaś ca mahātejāḥ sumitrānandavardhanaḥ
variants.southern_text: diṣṭyā ca kuśalī rāmo dharmātmā satyasaṃgaraḥ । lakṣmaṇaś ca mahātejāḥ sumitrānandavardhanaḥ ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: kuśalī yadi kākutsthaḥ kiṃ nu sāgaramekhalām mahīṃ dahati kopena yugāntāgnir ivotthitaḥ
variants.southern_text: kuśalī yadi kākutsthaḥ kiṃ na sāgaramekhalām । mahīṃ dahati kopena yugāntāgnir ivotthitaḥ ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: kaccic ca vyathate rāmaḥ kaccin na paripatyate uttarāṇi ca kāryāṇi kurute puruṣottamaḥ
variants.southern_text: kaccin na vyathate rāmaḥ kaccin na paripatyate । uttarāṇi ca kāryāṇi kurute puruṣottamaḥ ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: kaccin na dīnaḥ saṃbhrāntaḥ kāryeṣu ca na muhyati kaccin puruṣakāryāṇi kurute nṛpateḥ sutaḥ
variants.southern_text: kaccin na dīnaḥ saṃbhrāntaḥ kāryeṣu ca na muhyati । kaccit puruṣakāryāṇi kurute nṛpateḥ sutaḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: kaccin na vigatasneho vivāsān mayi rāghavaḥ kaccin māṃ vyasanād asmān mokṣayiṣyati vānaraḥ
variants.southern_text: kaccin na vigatasneho vivāsān mayi rāghavaḥ । kaccin māṃ vyasanād asmān mokṣayiṣyati rāghavaḥ ॥20॥

variants.critical_text: kaccid akṣāuhiṇīṃ bhīmāṃ bharato bhrātṛvatsalaḥ dhvajinīṃ mantribhir guptāṃ preṣayiṣyati matkṛte
variants.southern_text: kaccid akṣauhiṇīṃ bhīmāṃ bharato bhrātṛvatsalaḥ । dhvajinīṃ mantribhir guptāṃ preṣayiṣyati matkṛte ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: dharmāpadeśāt tyajataś ca rājyāṃ; māṃ cāpy araṇyaṃ nayataḥ padātim nāsīd vyathā yasya na bhīr na śokaḥ; kaccit sa dhairyaṃ hṛdaye karoti
variants.southern_text: dharmāpadeśāt tyajataḥ svarājyāṃ । māṃ cāpy araṇyaṃ nayataḥ padāteḥ । nāsīd yathā yasya na bhīr na śokaḥ । kaccit sa dhairyaṃ hṛdaye karoti ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: na cāsya mātā na pitā na cānyaḥ; snehād viśiṣṭo 'sti mayā samo vā tāvad dhy ahaṃ dūtajijīviṣeyaṃ; yāvat pravṛttiṃ śṛṇuyāṃ priyasya
variants.southern_text: na cāsya mātā na pitā na cānyaḥ । snehād viśiṣṭo 'sti mayā samo vā । tāvad dhy ahaṃ dūta jijīviṣeyaṃ । yāvat pravṛttiṃ śṛṇuyāṃ priyasya ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: na tvām ihasthāṃ jānīte rāmaḥ kamalalocanaḥ śrutvaiva tu vaco mahyaṃ kṣipram eṣyati rāghavaḥ
variants.southern_text: na tvām ihasthāṃ jānīte rāmaḥ kamalalocanaḥ । tena tvāṃ nānayatyāśu śacīmiva purandaraḥ ॥33॥

variants.critical_text: tavādarśanajenārye śokena sa pariplutaḥ na śarma labhate rāmaḥ siṃhārdita iva dvipaḥ
variants.southern_text: tavādarśanajenārye śokena sa paripūritaḥ । na śarma labhate rāmaḥ siṃhārdita iva dvipaḥ ॥37॥

variants.critical_text: dardareṇa ca te devi śape mūlaphalena ca malayena ca vindhyena meruṇā mandareṇa ca
variants.southern_text: mandareṇa ca te devi śape mūlaphalena ca । malayena ca vindhyena meruṇā dardureṇa ca ॥38॥

variants.critical_text: kṣipraṃ drakṣyasi vaidehi rāmaṃ prasravaṇe girau śatakratum ivāsīnaṃ nākapṛṣṭhasya mūrdhani
variants.southern_text: kṣipraṃ drakṣyasi vaidehi rāmaṃ prasravaṇe girau । śatakratum ivāsīnaṃ nāgapṛṣṭhasya mūrdhani ॥40॥

variants.critical_text: na māṃsaṃ rāghavo bhuṅkte na cāpi madhusevate vanyaṃ suvihitaṃ nityaṃ bhaktam aśnāti pañcamam
variants.southern_text: na māṃsaṃ rāghavo bhuṅkte na cāpi madhu sevate । vanyaṃ suvihitaṃ nityaṃ bhaktam aśnāti pañcamam ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: sītā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pūrṇacandranibhānanā hanūmantam uvācedaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ vacaḥ
variants.southern_text: sā sītā vacanaṃ śrutvā pūrṇacandranibhānanā । hanūmantam uvācedaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ vacaḥ ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: amṛtaṃ viṣasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ tvayā vānarabhāṣitam yac ca nānyamanā rāmo yac ca śokaparāyaṇaḥ
variants.southern_text: amṛtaṃ viṣasampṛktaṃ tvayā vānara bhāṣitam । yac ca nānyamanā rāmo yac ca śokaparāyaṇaḥ ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: śokasyāsya kadā pāraṃ rāghavo 'dhigamiṣyati plavamānaḥ pariśrānto hatanauḥ sāgare yathā
variants.southern_text: śokasyāsya kathaṃ pāraṃ rāghavo 'dhigamiṣyati । plavamānaḥ parikrānto hatanauḥ sāgare yathā ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: rākṣasānāṃ kṣayaṃ kṛtvā sūdayitvā ca rāvaṇam laṅkām unmūlitāṃ kṛtvā kadā drakṣyati māṃ patiḥ
variants.southern_text: rākṣasānāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā sūdayitvā ca rāvaṇam । laṅkām unmathitāṃ kṛtvā kadā drakṣyati māṃ patiḥ ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: avindhyo nāma medhāvī vidvān rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ dhṛtimāñ śīlavān vṛddho rāvaṇasya susaṃmataḥ
variants.southern_text: avindhyo nāma medhāvī vidvān rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ । dhṛtimāñ сhīlavān vṛddho rāvaṇasya susammataḥ ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: rāmāt kṣayam anuprāptaṃ rakṣasāṃ pratyacodayat na ca tasyāpi duṣṭātmā śṛṇoti vacanaṃ hitam
variants.southern_text: rāmāt kṣayam anuprāptaṃ rakṣasāṃ pratyacodayat । na ca tasya sa duṣṭātmā śṛṇoti vacanaṃ hitam ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: āśaṃseti hariśreṣṭha kṣipraṃ māṃ prāpsyate patiḥ antarātmā hi me śuddhas tasmiṃś ca bahavo guṇāḥ
variants.southern_text: āśaṃseyaṃ hariśreṣṭha kṣipraṃ māṃ prāpsyate patiḥ । antarātmā hi me śuddhas tasmiṃś ca bahavo guṇāḥ ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: utsāhaḥ pauruṣaṃ sattvam ānṛśaṃsyaṃ kṛtajñatā vikramaś ca prabhāvaś ca santi vānararāghave
variants.southern_text: utsāhaḥ pauruṣaṃ sattvam ānṛśaṃsyaṃ kṛtajñatā । vikramaś ca prabhāvaś ca santi vānara rāghave ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: caturdaśasahasrāṇi rākṣasānāṃ jaghāna yaḥ janasthāne vinā bhrātrā śatruḥ kas tasya nodvijet
variants.southern_text: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rākṣasānāṃ jaghāna yaḥ । janasthāne vinā bhrātrā śatruḥ kas tasya nodvijet ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: śarajālāṃśumāñ śūraḥ kape rāmadivākaraḥ śatrurakṣomayaṃ toyam upaśoṣaṃ nayiṣyati
variants.southern_text: śarajālāṃśumāñ chūraḥ kape rāmadivākaraḥ । śatrurakṣomayaṃ toyam upaśoṣaṃ nayiṣyati ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: śrutvaiva tu vaco mahyaṃ kṣipram eṣyati rāghavaḥ camūṃ prakarṣan mahatīṃ haryṛkṣagaṇasaṃkulām
variants.southern_text: śrutvaiva ca vaco mahyaṃ kṣipram eṣyati rāghavaḥ । camūṃ prakarṣan mahatīṃ haryṛkṣagaṇasaṃkulām ॥20॥

variants.critical_text: atha vā mocayiṣyāmi tām adyaiva hi rākṣasāt asmād duḥkhād upāroha mama pṛṣṭham anindite
variants.southern_text: athavā mocayiṣyāmi tvām adyaiva sa rākṣasāt । asmād duḥkhād upāroha mama pṛṣṭham anindite ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: drakṣyasy adyaiva vaidehi rāghavaṃ sahalakṣmaṇam vyavasāya samāyuktaṃ viṣṇuṃ daityavadhe yathā
variants.southern_text: drakṣyasy adyaiva vaidehi rāghavaṃ sahalakṣmaṇam । vyavasāyasamāyuktaṃ viṣṇuṃ daityavadhe yathā ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: kathayantīva candreṇa sūryeṇeva suvarcalā matpṛṣṭham adhiruhya tvaṃ tarākāśamahārṇavam
variants.southern_text: kathayantīva śāśiṇā saṃgamiṣyasi rohiṇī । matpṛṣṭham adhiroha tvaṃ tarākāśaṃ mahārṇavam ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: na hi me saṃprayātasya tvām ito nayato 'ṅgane anugantuṃ gatiṃ śaktāḥ sarve laṅkānivāsinaḥ
variants.southern_text: na hi me samprayātasya tvām ito nayato 'ṅgane । anugantuṃ gatiṃ śaktāḥ sarve laṅkānivāsinaḥ ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: hanūman dūram adhvanaṃ kathaṃ māṃ voḍhum icchasi tad eva khalu te manye kapitvaṃ hariyūthapa
variants.southern_text: hanūman dūram adhvanaṃ kathaṃ māṃ netum icchasi । tad eva khalu te manye kapitvaṃ hariyūthapa ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: kathaṃ vālpaśarīras tvaṃ mām ito netum icchasi sakāśaṃ mānavendrasya bhartur me plavagarṣabha
variants.southern_text: kathaṃ cālpaśarīras tvaṃ mām ito netum icchasi । sakāśaṃ mānavendrasya bhartur me plavagarṣabha ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: sītāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ cintayām āsa lakṣmīvān navaṃ paribhavaṃ kṛtam
variants.southern_text: sītāyās tu vacaḥ śrutvā hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ । cintayām āsa lakṣmīvān navaṃ paribhavaṃ kṛtam ॥33॥

variants.critical_text: iti saṃcintya hanumāṃs tadā plavagasattamaḥ darśayām āsa vaidehyāḥ svarūpam arimardanaḥ
variants.southern_text: iti saṃcintya hanumāṃs tadā plavagasattamaḥ । darśayām āsa sītāyāḥ svarūpam arimardanaḥ ॥35॥

variants.critical_text: tava sattvaṃ balaṃ caiva vijānāmi mahākape vāyor iva gatiṃ cāpi tejaś cāgnir ivādbhutam
variants.southern_text: tava sattvaṃ balaṃ caiva vijānāmi mahākape । vāyor iva gatiś cāpi tejaś cāgnir ivādbhutam ॥42॥

variants.critical_text: prākṛto 'nyaḥ kathaṃ cemāṃ bhūmim āgantum arhati udadher aprameyasya pāraṃ vānarapuṃgava
variants.southern_text: prākṛto 'nyaḥ kathaṃ cemāṃ bhūmim āgantum arhati । udadher aprameyasya pāraṃ vānarayūthapa ॥43॥

variants.critical_text: jānāmi gamane śaktiṃ nayane cāpi te mama avaśyaṃ sāmpradhāryāśu kāryasiddhir ihātmanaḥ
variants.southern_text: jānāmi gamane śaktiṃ nayane cāpi te mama । avaśyaṃ sāmpradhāryāśu kāryasiddhir ivātmanaḥ ॥44॥

variants.critical_text: patitā sāgare cāhaṃ timinakrajhaṣākule bhayeyam āśu vivaśā yādasām annam uttamam
variants.southern_text: patitā sāgare cāhaṃ timinakrajhaṣākule । bhaveyam āśu vivaśā yādasām annam uttamam ॥47॥

variants.critical_text: na ca śakṣye tvayā sārdhaṃ gantuṃ śatruvināśana kalatravati saṃdehas tvayy api syād asaṃśayam
variants.southern_text: na ca śakṣye tvayā sārdhaṃ gantuṃ śatruvināśana । kalatravati saṃdehas tvayi syād apy asaṃśayam ॥48॥

variants.critical_text: tais tvaṃ parivṛtaḥ śūraiḥ śūlam udgara pāṇibhiḥ bhaves tvaṃ saṃśayaṃ prāpto mayā vīra kalatravān
variants.southern_text: tais tvaṃ parivṛtaḥ śūraiḥ śūlamudgarapāṇibhiḥ । bhaves tvaṃ saṃśayaṃ prāpto mayā vīra kalatravān ॥50॥

variants.critical_text: atha vādāya rakṣāṃsi nyasyeyuḥ saṃvṛte hi mām yatra te nābhijānīyur harayo nāpi rāghavaḥ
variants.southern_text: athavādāya rakṣāṃsi nyaseyuḥ saṃvṛte hi mām । yatra te nābhijānīyur harayo nāpi rāghavaḥ ॥58॥

variants.critical_text: mayi jīvitam āyattaṃ rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ bhrātṝṇāṃ ca mahābāho tava rājakulasya ca
variants.southern_text: mayi jīvitam āyattaṃ rāghavasyāmitaujasaḥ । bhrātṝṇāṃ ca mahābāho tava rājakulasya ca ॥60॥

variants.critical_text: tau nirāśau madarthe tu śokasaṃtāpakarśitau saha sarvarkṣaharibhis tyakṣyataḥ prāṇasaṃgraham
variants.southern_text: tau nirāśau madarthaṃ ca śokasaṃtāpakarśitau । saha sarvarkṣaharibhis tyakṣyataḥ prāṇasaṃgraham ॥61॥

variants.critical_text: bhartur bhaktiṃ puraskṛtya rāmād anyasya vānara nāhaṃ spraṣṭuṃ padā gātram iccheyaṃ vānarottama
variants.southern_text: bhartur bhaktiṃ puraskṛtya rāmād anyasya vānara । nāhaṃ spraṣṭuṃ svato gātram iccheyaṃ vānarottama ॥62॥

variants.critical_text: yad ahaṃ gātrasaṃsparśaṃ rāvaṇasya gatā balāt anīśā kiṃ kariṣyāmi vināthā vivaśā satī
variants.southern_text: yad ahaṃ gātrasaṃsparśaṃ rāvaṇasya gatā balāt । anīśā kiṃ kariṣyāmi vināthā vivaśā sati ॥63॥

variants.critical_text: śrutā hi dṛṣṭāś ca mayā parākramā; mahātmanas tasya raṇāvamardinaḥ na devagandharvabhujaṃgarākṣasā; bhavanti rāmeṇa samā hi saṃyuge
variants.southern_text: śrutāś ca dṛṣṭā hi mayā parākramā । mahātmanas tasya raṇāvamardinaḥ । na devagandharvabhujaṃgarākṣasā । bhavanti rāmeṇa samā hi saṃyuge ॥65॥

variants.critical_text: sa me hariśreṣṭha salakṣmaṇaṃ patiṃ; sayūthapaṃ kṣipram ihopapādaya cirāya rāmaṃ prati śokakarśitāṃ; kuruṣva māṃ vānaramukhya harṣitām
variants.southern_text: sa me hariśreṣṭha salakṣmaṇaṃ priyaṃ । sayūthapaṃ kṣipram ihopapādaya । cirāya rāmaṃ prati śokakarśitāṃ । kuruṣva māṃ vānaravīra harṣitām ॥68॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ sa kapiśārdūlas tena vākyena harṣitaḥ sītām uvāca tac chrutvā vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ
variants.southern_text: tataḥ sa kapiśārdūlas tena vākyena toṣitaḥ । sītām uvāca tac chrutvā vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: strītvaṃ na tu samarthaṃ hi sāgaraṃ vyativartitum mām adhiṣṭhāya vistīrṇaṃ śatayojanam āyatam
variants.southern_text: strītvān na tvaṃ samarthāsi sāgaraṃ vyativartitum । mām adhiṣṭhāya vistīrṇaṃ śatayojanam āyatam ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: dvitīyaṃ kāraṇaṃ yac ca bravīṣi vinayānvite rāmād anyasya nārhāmi saṃsparśam iti jānaki
variants.southern_text: dvitīyaṃ kāraṇaṃ yac ca bravīṣi vinayānvite । rāmād anyasya nārhāmi saṃsargam iti jānaki ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: śroṣyate caiva kākutsthaḥ sarvaṃ niravaśeṣataḥ ceṣṭitaṃ yat tvayā devi bhāṣitaṃ mama cāgrataḥ
variants.southern_text: śroṣyate caiva kākutsthaḥ sarvaṃ niravaśeṣataḥ । ceṣṭitaṃ yat tvayā devi bhāṣitaṃ ca mamāgrataḥ ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: kāraṇair bahubhir devi rāma priyacikīrṣayā snehapraskannamanasā mayaitat samudīritam
variants.southern_text: kāraṇair bahubhir devi rāmapriyacikīrṣayā । snehapraskannamanasā mayaitat samudīritam ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: laṅkāyā duṣpraveśatvād dustaratvān mahodadheḥ sāmarthyād ātmanaś caiva mayaitat samudāhṛtam
variants.southern_text: laṅkāyā duṣpraveśatvād dustaratvān mahodadheḥ । sāmarthyād ātmanaś caiva mayaitat samudīritam ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: icchāmi tvāṃ samānetum adyaiva raghubandhunā gurusnehena bhaktyā ca nānyathā tad udāhṛtam
variants.southern_text: icchāmi tvāṃ samānetum adyaiva raghunandinā । gurusnehena bhaktyā ca nānyathā tad udāhṛtam ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: idaṃ śreṣṭham abhijñānaṃ brūyās tvaṃ tu mama priyam śailasya citrakūṭasya pāde pūrvottare tadā
variants.southern_text: idaṃ śreṣṭham abhijñānaṃ brūyās tvaṃ tu mama priyam । śailasya citrakūṭasya pāde pūrvottare pade ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: tāpasāśramavāsinyāḥ prājyamūlaphalodake tasmin siddhāśrame deśe mandākinyā adūrataḥ
variants.southern_text: tāpasāśramavāsinyāḥ prājyamūlaphalodake । tasmin siddhāśrite deśe mandākinyāvidūrataḥ ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: tasyopavanaṣaṇḍeṣu nānāpuṣpasugandhiṣu vihṛtya salilaklinnā tavāṅke samupāviśam
variants.southern_text: tasyopavanakhaṇḍeṣu nānāpuṣpasugandhiṣu । vihṛtya salile klinno mamāṅke samupāviśaḥ ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: tvayā vihasitā cāhaṃ kruddhā saṃlajjitā tadā bhakṣya gṛddhena kālena dāritā tvām upāgatā
variants.southern_text: tvayā vihasitā cāhaṃ kruddhā saṃlajjitā tadā । bhakṣyagṛddhena kālena dāritā tvām upāgatā ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: āsīnasya ca te śrāntā punar utsaṅgam āviśam krudhyantī ca prahṛṣṭena tvayāhaṃ parisāntvitā
variants.southern_text: tataḥ śrāntāham utsaṅgam āsīnasya tavāviśam । krudhyantīva prahṛṣṭena tvayāhaṃ parisāntvitā ॥19॥

variants.critical_text: vīkṣamāṇas tatas taṃ vai vāyasaṃ samavaikṣathāḥ nakhaiḥ sarudhirais tīkṣṇair mām evābhimukhaṃ sthitam
variants.southern_text: vīkṣamāṇas tatas taṃ vai vāyasaṃ samavaikṣata । nakhaiḥ sarudhirais tīkṣṇair mām evābhimukhaṃ sthitam ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: putraḥ kila sa śakrasya vāyasaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ dharāntaracaraḥ śīghraṃ pavanasya gatau samaḥ
variants.southern_text: putraḥ kila sa śakrasya vāyasaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ । dharāntaraṃ gataḥ śīghraṃ pavanasya gatau samaḥ ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tasmin mahābāhuḥ kopasaṃvartitekṣaṇaḥ vāyase kṛtavān krūrāṃ matiṃ matimatāṃ vara
variants.southern_text: tatas tasmin mahābāhuḥ kopasaṃvartitekṣaṇaḥ । vāyase kṛtavān krūrāṃ matiṃ matimatāṃ varaḥ ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: sa darbhasaṃstarād gṛhya brahmaṇo 'streṇa yojayaḥ sa dīpta iva kālāgnir jajvālābhimukho dvijam
variants.southern_text: sa darbhaṃ saṃstarād gṛhya brahmaṇo 'streṇa yojayat । sa dīpta iva kālāgnir jajvālābhimukho dvijam ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: sa pitrā ca parityaktaḥ suraiḥ sarvair maharṣibhiḥ trīṃl lokān saṃparikramya tvām eva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
variants.southern_text: sa pitrā ca parityaktaḥ sarvaiś ca paramarṣibhiḥ । trīṃl lokān samparikramya tam eva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: taṃ tvaṃ nipatitaṃ bhūmau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatam vadhārham api kākutstha kṛpayā paryapālayaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa taṃ nipatitaṃ bhūmau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatam । vadhārham api kākutsthaḥ kṛpayā paryapālayat ॥33॥

variants.critical_text: paridyūnaṃ viṣaṇṇaṃ ca sa tvam āyāntam uktavān moghaṃ kartuṃ na śakyaṃ tu brāhmam astraṃ tad ucyatām
variants.southern_text: paridyūnaṃ vivarṇaṃ ca patamānaṃ tam abravīt । moghaṃ astraṃ na śakyaṃ tu brāhmam kartuṃ tad ucyatām ॥34॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tasyākṣi kākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam
variants.southern_text: tatas tasyākṣi kākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam । dattvā tu dakṣiṇaṃ netraṃ prāṇebhyaḥ parirakṣitaḥ ॥35॥

variants.critical_text: sa te tadā namaskṛtvā rājñe daśarathāya ca tvayā vīra visṛṣṭas tu pratipede svam ālayam
variants.southern_text: sa rāmāya namaskṛtya rājñe daśarathāya ca । visṛṣṭas tena vīreṇa pratipede svam ālayam ॥36॥

variants.critical_text: matkṛte kākamātre 'pi brahmāstraṃ samudīritam kasmād yo māṃ harat tvattaḥ kṣamase taṃ mahīpate
variants.southern_text: matkṛte kākamātre 'pi brahmāstraṃ samudīritam । kasmād yo māharat tvattaḥ kṣamase taṃ mahīpate ॥37॥

variants.critical_text: evam astravidāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sattvavān balavān api kimartham astraṃ rakṣaḥsu na yojayasi rāghava
variants.southern_text: evam astravidāṃ śreṣṭho balavān sattvavān api । kimartham astraṃ rakṣaḥsu na yojayasi rāghava ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: na nāgā nāpi gandharvā nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ rāmasya samare vegaṃ śaktāḥ prati samādhitum
variants.southern_text: na nāgā nāpi gandharvā na surā na marudgaṇāḥ । rāmasya samare vegaṃ śaktāḥ prati samīhitum ॥42॥

variants.critical_text: tasyā vīryavataḥ kaś cid yady asti mayi saṃbhramaḥ kimarthaṃ na śarais tīkṣṇaiḥ kṣayaṃ nayati rākṣasān
variants.southern_text: tasya vīryavataḥ kaccid yady asti mayi sambhramaḥ । kimarthaṃ na śarais tīkṣṇaiḥ kṣayaṃ nayati rākṣasān ॥43॥

variants.critical_text: pitṛvad vartate rāme mātṛvan māṃ samācaran hriyamāṇāṃ tadā vīro na tu māṃ veda lakṣmaṇaḥ
variants.southern_text: pitṛvad vartate rāme mātṛvan māṃ samācarat । hriyamāṇāṃ tadā vīro na tu māṃ veda lakṣmaṇaḥ ॥58॥

variants.critical_text: vṛddhopasevī lakṣmīvāñ śakto na bahubhāṣitā rājaputraḥ priyaśreṣṭhaḥ sadṛśaḥ śvaśurasya me
variants.southern_text: vṛddhopasevī lakṣmīvāñ śakto na bahubhāṣitā । rājaputrapriyaśreṣṭhaḥ sadṛśaḥ śvaśurasya me ॥59॥

variants.critical_text: yaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāghavo naiva vṛddham āryam anusmarat sa mamārthāya kuśalaṃ vaktavyo vacanān mama
variants.southern_text: yaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāghavo naiva vṛttam āryam anusmarat । sa mamārthāya kuśalaṃ vaktavyo vacanān mama ॥61॥

variants.critical_text: idaṃ brūyāś ca me nāthaṃ śūraṃ rāmaṃ punaḥ punaḥ jīvitaṃ dhārayiṣyāmi māsaṃ daśarathātmaja
variants.southern_text: idaṃ brūyāś ca me nāthaṃ śūraṃ rāmaṃ punaḥ punaḥ । jīvitaṃ dhārayiṣyāmi māsaṃ daśarathātmaja । ūrdhvaṃ māsān na jīveyaṃ satyenāhaṃ bravīmi te ॥64॥

variants.critical_text: harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ sītādarśanajena saḥ hṛdayena gato rāmaṃ śarīreṇa tu viṣṭhitaḥ
variants.southern_text: harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ sītādarśanajena saḥ । hṛdayena gato rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca salakṣaṇām । (or) hṛdayena gato rāmam śarīreṇa tu viṣṭhitaḥ ॥69॥

variants.critical_text: maṇiṃ tu dṛṣṭvā rāmo vai trayāṇāṃ saṃsmariṣyati vīro jananyā mama ca rājño daśarathasya ca
variants.southern_text: maṇiṃ dṛṣṭvā tu rāmo vai trayāṇāṃ saṃsmariṣyati । vīro jananyā mama ca rājño daśarathasya ca ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: sa bhūyas tvaṃ samutsāhe codito harisattama asmin kāryasamārambhe pracintaya yaduttaram
variants.southern_text: sa bhūyas tvaṃ samutsāhacodito harisattama । asmin kāryasamutsahe pracintaya yaduttaram ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: nityam utsāhayuktāś ca vācaḥ śrutvā mayeritāḥ vardhiṣyate dāśaratheḥ pauruṣaṃ madavāptaye
variants.southern_text: nityam utsāhayuktasya vācaḥ śrutvā mayeritāḥ । vardhiṣyate dāśaratheḥ pauruṣaṃ madavāptaye ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: matsaṃdeśayutā vācas tvattaḥ śrutvaiva rāghavaḥ parākramavidhiṃ vīro vidhivat saṃvidhāsyati
variants.southern_text: matsaṃdeśayutā vācas tvattaḥ śrutvaiva rāghavaḥ । parākrame matiṃ vīro vidhivat saṃvidhāsyati ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: na hi paśyāmi martyeṣu nāmareṣv asureṣu vā yas tasya vamato bāṇān sthātum utsahate 'grataḥ
variants.southern_text: na hi paśyāmi martyeṣu nāsureṣu sureṣu vā । yas tasya vamato bāṇān sthātum utsahate 'grataḥ ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: sa hi sāgaraparyantāṃ mahīṃ śāsitum īhate tvan nimitto hi rāmasya jayo janakanandini
variants.southern_text: sa hi sāgaraparyantāṃ mahīṃ sādhitum īhate । tvan nimitto hi rāmasya jayo janakanandini ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: mama ced alpabhāgyāyāḥ sāmnidhyāt tava vīryavān asya śokasya mahato muhūrtaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet
variants.southern_text: mama caivālpabhāgyāyāḥ sāmnidhyāt tava vānara । asya śokasya mahato muhūrtaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: gate hi hariśārdūla punarāgamanāya tu prāṇānām api saṃdeho mama syān nātra saṃśayaḥ
variants.southern_text: tato hi hariśārdūla punarāgamanāya tu । prāṇānām api saṃdeho mama syān nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: kāmam asya tvam evaikaḥ kāryasya parisādhane paryāptaḥ paravīraghna yaśasyas te balodayaḥ
variants.southern_text: kāmam asya tvam evaikaḥ kāryasya parisādhane । paryāptaḥ paravīraghna yaśasyas te phalodayaḥ ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: balaiḥ samagrair yadi māṃ rāvaṇaṃ jitya saṃyuge vijayī svapuraṃ yāyāt tat tu me syād yaśaskaram
variants.southern_text: balaiḥ samagrair yudhi māṃ rāvaṇaṃ jitya saṃyuge । vijayī svapuraṃ yāyāt tat tasya sadṛśaṃ bhavet ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: tad yathā tasya vikrāntam anurūpaṃ mahātmanaḥ bhaved āhava śūrasya tathā tvam upapādaya
variants.southern_text: tad yathā tasya vikrāntam anurūpaṃ mahātmanaḥ । bhaved āhavaśūrasya tathā tvam upapādaya ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: tad arthopahitaṃ vākyaṃ sahitaṃ hetusaṃhitam niśamya hanumāñ śeṣaṃ vākyam uttaram abravīt
variants.southern_text: tad arthopahitaṃ vākyaṃ praśritaṃ hetusaṃhitam । niśamya hanumāñ śeṣaṃ vākyam uttaram abravīt ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: devi haryṛkṣasainyānām īśvaraḥ plavatāṃ varaḥ sugrīvaḥ sattvasaṃpannas tavārthe kṛtaniścayaḥ
variants.southern_text: devi haryṛkṣasainyānām īśvaraḥ plavatāṃ varaḥ । sugrīvaḥ sattvasampannas tavārthe kṛtaniścayaḥ ॥33॥

variants.critical_text: tasya vikramasaṃpannāḥ sattvavanto mahābalāḥ manaḥsaṃkalpasaṃpātā nideśe harayaḥ sthitāḥ
variants.southern_text: tasya vikramasampannāḥ sattvavanto mahābalāḥ । manaḥsaṃkalpasampātā nideśe harayaḥ sthitāḥ ॥35॥

variants.critical_text: asakṛt tair mahotsahaiḥ sasāgaradharādharā pradakṣiṇīkṛtā bhūmir vāyumārgānusāribhiḥ
variants.southern_text: asakṛt tair mahotsāhaiḥ sasāgaradharādharā । pradakṣiṇīkṛtā bhūmir vāyumārgānusāribhiḥ ॥37॥

variants.critical_text: mama pṛṣṭhagatau tau ca candrasūryāv ivoditau tvatsakāśaṃ mahāsattvau nṛsiṃhāv āgamiṣyataḥ
variants.southern_text: mama pṛṣṭhagatau tau ca candrasūryāv ivoditau । tvatsakāśaṃ mahāsaṅghau nṛsiṃhāv āgamiṣyataḥ ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: sagaṇaṃ rāvaṇaṃ hatvā rāghavo raghunandanaḥ tvām ādāya varārohe svapuraṃ pratiyāsyati
variants.southern_text: sagaṇaṃ rāvaṇaṃ hatvā rāghavo raghunandanaḥ । tvām ādāya varārohe svapurīṃ prati yāsyati ॥43॥

variants.critical_text: tad āśvasihi bhadraṃ te bhava tvaṃ kālakāṅkṣiṇī nacirād drakṣyase rāmaṃ prajvajantam ivānilam
variants.southern_text: tad āśvasihi bhadraṃ te bhava tvaṃ kālakāṅkṣiṇī । nacirād drakṣyase rāmaṃ prajvalantam ivānilam ॥44॥

variants.critical_text: kṣipraṃ tvaṃ devi śokasya pāraṃ yāsyasi maithili rāvaṇaṃ caiva rāmeṇa nihataṃ drakṣyase 'cirāt
variants.southern_text: kṣipraṃ tvaṃ devi śokasya pāraṃ drakṣyasi maithili । rāvaṇaṃ caiva rāmeṇa drakṣyase nihataṃ balāt ॥46॥

variants.critical_text: tam arighnaṃ kṛtātmānaṃ kṣipraṃ drakṣyasi rāghavam lakṣmaṇaṃ ca dhanuṣpāṇiṃ laṅkādvāram upasthitam
variants.southern_text: tam arighnaṃ kṛtātmānaṃ kṣipraṃ drakṣyasi rāghavam । lakṣmaṇaṃ ca dhanuṣpāṇiṃ laṅkādvāram upāgatam ॥48॥

variants.critical_text: mā rudo devi śokena mā bhūt te manaso 'priyam śacīva pathyā śakreṇa bhartrā nāthavatī hy asi
variants.southern_text: ruda mā devi śokena mā bhūt te manaso bhayam । śacīva bhartrā śakreṇa bhartrā saṅgam eṣyasi śobhane ॥52॥

variants.critical_text: tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā priyavaktāraṃ saṃprahṛṣyāmi vānara ardhasaṃjātasasyeva vṛṣṭiṃ prāpya vasuṃdharā
variants.southern_text: tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā priyavaktāraṃ samprahṛṣyāmi vānara । ardhasaṃjātasasyeva vṛṣṭiṃ prāpya vasuṃdharā ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: abhijñānaṃ ca rāmasya dattaṃ harigaṇottama kṣiptām īṣikāṃ kākasya kopād ekākṣiśātanīm
variants.southern_text: abhijñānaṃ ca rāmasya dadyā harigaṇottama । kṣiptām īṣikāṃ kākasya kopād ekākṣiśātanīm ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: manaḥśilāyās tikalo gaṇḍapārśve niveśitaḥ tvayā pranaṣṭe tilake taṃ kila smartum arhasi
variants.southern_text: manaḥśilāyās tilako gaṇḍapārśve niveśitaḥ । tvayā pranaṣṭe tilake taṃ kila smartum arhasi ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: eṣa niryātitaḥ śrīmān mayā te vārisaṃbhavaḥ ataḥ paraṃ na śakṣyāmi jīvituṃ śokalālasā
variants.southern_text: eṣa niryātitaḥ śrīmān mayā te vārisambhavaḥ । ataḥ paraṃ na śakṣyāmi jīvituṃ śokalālasā ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: asahyāni ca duḥkhāni vācaś ca hṛdayacchidaḥ rākṣasīnāṃ sughorāṇāṃ tvatkṛte marṣayāmy aham
variants.southern_text: asahyāni ca duḥkhāni vācaś ca hṛdayacchidaḥ । rākṣasaiḥ saha saṃvāsaṃ tvatkṛte marṣayāmy aham ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: ghoro rākṣasarājo 'yaṃ dṛṣṭiś ca na sukhā mayi tvāṃ ca śrutvā vipadyantaṃ na jīveyam ahaṃ kṣaṇam
variants.southern_text: ghoro rākṣasarājo 'yaṃ dṛṣṭiś ca na sukhā mayi । tvāṃ ca śrutvā viṣajjantaṃ na jīveyam api kṣaṇam ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: hatvā tu samare krūraṃ rāvaṇaṃ saha bāndhavam rāghavau tvāṃ viśālākṣi svāṃ purīṃ prāpayiṣyataḥ
variants.southern_text: hatvā tu samare rakṣo rāvaṇaṃ sahabāndhavaiḥ । rāghavau tvāṃ viśālākṣi svāṃ purīṃ prati neṣyataḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: yat tu rāmo vijānīyād abhijñānam anindite prītisaṃjananaṃ tasya bhūyas tvaṃ dātum arhasi
variants.southern_text: yat tu rāmo vijānīyād abhijñānam anindite । prītisaṃjananaṃ bhūyas tasya tvaṃ dātum arhasi ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: sābravīd dattam eveha mayābhijñānam uttamam etad eva hi rāmasya dṛṣṭvā matkeśabhūṣaṇam
variants.southern_text: sābravīd dattam evāho mayābhijñānam uttamam । etad eva hi rāmasya dṛṣṭvā yatnena bhūṣaṇam ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: yathā ca sa mahābāhur māṃ tārayati rāghavaḥ asmād duḥkhāmbusaṃrodhāt tat samādhātum arhasi
variants.southern_text: yathā ca sa mahābāhur māṃ tārayati rāghavaḥ । asmād duḥkhāmbusaṃrodhāt tvaṃ samādhātum arhasi ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: na sāma rakṣaḥsu guṇāya kalpate; na danam arthopaciteṣu vartate na bhedasādhyā baladarpitā janāḥ; parākramas tv eṣa mameha rocate
variants.southern_text: na sāma rakṣaḥsu guṇāya kalpate । na danam arthopaciteṣu yujyate । na bhedasādhyā baladarpitā janāḥ । parākramas tv eṣa mameha rocate ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: na cāsya kāryasya parākramād ṛte; viniścayaḥ kaś cid ihopapadyate hṛtapravīrās tu raṇe hi rākṣasāḥ; kathaṃ cid īyur yad ihādya mārdavam
variants.southern_text: na cāsya kāryasya parākramād ṛte । viniścayaḥ kaś cid ihopapadyate । hatapravīrāś ca raṇe tu rākṣasāḥ । kathaṃ cid īyur yad ihādya mārdavam ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: kārye karmaṇi nirdiṣṭo yo bahūny api sādhayet pūrvakāryavirodhena sa kāryaṃ kartum arhati
variants.southern_text: kārye karmaṇi nirvṛtte yo bahūny api sādhayet । pūrvakāryavirodhena sa kāryaṃ kartum arhati ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: ihaiva tāvat kṛtaniścayo hy ahaṃ; yadi vrajeyaṃ plavageśvarālayam parātmasaṃmarda viśeṣatattvavit; tataḥ kṛtaṃ syān mama bhartṛśāsanam
variants.southern_text: ihaiva tāvat kṛtaniścayo hy ahaṃ । vrajeyam adya plavageśvarālayam । parātmasammardaviśeṣatattvavit । tataḥ kṛtaṃ syān mama bhartṛśāsanam ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: kathaṃ nu khalv adya bhavet sukhāgataṃ; prasahya yuddhaṃ mama rākṣasaiḥ saha tathaiva khalv ātmabalaṃ ca sāravat; samānayen māṃ ca raṇe daśānanaḥ
variants.southern_text: kathaṃ nu khalv adya bhavet sukhāgataṃ । prasahya yuddhaṃ mama rākṣasaiḥ saha । tathaiva khalv ātmabalaṃ ca sāravat । sa mānayen māṃ ca raṇe daśānanaḥ ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: tato mahat sāśvamahārathadvipaṃ; balaṃ samāneṣv api rākṣasādhipaḥ triśūlakālāyasapaṭṭiśāyudhaṃ; tato mahad yuddham idaṃ bhaviṣyati
variants.southern_text: tato mahat sāśvamahārathadvipaṃ । balaṃ samāneṣyati rākṣasādhipaḥ । triśūlakālāyasapaṭṭiśāyudhaṃ । tato mahad yuddham idaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: ahaṃ tu taiḥ saṃyati caṇḍavikramaiḥ; sametya rakṣobhir asaṃgavikramaḥ nihatya tad rāvaṇacoditaṃ balaṃ; sukhaṃ gamiṣyāmi kapīśvarālayam
variants.southern_text: ahaṃ ca taiḥ saṃyati caṇḍavikramaiḥ । sametya rakṣobhir abhaṅgavikramaḥ । nihatya tad rāvaṇacoditaṃ balaṃ । sukhaṃ gamiṣyāmi kapīśvarālayam ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: latāgṛhaiś citragṛhaiś ca nāśitair; mahoragair vyālamṛgaiś ca nirdhutaiḥ śilāgṛhair unmathitais tathā gṛhaiḥ; pranaṣṭarūpaṃ tad abhūn mahad vanam
variants.southern_text: latāgṛhaiś citragṛhaiś ca sāditair । vyālair mṛgair ārtaravaiś ca pakṣibhiḥ । śilāgṛhair unmathitais tathā gṛhaiḥ । pranaṣṭarūpaṃ tad abhūn mahad vanam ॥19॥

variants.critical_text: sa tasya kṛtvārthapater mahākapir; mahad vyalīkaṃ manaso mahātmanaḥ yuyutsur eko bahubhir mahābalaiḥ; śriyā jvalaṃs toraṇam āśritaḥ kapiḥ
variants.southern_text: tataḥ sa kṛtvā jagatīpater mahān । mahad vyalīkaṃ manaso mahātmanaḥ । yuyutsur eko bahubhir mahābalaiḥ । śriyā jvalaṃs toraṇam āśritaḥ kapiḥ ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ pakṣininādena vṛkṣabhaṅgasvanena ca babhūvus trāsasaṃbhrāntāḥ sarve laṅkānivāsinaḥ
variants.southern_text: tataḥ pakṣininādena vṛkṣabhaṅgasvanena ca । babhūvus trāsasambhrāntāḥ sarve laṅkānivāsinaḥ ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: tatas taṃ girisaṃkāśam atikāyaṃ mahābalam rākṣasyo vānaraṃ dṛṣṭvā papracchur janakātmajām
variants.southern_text: tatas tu girisaṃkāśam atikāyaṃ mahābalam । rākṣasyo vānaraṃ dṛṣṭvā papracchur janakātmajām ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: ācakṣva no viśālākṣi mā bhūt te subhage bhayam saṃvādam asitāpāṅge tvayā kiṃ kṛtavān ayam
variants.southern_text: ācakṣva no viśālākṣi mā bhūt te subhage bhayam । saṃvādam asitāpāṅgi tvayā kiṃ kṛtavān ayam ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: athābravīt tadā sādhvī sītā sarvāṅgaśobhanā rakṣasāṃ kāmarūpāṇāṃ vijñāne mama kā gatiḥ
variants.southern_text: athābravīt tadā sādhvī sītā sarvāṅgaśobhanā । rakṣasāṃ kāmarūpāṇāṃ vijñāne kā gatir mama ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: yūyam evāsya jānīta yo 'yaṃ yad vā kariṣyati ahir eva aheḥ pādān vijānāti na saṃśayaḥ
variants.southern_text: yūyam evāsya jānīta yo 'yaṃ yad vā kariṣyati । ahir eva hy aheḥ pādān vijānāti na saṃśayaḥ ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: aham apy asya bhītāsmi nainaṃ jānāmi ko 'nvayam vedmi rākṣasam evainaṃ kāmarūpiṇam āgatam
variants.southern_text: aham apy atibhītāsmi nainaṃ jānāmi ko hy ayam । vedmi rākṣasam evainaṃ kāmarūpiṇam āgatam ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: rāvaṇasya samīpe tu rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ virūpaṃ vānaraṃ bhīmam ākhyatum upacakramuḥ
variants.southern_text: rāvaṇasya samīpe tu rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ । virūpaṃ vānaraṃ bhīmam rāvaṇaya nyavediṣuḥ ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: tena tvadbhūtarūpeṇa yat tat tava manoharam nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ pramṛṣṭaṃ pramadāvanam
variants.southern_text: tenaivādbhutarūpeṇa yat tat tava manoharam । nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ pramṛṣṭaṃ pramadāvanam ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: na tatra kaś cid uddeśo yas tena na vināśitaḥ yatra sā jānakī sītā sa tena na vināśitaḥ
variants.southern_text: na tatra kaś cid uddeśo yas tena na vināśitaḥ । yatra sā jānakī devī sa tena na vināśitaḥ ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: jānakīrakṣaṇārthaṃ vā śramād vā nopalabhyate atha vā kaḥ śramas tasya saiva tenābhirakṣitā
variants.southern_text: jānakīrakṣaṇārthaṃ vā śramād vā nopalakṣyate । atha vā kaḥ śramas tasya saiva tenābhirakṣitā ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: tasyograrūpasyograṃ tvaṃ daṇḍam ājñātum arhasi sītā saṃbhāṣitā yena tad vanaṃ ca vināśitam
variants.southern_text: tasyograrūpasyograṃ tvaṃ daṇḍam ājñātum arhasi । sītā sambhāṣitā yena vanaṃ tena vināśitam ॥20॥

variants.critical_text: rākṣasīnāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ hutāgir iva jajvāla kopasaṃvartitekṣaṇaḥ
variants.southern_text: rākṣasīnāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ । hutāgnir iva jajvāla kopasaṃvartitekṣaṇaḥ ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: te kapiṃ taṃ samāsādya toraṇastham avasthitam abhipetur mahāvegāḥ pataṅgā iva pāvakam
variants.southern_text: te kapiṃ taṃ samāsādya toraṇastham avasthitam । abhipetur mahāvegāḥ pataṃgā iva pāvakam ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: te gadābhir vicitrābhiḥ parighaiḥ kāñcanāṅgadaiḥ ājaghnur vānaraśreṣṭhaṃ śarair ādityasaṃnibhaiḥ
variants.southern_text: te gadābhir vicitrābhiḥ parighaiḥ kāñcanāṅgadaiḥ । ājagmur vānaraśreṣṭhaṃ śarair ādityasaṃnibhaiḥ ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: hanūmān api tejasvī śrīmān parvatasaṃnibhaḥ kṣitāv āvidhya lāṅgūlaṃ nanāda ca mahāsvanam
variants.southern_text: hanūmān api tejasvī śrīmān parvatasaṃnibhaḥ । kṣitāv āvidhya lāṅgūlaṃ nanāda ca mahādhvanim ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: sa taṃ parigham ādāya jaghāna rajanīcarān
variants.southern_text: sa taṃ parigham ādāya jaghāna rajanīcarān । sapannagam ivādāya sphurantaṃ vinatāsutaḥ ॥40॥

variants.critical_text: sa hatvā rākṣasān vīraḥ kiṃkarān mārutātmajaḥ yuddhākāṅkṣī punar vīras toraṇaṃ samupasthitaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa hatvā rakṣasān vīraḥ kiṃkarān mārutātmajaḥ । yuddhākāṅkṣī punar vīras toraṇaṃ samupasthitaḥ ॥42॥

variants.critical_text: saṃpradhṛṣya ca durdharṣaś caityaprāsādam unnatam hanūmān prajvalaṃl lakṣmyā pāriyātropamo 'bhavat
variants.southern_text: sampradhṛṣya tu durdharṣaś caityaprāsādam unnatam । hanūmān prajvalaṃl lakṣmyā pāriyātropamo 'bhavat ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: sa bhūtvā tu mahākāyo hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ dhṛṣṭam āsphoṭayām āsa laṅkāṃ śabdena pūrayan
variants.southern_text: sa bhūtvā sumahākāyaḥ prabhāvān mārutātmajaḥ । dhṛṣṭam āsphoṭayām āsa laṅkāṃ śabdena pūrayan ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: tasyāsphoṭitaśabdena mahatā śrotraghātinā petur vihaṃgā gaganād uccaiś cedam aghoṣayat
variants.southern_text: tasyāsphoṭitaśabdena mahatā śrotraghātinā । petur vihaṃgamās tatra caityapālāśca mohitāḥ ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: jayaty atibalo rāmo lakṣmaṇaś ca mahābalaḥ rājā jayati sugrīvo rāghaveṇābhipālitaḥ
variants.southern_text: astravijjayatāṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ । rājā jayati sugrīvo rāghaveṇābhipālitaḥ ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: evam uktvā vimānasthaś caityasthān haripuṃgavaḥ nanāda bhīmanirhrādo rakṣasāṃ janayan bhayam
variants.southern_text: evam uktvā mahākayaś caityastho hariyūthapaḥ । nanāda bhīmanirhrādo rakṣasāṃ janayan bhayam ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: tena śabdena mahatā caityapālāḥ śataṃ yayuḥ gṛhītvā vividhān astrān prāsān khaḍgān paraśvadhān
variants.southern_text: tena nādena mahatā caityapālāḥ śataṃ yayuḥ । gṛhītvā vividhān astrān prāsān khaḍgān paraśvadhān ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: tato vātātmajaḥ kruddho bhīmarūpaṃ samāsthitaḥ
variants.southern_text: parikṣipya hariśreṣṭhaṃ sa babhau rakṣasāṃ gaṇaḥ । tato vātātmajaḥ kruddho bhīmarūpaṃ samāsthitaḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: neyam asti purī laṅkā na yūyaṃ na ca rāvaṇaḥ yasmād ikṣvākunāthena baddhaṃ vairaṃ mahātmanā
variants.southern_text: āgamiṣyati sugrīvaḥ sarveṣāṃ vo niṣūdanaḥ । neyam asti purī laṅkā na yūyaṃ na ca rāvaṇaḥ । yasya tv ikṣvākuvīreṇa baddhaṃ vairaṃ mahātmanā ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: dhanuḥ śakradhanuḥ prakhyaṃ mahad rucirasāyakam visphārayāṇo vegena vajrāśanisamasvanam
variants.southern_text: dhanuḥ śakradhanuḥprakhyaṃ mahad rucirasāyakam । visphārayāṇo vegena vajrāśanisamasvanam ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: taṃ toraṇaviṭaṅkasthaṃ hanūmantaṃ mahākapim jambumālī mahābāhur vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
variants.southern_text: taṃ toraṇaviṭaṅkasthaṃ hanūmantaṃ mahākapim । jambumālī mahātejā vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: ardhacandreṇa vadane śirasy ekena karṇinā bāhvor vivyādha nārācair daśabhis taṃ kapīśvaram
variants.southern_text: ardhacandreṇa vadane śirasy ekena karṇinā । bāhvor vivyādha nārācair daśabhis tu kapīśvaram ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: sa śaraiḥ pūritatanuḥ krodhena mahatā vṛtaḥ tam eva parighaṃ gṛhya bhrāmayām āsa vegitaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa śaraiḥ pūritatanuḥ krodhena mahatā vṛtaḥ । tameva parighaṃ gṛhya bhrāmayāmāsa vegitaḥ ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: tasya caiva śiro nāsti na bāhū na ca jānunī na dhanur na ratho nāśvās tatrādṛśyanta neṣavaḥ
variants.southern_text: tasya caiva śiro nāsti na bāhū jānunī na ca । na dhanur na ratho nāśvās tatrādṛśyanta neṣavaḥ ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: sa hatas tarasā tena jambumālī mahārathaḥ papāta nihato bhūmau cūrṇitāṅgavibhūṣaṇaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa hatas tarasā tena jambumālī mahārathaḥ । papāta nihato bhūmau cūrṇitāṅga iva drumaḥ ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: jambumāliṃ ca nihataṃ kiṃkarāṃś ca mahābalān cukrodha rāvaṇaḥ śrutvā kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ
variants.southern_text: jambumāliṃ sunihataṃ kiṃkarāṃś ca mahābalān । cukrodha rāvaṇaḥ śrutvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ ॥19॥

variants.critical_text: jananyas tās tatas teṣāṃ viditvā kiṃkarān hatān babhūvuḥ śokasaṃbhrāntāḥ sabāndhavasuhṛjjanāḥ
variants.southern_text: jananyas tās tatas teṣāṃ viditvā kiṃkarān hatān । babhūvuḥ śokasambhrāntāḥ sabāndhavasuhṛjjanāḥ ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: te parasparasaṃgharṣās taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ abhipetur hanūmantaṃ toraṇastham avasthitam
variants.southern_text: te parasparasaṃgharṣāt taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ । abhipetur hanūmantaṃ toraṇastham avasthitam ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: sṛjanto bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ te rathagarjitaniḥsvanāḥ vṛṣṭimanta ivāmbhodā vicerur nairṛtarṣabhāḥ
variants.southern_text: sṛjanto bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ te rathagarjitaniḥsvanāḥ । pravṛṭkāla ivāmbhodā vicerur nairṛtāmbudāḥ ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: tatas teṣv avapanneṣu bhūmau nipatiteṣu ca tat sainyam agamat sarvaṃ diśo daśabhayārditam
variants.southern_text: tatas teṣv avapanneṣu bhūmau nipatiteṣu ca । tat sainyam agamat sarvaṃ diśo daśa bhayārditam ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: sa virūpākṣayūpākṣau durdharaṃ caiva rākṣasaṃ praghasaṃ bhāsakarṇaṃ ca pañcasenāgranāyakān
variants.southern_text: sa virūpākṣayūpākṣau durdharaṃ caiva rākṣasaṃ । praghasaṃ bhāsakarṇaṃ ca pañca senāgranāyakān ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: yat taiś ca khalu bhāvyaṃ syāt tam āsādya vanālayam karma cāpi samādheyaṃ deśakālavirodhitam
variants.southern_text: yattaiś ca khalu bhāvyaṃ syāt tam āsādya vanālayam । karma cāpi samādheyaṃ deśakālāvirodhitam ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: na hy ahaṃ taṃ kapiṃ manye karmaṇā pratitarkayan sarvathā tan mahad bhūtaṃ mahābalaparigraham
variants.southern_text: na hy ahaṃ taṃ kapiṃ manye karmaṇā prati tarkayan । sarvathā tan mahad bhūtaṃ mahābalaparigraham ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: tasya pañcāyasās tīkṣṇāḥ sitāḥ pītamukhāḥ śarāḥ śirasty utpalapatrābhā durdhareṇa nipātitāḥ
variants.southern_text: tais taiḥ praharaṇair bhīmair abhipetus tatas tataḥ । tasya pañcāyasās tīkṣṇāḥ sitāḥ pītamukhāḥ śarāḥ । śirasy utpalapatrābhā durdhareṇa nipātitāḥ ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: ardyamānas tatas tena durdhareṇānilātmajaḥ cakāra ninadaṃ bhūyo vyavardhata ca vegavān
variants.southern_text: ardyamānas tatas tena durdhareṇānilātmajaḥ । cakāra ninadaṃ bhūyo vyavardhata ca vīryavān ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: tatas taṃ mathitāṣṭāśvaṃ rathaṃ bhagnākṣakūvaram vihāya nyapatad bhūmau durdharas tyaktajīvitaḥ
variants.southern_text: tataḥ sa mathitāṣṭāśvaṃ rathaṃ bhagnākṣakūbaram । vihāya nyapatad bhūmau durdharas tyaktajīvitaḥ ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: taṃ virūpākṣayūpākṣau dṛṣṭvā nipatitaṃ bhuvi saṃjātaroṣau durdharṣāv utpetatur ariṃdamau
variants.southern_text: taṃ virūpākṣayūpākṣau dṛṣṭvā nipatitaṃ bhuvi । tau jātaroṣau durdharṣāv utpetatur ariṃdamau ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: sa tābhyāṃ sahasotpatya viṣṭhito vimale 'mbare mudgarābhyāṃ mahābāhur vakṣasy abhihataḥ kapiḥ
variants.southern_text: sa tābhyāṃ sahasotplutya viṣṭhito vimale 'mbare । mudgarābhyāṃ mahābāhur vakṣasy abhihataḥ kapiḥ ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: tayor vegavator vegaṃ vinihatya mahābalaḥ nipapāta punar bhūmau suparṇasamavikramaḥ
variants.southern_text: tayor vegavator vegaṃ vinihatya mahābalaḥ । nipapāta punar bhūmau suparṇa iva vegitaḥ ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tāṃs trīn hatāñ jñātvā vānareṇa tarasvinā abhipede mahāvegaḥ prasahya praghaso harim
variants.southern_text: tatas tāṃs trīn hatāñ jñātvā vānareṇa tarasvinā । abhipede mahāvegaḥ prasahya praghaso balī ॥33॥

variants.critical_text: paṭṭiśena śitāgreṇa praghasaḥ pratyapothayat bhāsakarṇaś ca śūlena rākṣasaḥ kapisattamam
variants.southern_text: paṭṭiśena śitāgreṇa praghasaḥ pratyapothayat । bhāsakarṇaś ca śūlena rākṣasaḥ kapikuñjaram ॥35॥

variants.critical_text: samutpāṭya gireḥ śṛṅgaṃ samṛgavyālapādapam jaghāna hanumān vīro rākṣasau kapikuñjaraḥ
variants.southern_text: samutpāṭya gireḥ śṛṅgaṃ samṛgavyālapādapam । jaghāna hanumān vīro rākṣasau kapikuñjaraḥ । giriśṛṅgasuniṣpiṣṭau tilaśas tau babhuvatuḥ ॥37॥

variants.critical_text: hatair nāgaiś ca turagair bhagnākṣaiś ca mahārathaiḥ hataiś ca rākṣasair bhūmī ruddhamārgā samantataḥ
variants.southern_text: hatair nāgais turagaiś ca bhagnākṣaiś ca mahārathaiḥ । hataiś ca rākṣasair bhūmī ruddhamārgā samantataḥ ॥40॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ kapis tān dhvajinīpatīn raṇe; nihatya vīrān sabalān savāhanān tad eva vīraḥ parigṛhya toraṇaṃ; kṛtakṣaṇaḥ kāla iva prajākṣaye
variants.southern_text: tataḥ kapis tān dhvajinīpatīn raṇe । nihatya vīrān sabalān savāhanān । tathaiva vīraḥ parigṛhya toraṇaṃ । kṛtakṣaṇaḥ kāla iva prajākṣaye ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: senāpatīn pañca sa tu pramāpitān; hanūmatā sānucarān savāhanān samīkṣya rājā samaroddhatonmukhaṃ; kumāram akṣaṃ prasamaikṣatākṣatam
variants.southern_text: senāpatīn pañca sa tu pramāpitān; । hanūmatā sānucarān savāhanān । niśamya rājā samaroddhatonmukhaṃ; । kumāram akṣaṃ prasamaikṣatākṣatam ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: sa tasya dṛṣṭyarpaṇasaṃpracoditaḥ; pratāpavān kāñcanacitrakārmukaḥ samutpapātātha sadasy udīrito; dvijātimukhyair haviṣeva pāvakaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa tasya dṛṣṭyarpaṇasampracoditaḥ; । pratāpavān kāñcanacitrakārmukaḥ । samutpapātātha sadasy udīrito; । dvijātimukhyair haviṣeva pāvakaḥ ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: tato mahad bāladivākaraprabhaṃ; prataptajāmbūnadajālasaṃtatam rathāṃ samāsthāya yayau sa vīryavān; mahāhariṃ taṃ prati nairṛtarṣabhaḥ
variants.southern_text: tato mahān bāladivākaraprabhaṃ; । prataptajāmbūnadajālasaṃtatam । rathāṃ samāsthāya yayau sa vīryavān; । mahāhariṃ taṃ prati nairṛtarṣabhaḥ ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tapaḥsaṃgrahasaṃcayārjitaṃ; prataptajāmbūnadajālaśobhitam patākinaṃ ratnavibhūṣitadhvajaṃ; manojavāṣṭāśvavaraiḥ suyojitam
variants.southern_text: tatas tapaḥsaṃgrahasaṃcayārjitaṃ; । prataptajāmbūnadajālacitritam । patākinaṃ ratnavibhūṣitadhvajaṃ; । manojavāṣṭāśvavaraiḥ suyojitam ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: surāsurādhṛṣyam asaṃgacāriṇaṃ; raviprabhaṃ vyomacaraṃ samāhitam satūṇam aṣṭāsinibaddhabandhuraṃ; yathākramāveśitaśaktitomaram
variants.southern_text: surāsurādhṛṣyam asaṅgacāriṇaṃ; । taḍitprabhaṃ vyomacaraṃ samāhitam । satūṇam aṣṭāsinibaddhabandhuraṃ; । yathākramāveśitaśaktitomaram ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: sa pūrayan khaṃ ca mahīṃ ca sācalāṃ; turaṃgamataṅgamahārathasvanaiḥ balaiḥ sametaiḥ sa hi toraṇasthitaṃ; samartham āsīnam upāgamat kapim
variants.southern_text: sa pūrayan khaṃ ca mahīṃ ca sācalāṃ; । turaṃgamataṅgamahārathasvanaiḥ । balaiḥ sametaiḥ sahatoraṇasthitaṃ; । samartham āsīnam upāgamat kapim ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: sa taṃ samāsādya hariṃ harīkṣaṇo; yugāntakālāgnim iva prajākṣaye avasthitaṃ vismitajātasaṃbhramaḥ; samaikṣatākṣo bahumānacakṣuṣā
variants.southern_text: sa taṃ samāsādya hariṃ harīkṣaṇo; । yugāntakālāgnim iva prajākṣaye । avasthitaṃ vismitajātasambhramaḥ; । samaikṣatākṣo bahumānacakṣuṣā ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: sa tasya vegaṃ ca kaper mahātmanaḥ; parākramaṃ cāriṣu pārhtivātmajaḥ vicārayan khaṃ ca balaṃ mahābalo; himakṣaye sūrya ivābhivardhate
variants.southern_text: sa tasya vegaṃ ca kaper mahātmanaḥ; । parākramaṃ cāriṣu rāvaṇātmajaḥ । vicārayan svaṃ ca balaṃ mahābalo; । yugakṣaye sūrya ivābhivardhata ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: sa jātamanyuḥ prasamīkṣya vikramaṃ; sthiraḥ sthitaḥ saṃyati durnivāraṇam samāhitātmā hanumantam āhave; pracodayām āsa śarais tribhiḥ śitaiḥ
variants.southern_text: sa jātamanyuḥ prasamīkṣya vikramaṃ; । sthitaḥ sthiraḥ (sthiram?) saṃyati durnivāraṇam । samāhitātmā hanumantam āhave; । pracodayām āsa śitaiḥ śarais tribhiḥ ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ kapiṃ taṃ prasamīkṣya garvitaṃ; jitaśramaṃ śatruparājayor jitam avaikṣatākṣaḥ samudīrṇamānasaḥ; sabāṇapāṇiḥ pragṛhītakārmukaḥ
variants.southern_text: tataḥ kapiṃ taṃ prasamīkṣya garvitaṃ । jitaśramaṃ śatruparājayocitam । avaikṣatākṣaḥ samudīrṇamānasaḥ । sabāṇapāṇiḥ pragṛhītakārmukaḥ ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: sa hemaniṣkāṅgadacārukuṇḍalaḥ; samāsasādāśu parākramaḥ kapim tayor babhūvāpratimaḥ samāgamaḥ; surāsurāṇām api saṃbhramapradaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa hemaniṣkāṅgadacārukuṇḍalaḥ । samāsasādāśu parākramaḥ kapim । tayor babhūvāpratimaḥ samāgamaḥ । surāsurāṇām api sambhramapradaḥ ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: rarāsa bhūmir na tatāpa bhānumān; vavau na vāyuḥ pracacāla cācalaḥ kapeḥ kumārasya ca vīkṣya saṃyugaṃ; nanāda ca dyaur udadhiś ca cukṣubhe
variants.southern_text: rarāsa bhūmir na tatāpa bhānumān । vavau na vāyuḥ pracacāla cācalaḥ । kapeḥ kumārasya ca vīryasaṃyugaṃ । nanāda ca dyaur udadhiś ca cukṣubhe ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ sa vīraḥ sumukhān patatriṇaḥ; suvarṇapuṅkhān saviṣān ivoragān samādhisaṃyogavimokṣatattvavic; charān atha trīn kapimūrdhny apātayat
variants.southern_text: sa tasya vīraḥ sumukhān patatriṇaḥ । suvarṇapuṅkhān saviṣān ivoragān । samādhisaṃyogavimokṣatattvavic । charān atha trīn kapimūrdhny atāḍayat ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: sa taiḥ śarair mūrdhni samaṃ nipātitaiḥ; kṣarann asṛgdigdhavivṛttalocanaḥ navoditādityanibhaḥ śarāṃśumān; vyarājatāditya ivāṃśumālikaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa taiḥ śarair mūrdhni samaṃ nipātitaiḥ । kṣarann asṛgdigdhavivṛttanetraḥ । navoditādityanibhaḥ śarāṃśumān । vyarājatāditya ivāṃśumālikaḥ ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ sa piṅgādhipamantrisattamaḥ; samīkṣya taṃ rājavarātmajaṃ raṇe udagracitrāyudhacitrakārmukaṃ; jaharṣa cāpūryata cāhavonmukhaḥ
variants.southern_text: tataḥ sa plavaṅgādhipamantrisattamaḥ । samīkṣya taṃ rājavarātmajaṃ raṇe । udagracitrāyudhacitrakārmukaṃ । jaharṣa cāpūryata cāhavonmukhaḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: sa mandarāgrastha ivāṃśumālī; vivṛddhakopo balavīryasaṃyutaḥ kumāram akṣaṃ sabalaṃ savāhanaṃ; dadāha netrāgnimarīcibhis tadā
variants.southern_text: sa mandarāgrastha ivāṃśumālī । vivṛddhakopo balavīryasaṃvṛtaḥ । kumāram akṣaṃ sabalaṃ savāhanaṃ । dadāha netrāgnimarīcibhis tadā ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ kapis taṃ raṇacaṇḍavikramaṃ; vivṛddhatejobalavīryasāyakam kumāram akṣaṃ prasamīkṣya saṃyuge; nanāda harṣād ghanatulyavikramaḥ
variants.southern_text: kapis tatas taṃ raṇacaṇḍavikramaṃ । pravṛddhatejobalavīryasāyakam । kumāram akṣaṃ prasamīkṣya saṃyuge । nanāda harṣād ghanatulyavikramaḥ ॥19॥

variants.critical_text: sa tena bāṇaiḥ prasabhaṃ nipātitaiś; cakāra nādaṃ ghananādaniḥsvanaḥ samutpapātāśu nabhaḥ sa mārutir; bhujoruvikṣepaṇa ghoradarśanaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa tena bāṇaiḥ prasabhaṃ nipātitaiś । cakāra nādaṃ ghananādaniḥsvanaḥ । samutpapātāśu nabhaḥ sa mārutir । bhujoruvikṣepaṇaghoradarśanaḥ ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: samutpatantaṃ samabhidravad balī; sa rākṣasānāṃ pravaraḥ pratāpavān rathī rathaśreṣṭhatamaḥ kirañ śaraiḥ; payodharaḥ śailam ivāśmavṛṣṭibhiḥ
variants.southern_text: tamutpatantaṃ samabhidravad balī । sa rākṣasānāṃ pravaraḥ pratāpavān । rathī rathaśreṣṭhatamaḥ kirañ charaiḥ । payodharaḥ śailam ivāśmavṛṣṭibhiḥ ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: sa tāñ śarāṃs tasya vimokṣayan kapiś; cacāra vīraḥ pathi vāyusevite śarāntare mārutavad viniṣpatan; manojavaḥ saṃyati caṇḍavikramaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa tāñ śarāṃs tasya harir vimokṣayamś । cacāra vīraḥ pathi vāyusevite । śarāntare mārutavad viniṣpatan । manojavaḥ saṃyati caṇḍavikramaḥ ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: abālavad bāladivākaraprabhaḥ; karoty ayaṃ karma mahan mahābalaḥ na cāsya sarvāhavakarmaśobhinaḥ; pramāpaṇe me matir atra jāyate
variants.southern_text: abālavad bāladivākaraprabhaḥ । karoty ayaṃ karma mahan mahābalaḥ । na cāsya sarvāhavakarmaśālinaḥ । pramāpaṇe me matir atra jāyate ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: parākramotsāhavivṛddhamānasaḥ; samīkṣate māṃ pramukhāgataḥ sthitaḥ parākramo hy asya manāṃsi kampayet; surāsurāṇām api śīghrakāriṇaḥ
variants.southern_text: parākramotsāhavivṛddhamānasaḥ । samīkṣate māṃ pramukho 'grataḥ sthitaḥ । parākramo hy asya manāṃsi kampayet । surāsurāṇām api śīghrakāriṇaḥ ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: na khalv ayaṃ nābhibhaved upekṣitaḥ; parākramo hy asya raṇe vivardhate pramāpaṇaṃ tv eva mamāsya rocate; na vardhamāno 'gnir upekṣituṃ kṣamaḥ
variants.southern_text: na khalv ayaṃ nābhibhaved upekṣitaḥ । parākramo hy asya raṇe vivardhate । pramāpaṇaṃ hy asya mamādya rocate । na vardhamāno 'gnir upekṣituṃ kṣamaḥ ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: sa tasya tān aṣṭahayān mahājavān; samāhitān bhārasahān vivartane jaghāna vīraḥ pathi vāyusevite; talaprahālaiḥ pavanātmajaḥ kapiḥ
variants.southern_text: sa tasya tān aṣṭa varān mahāhayān । samāhitān bhārasahān vivartane । jaghāna vīraḥ pathi vāyusevite । talaprahāraiḥ pavanātmajaḥ kapiḥ ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: sa taṃ parityajya mahāratho rathaṃ; sakārmukaḥ khaḍgadharaḥ kham utpatat tapo'bhiyogād ṛṣir ugravīryavān; vihāya dehaṃ marutām ivālayam
variants.southern_text: sa taṃ parityajya mahāratho rathaṃ । sakārmukaḥ khaḍgadharaḥ kham utpatan । tato'bhiyogād ṛṣir ugravīryavān । vihāya dehaṃ marutām ivālayam ॥33॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ kapis taṃ vicarantam ambare; patatrirājānilasiddhasevite sametya taṃ mārutavegavikramaḥ; krameṇa jagrāha ca pādayor dṛḍham
variants.southern_text: kapis tatas taṃ vicarantam ambare । patatrirājānilasiddhasevite । sametya taṃ mārutavegavikramaḥ । krameṇa jagrāha ca pādayor dṛḍham ॥34॥

variants.critical_text: sa bhagnabāhūrukaṭīśiro dharaḥ; kṣarann asṛn nirmathitāsthilocanaḥ sa bhinnasaṃdhiḥ pravikīrṇabandhano; hataḥ kṣitau vāyusutena rākṣasaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa bhagnabāhūrukaṭīpayodharaḥ । kṣarann asṛn nirmathitāsthilocanaḥ । sabhinnasaṃdhiḥ pravikīrṇabandhano । hataḥ kṣitau vāyusutena rākṣasaḥ ॥36॥

variants.critical_text: nihatya taṃ vajrasutopamaprabhaṃ; kumāram akṣaṃ kṣatajopamekṣaṇam tad eva vīro 'bhijagāma toraṇaṃ; kṛtakṣaṇaḥ kāla iva prajākṣaye
variants.southern_text: nihatya taṃ vajrasutopamaṃ raṇe । kumāram akṣaṃ kṣatajopamekṣaṇam । tad eva vīro 'bhijagāma toraṇaṃ । kṛtakṣaṇaḥ kāla iva prajākṣaye ॥38॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tu rakṣo'dhipatir mahātmā; hanūmatākṣe nihate kumāre manaḥ samādhāya tadendrakalpaṃ; samādideśendrajitaṃ sa roṣāt
variants.southern_text: tatas tu rakṣo'dhipatir mahātmā । hanūmatākṣe nihate kumāre । manaḥ samādhāya sa devakalpaṃ । samādideśendrajitaṃ saroṣaḥ ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: tavāstrabalam āsādya nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ na kaś cit triṣu lokeṣu saṃyuge na gataśramaḥ
variants.southern_text: tavāstrabalam āsādya sāsurā samarudgaṇāḥ । na śekuḥ samare sthatuṃ sureṣvarasamāśritāḥ ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: na te 'sty aśakyaṃ samareṣu karmaṇā; na te 'sty akāryaṃ matipūrvamantraṇe na so 'sti kaś cit triṣu saṃgraheṣu vai; na veda yas te 'strabalaṃ balaṃ ca te
variants.southern_text: na te 'sty aśakyaṃ samareṣu karmaṇā । na te 'sty akāryaṃ matipūrvamantraṇe । na so 'sti kaś cit triṣu saṃgraheṣu । na veda yas te 'strabalaṃ balaṃ ca ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: nihatā iṃkarāḥ sarve jambumālī ca rākṣasaḥ amātyaputrā vīrāś ca pañca senāgrayāyinaḥ
variants.southern_text: nihatāḥ kiṃkarāḥ sarve jambumālī ca rākṣasaḥ । amātyaputrā vīrāś ca pañca senāgragaminaḥ ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: sahodaras te dayitaḥ kumāro 'kṣaś ca sūditaḥ na tu teṣv eva me sāro yas tvayy ariniṣūdana
variants.southern_text: balāni susamṛddhāni sāśvanāgarathāni ca । sahodaras te dayitaḥ kumāro 'kṣaś ca sūditaḥ । na tu teṣv eva me sāro yas tvayy ariniṣūdana ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: idaṃ hi dṛṣṭvā matiman mahad balaṃ; kapeḥ prabhāvaṃ ca parākramaṃ ca tvam ātmanaś cāpi samīkṣya sāraṃ; kuruṣva vegaṃ svabalānurūpam
variants.southern_text: idaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ mahad balaṃ । kapeḥ prabhāvaṃ ca parākramaṃ ca । tvam ātmanaś cāpi samīkṣya sāraṃ । kuruṣva vegaṃ svabalānurūpam ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: balāvamardas tvayi saṃnikṛṣṭe; yathā gate śāmyati śāntaśatrau tathā samīkṣyātmabalaṃ paraṃ ca; samārabhasvāstravidāṃ variṣṭha
variants.southern_text: balāvamardas tvayi saṃnikṛṣṭe । yathā gate śāmyati śāntaśatrau । tathā samīkṣyātmabalaṃ paraṃ ca । samārabhasvāstrabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: na khalv iyaṃ matiḥ śreṣṭhā yat tvāṃ saṃpreṣayāmy aham iyaṃ ca rājadharmāṇāṃ kṣatrasya ca matir matā
variants.southern_text: na khalv iyaṃ matiśreṣṭha yat tvāṃ sampreṣayāmy aham । iyaṃ ca rājadharmāṇāṃ kṣatrasya ca matir matā ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: nānāśastraiś ca saṃgrāme vaiśāradyam ariṃdama avaśyam eva boddhavyaṃ kāmyaś ca vijayo raṇe
variants.southern_text: nānāśastreṣu saṃgrāme vaiśāradyam ariṃdama । avaśyam eva boddhavyaṃ kāmyaś ca vijayo raṇe ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ pitus tad vacanaṃ niśamya; pradakṣiṇaṃ dakṣasutaprabhāvaḥ cakāra bhartāram adīnasattvo; raṇāya vīraḥ pratipannabuddhiḥ
variants.southern_text: tataḥ pitus tad vacanaṃ niśamya । pradakṣiṇaṃ dakṣasutaprabhāvaḥ । cakāra bhartāram atitvareṇa । raṇāya vīraḥ pratipannabuddhiḥ ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: tatas taiḥ svagaṇair iṣṭair indrajit pratipūjitaḥ yuddhoddhatakṛtotsāhaḥ saṃgrāmaṃ pratipadyata
variants.southern_text: tatas taiḥ svagaṇair iṣṭair indrajit pratipūjitaḥ । yuddhoddhatakṛtotsāhaḥ saṃgrāmaṃ samprapadyata ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: śrīmān padmapalāśākṣo rākṣasādhipateḥ sutaḥ nirjagāma mahātejāḥ samudra iva parvasu
variants.southern_text: śrīmān padmapalāśākṣo rākṣasādhipateḥ sutaḥ । nirjagāma mahātejāḥ samudra iva parvaṇi ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: sa pakṣi rājopamatulyavegair; vyālaiś caturbhiḥ sitatīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraiḥ rathaṃ samāyuktam asaṃgavegaṃ; samārurohendrajid indrakalpaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa pakṣirājopamatulyavegair । vyāghraiś caturbhiḥ sa tu tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraiḥ । rathaṃ samāyuktam asahyavegaḥ । samārurohendrajid indrakalpaḥ ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: sa tasya rathanirghoṣaṃ jyāsvanaṃ kārmukasya ca niśamya harivīro 'sau saṃprahṛṣṭataro 'bhavat
variants.southern_text: sa tasya rathanirghoṣaṃ jyāsvanaṃ kārmukasya ca । niśamya harivīro 'sau samprahṛṣṭataro 'bhavat ॥20॥

variants.critical_text: sumahac cāpam ādāya śitaśalyāṃś ca sāyakān hanūmantam abhipretya jagāma raṇapaṇḍitaḥ
variants.southern_text: indrajic cāpam ādāya śitaśalyāṃś ca sāyakān । hanūmantam abhipretya jagāma raṇapaṇḍitaḥ ॥21॥

variants.southern_text: āyantaṃ sa rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā tūrṇam indradhvajaṃ kapiḥ । nanāda ca mahānādaṃ vyavardhata ca vegavān ॥24॥

variants.southern_text: tataḥ sametāv atitīkṣṇavegau । mahābalau tau raṇanirviśaṅkau । kapiś ca rakṣo'dhipates tanūjaḥ । surāsurendrāv iva baddhavairau ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: sa tasya vīrasya mahārathasyā; dhanuṣmataḥ saṃyati saṃmatasya śarapravegaṃ vyahanat pravṛddhaś; cacāra mārge pitur aprameyaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa tasya vīrasya mahārathasyā । dhanuṣmataḥ saṃyati sammatasya । śarapravegaṃ vyahanat pravṛddhaś । cacāra mārge pitur aprameyaḥ ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ śarān āyatatīkṣṇaśalyān; supatriṇaḥ kāñcanacitrapuṅkhān mumoca vīraḥ paravīrahantā; susaṃtatān vajranipātavegān
variants.southern_text: tataḥ śarān āyatatīkṣṇaśalyān । supatriṇaḥ kāñcanacitrapuṅkhān । mumoca vīraḥ paravīrahantā । susaṃtatān vajrasamānavegān ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: sa tasya tat syandananiḥsvanaṃ ca; mṛdaṅgabherīpaṭahasvanaṃ ca vikṛṣyamāṇasya ca kārmukasya; niśamya ghoṣaṃ punar utpapāta
variants.southern_text: tataḥ sa tatsyandananiḥsvanaṃ ca । mṛdaṅgabherīpaṭahasvanaṃ ca । vikṛṣyamāṇasya ca kārmukasya । niśamya ghoṣaṃ punar utpapāta ॥29॥

variants.southern_text: śarāṇām antareṣv āśu vyavartata mahākapiḥ । haris tasyābhilakṣyasya mokṣayaṃl lakṣyasaṃgraham ॥30॥

variants.southern_text: tāv ubhau vegasampannau raṇakarmaviśāradau । sarvabhūtamanogrāhi cakratur yuddham uttamam ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ paitāmahāṃ vīraḥ so 'stram astravidāṃ varaḥ saṃdadhe sumahātejās taṃ haripravaraṃ prati
variants.southern_text: tataḥ paitāmahaṃ vīraḥ so 'stram astravidāṃ varaḥ । saṃdadhe sumahātejās taṃ haripravaraṃ prati ॥36॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ svāyambhuvair mantrair brahmāstram abhimantritam hanūmāṃś cintayām āsa varadānaṃ pitāmahāt
variants.southern_text: tataḥ svāyambhuvair mantrair brahmāstram cābhimantritam । hanūmāṃś cintayām āsa varadānaṃ pitāmahāt ॥40॥

variants.critical_text: na me 'strabandhasya ca śaktir asti; vimokṣaṇe lokaguroḥ prabhāvāt ity evam evaṃvihito 'strabandho; mayātmayoner anuvartitavyaḥ
variants.southern_text: na me 'sya bandhasya ca śaktir asti । vimokṣaṇe lokaguroḥ prabhāvāt । ity evam evaṃ vihito 'strabandho । mayātmayoner anuvartitavyaḥ ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: tatas taṃ rākṣasā dṛṣṭvā nirviceṣṭam ariṃdamam babandhuḥ śaṇavalkaiś ca drumacīraiś ca saṃhataiḥ
variants.southern_text: tatas te rākṣasā dṛṣṭvā nirviceṣṭam ariṃdamam । babandhuḥ śaṇavalkaiś ca drumacīraiś ca saṃhataiḥ ॥46॥

variants.critical_text: sa rocayām āsa paraiś ca bandhanaṃ; prasahya vīrair abhinigrahaṃ ca kautūhalān māṃ yadi rākṣasendro; draṣṭuṃ vyavasyed iti niścitārthaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa rocayām āsa paraiś ca bandhaṃ । prasahya vīrair abhigarhaṇaṃ ca । kautūhalān māṃ yadi rākṣasendro । draṣṭuṃ vyavasyed iti niścitārthaḥ ॥47॥
