variants.critical_text: tataḥ sa karmaṇā tasya vismito bhīmavikramaḥ hanumān roṣatāmrākṣo rakṣo'dhipam avaikṣata
variants.southern_text: tataḥ sa karmaṇā tasya vismito bhīmavikramaḥ । hanumān krodhatāmrākṣo rakṣo'dhipam avaikṣata ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: vipulair darśanīyaiś ca rakṣākṣair bhīmadarśanaiḥ dīptatīkṣṇamahādaṃṣṭraiḥ pralambadaśanacchadaiḥ

variants.critical_text: upopaviṣṭaṃ rakṣobhiś caturbhir baladarpitaiḥ kṛtsnaiḥ parivṛtaṃ lokaṃ caturbhir iva sāgaraiḥ

variants.southern_text: sa taiḥ sampīḍyamāno 'pi rakṣobhir bhīmavikramaiḥ । vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā rakṣo'dhipam avaikṣata ॥15॥

variants.southern_text: yadi vaiśravaṇasya tvaṃ yamasya varuṇasya ca । cārurūpam idaṃ kṛtvā praviṣto naḥ purīm imām ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: jyeṣṭhas tasya mahābāhuḥ putraḥ priyakaraḥ prabhuḥ pitur nideśān niṣkrāntaḥ praviṣṭo daṇḍakāvanam

variants.critical_text: sa mārgamāṇas tāṃ devīṃ rājaputraḥ sahānujaḥ ṛśyamūkam anuprāptaḥ sugrīveṇa ca saṃgataḥ
variants.southern_text: sa mārgamāṇas tu devīṃ rājaputraḥ sahānujaḥ । ṛśyamūkam anuprāptaḥ sugrīveṇa ca saṃgataḥ ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: sa sītāmārgaṇe vyagraḥ sugrīvaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ harīn saṃpreṣayām āsa diśaḥ sarvā harīśvaraḥ
variants.southern_text: sa sītāmārgaṇe vyagraḥ sugrīvaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ । harīn sampreṣayām āsa diśaḥ sarvā harīśvaraḥ ॥12॥

variants.southern_text: lakṣiteyaṃ mayā sītā tathā śokaparāyaṇā । gṛhe yāṃ nābhijānāsi pañcāsyām iva pannagīm ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: neyaṃ jarayituṃ śakyā sāsurair amarair api viṣasaṃsṛṣṭam atyarthaṃ bhuktam annam ivaujasā
variants.southern_text: neyaṃ jarayituṃ śakyā sāsurair amarair api । viṣasaṃspṛṣṭam atyarthaṃ bhuktam annam ivaujasā ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: tapaḥsaṃtāpalabdhas te yo 'yaṃ dharmaparigrahaḥ na sa nāśayituṃ nyāyya ātmaprāṇaparigrahaḥ
variants.southern_text: tapaḥsaṃtāpalabdhas te so 'yaṃ dharmaparigrahaḥ । na sa nāśayituṃ nyāyya ātmaprāṇaparigrahaḥ ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: mānuṣo rāghavo rājan sugrīvaś ca harīśvaraḥ tasmāt prāṇaparitrāṇaṃ kathaṃ rājan kariṣyasi
variants.southern_text: sugrīvo na ca devo 'yaṃ na yakṣo na ca rākṣasaḥ । mānuṣo rāghavo rājan sugrīvaś ca harīśvaraḥ । tasmāt prāṇaparitrāṇaṃ kathaṃ rājan kariṣyasi ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: janasthānavadhaṃ buddhvā buddhvā vālivadhaṃ tathā rāmasugrīvasakhyaṃ ca budhyasva hitam ātmanaḥ
variants.southern_text: janasthānavadhaṃ buddhvā vālinaś ca vadhaṃ tathā । rāmasugrīvasakhyaṃ ca budhyasva hitam ātmanaḥ ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: kāmaṃ khalv aham apy ekaḥ savājirathakuñjarām laṅkāṃ nāśayituṃ śaktas tasyaiṣa tu viniścayaḥ
variants.southern_text: kāmaṃ khalv aham apy ekaḥ savājirathakuñjarām । laṅkāṃ nāśayituṃ śaktas tasyaiṣa tu na niścayaḥ ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: yāṃ sītety abhijānāsi yeyaṃ tiṣṭhati te vaśe kālarātrīti tāṃ viddhi sarvalaṅkāvināśinīm
variants.southern_text: yāṃ sītety abhijānāsi yeyaṃ tiṣṭhati te gṛhe । kālarātrīti tāṃ viddhi sarvalaṅkāvināśinīm ॥34॥

variants.critical_text: tad alaṃ kālapāśena sītā vigraharūpiṇā svayaṃ skandhāvasaktena kṣamam ātmani cintyatām
variants.southern_text: tad alaṃ kālapāśena sītāvigraharūpiṇā । svayaṃ skandhāvasaktena kṣemam ātmani cintyatām ॥35॥

variants.critical_text: sītāyās tejasā dagdhāṃ rāmakopaprapīḍitām dahyamanām imāṃ paśya purīṃ sāṭṭapratolikām
variants.southern_text: sītāyās tejasā dagdhāṃ rāmakopapradīpitām । dahyamanām imāṃ paśya purīṃ sāṭṭapratolikām ॥36॥

variants.critical_text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vānarasya mahātmanaḥ ājñāpayad vadhaṃ tasya rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vānarasya mahātmanaḥ । ājñāpayad vadhaṃ tasya rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: niścitārthas tataḥ sāmnāpūjya śatrujidagrajam uvāca hitam atyarthaṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ
variants.southern_text: niścitārthas tataḥ sāmnā pūjya śatrujid agrajam । uvāca hitam atyarthaṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: vairūpyām aṅgeṣu kaśābhighāto; mauṇḍyaṃ tathā lakṣmaṇasaṃnipātaḥ etān hi dūte pravadanti daṇḍān; vadhas tu dūtasya na naḥ śruto 'pi
variants.southern_text: vairūpyām aṅgeṣu kaśābhighāto । mauṇḍyaṃ tathā lakṣmaṇasaṃnipātaḥ । etān hi dūte pravadanti daṇḍān । vadhas tu dūtasya na naḥ śruto 'sti ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: kathaṃ ca dharmārthavinītabuddhiḥ; parāvarapratyayaniścitārthaḥ bhavadvidhaḥ kopavaśe hi tiṣṭhet; kopaṃ niyacchanti hi sattvavantaḥ
variants.southern_text: kathaṃ ca dharmārthavinītabuddhiḥ । parāvarapratyayaniścitārthaḥ । bhavadvidhaḥ kopavaśe hi tiṣṭhet । kopaṃ na gacchanti hi sattvavantaḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: na dharmavāde na ca lokavṛtte; na śāstrabuddhigrahaṇeṣu vāpi vidyeta kaś cit tava vīratulyas; tvaṃ hy uttamaḥ sarvasurāsurāṇām
variants.southern_text: na dharmavāde na ca lokavṛtte । na śāstrabuddhigrahaṇeṣu vāpi । vidyeta kaś cit tava vīra tulyas । tvaṃ hy uttamaḥ sarvasurāsurāṇām ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: sādhur vā yadi vāsādhur parair eṣa samarpitaḥ bruvan parārthaṃ paravān na dūto vadham arhati
variants.southern_text: sādhur vā yadi vāsādhuḥ parair eṣa samarpitaḥ । bruvan parārthaṃ paravān na dūto vadham arhati ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: api cāsmin hate rājan nānyaṃ paśyāmi khecaram iha yaḥ punar āgacchet paraṃ pāraṃ mahodadhiḥ
variants.southern_text: api cāsmin hate nānyaṃ rājan paśyāmi khecaram । iha yaḥ punar āgacchet paraṃ pāraṃ mahodadheḥ ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: asmin vinaṣṭe na hi dūtam anyaṃ; paśyāmi yas tau nararājaputrau yuddhāya yuddhapriyadurvinītāv; udyojayed dīrghapathāvaruddhau
variants.southern_text: asmin vinaṣṭe na hi dūtam anyaṃ । paśyāmi yas tau nararājaputrau । yuddhāya yuddhapriya durvinītāv । udyojayed vai bhavatā viruddhau ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: parākramotsāhamanasvināṃ ca; surāsurāṇām api durjayena tvayā manonandana nairṛtānāṃ; yuddhāyatir nāśayituṃ na yuktā
variants.southern_text: parākramotsāhamanasvināṃ ca । surāsurāṇām api durjayena । tvayā manonandana nairṛtānāṃ । yuddhāya nirnāśayituṃ na yuktam ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: hitāś ca śūrāś ca samāhitāś ca; kuleṣu jātāś ca mahāguṇeṣu manasvinaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhāḥ; koṭyagraśaste subhṛtāś ca yodhāḥ
variants.southern_text: hitāś ca śūrāś ca samāhitāś ca । kuleṣu jātāś ca mahāguṇeṣu । manasvinaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhāḥ । kopapraśastāḥ subhṛtāś ca yodhāḥ ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: tad ekadeśena balasya tāvat; ke cit tavādeśakṛto 'payāntu tau rājaputrau vinigṛhya mūḍhau; pareṣu te bhāvayituṃ prabhāvam
variants.southern_text: tad ekadeśena balasya tāvat । ke cit tavādeśakṛto 'dya yāntu । tau rājaputrāv upagṛhya mūḍhau । pareṣu te bhāvayituṃ prabhāvam ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā daśagrīvo mahābalaḥ deśakālahitaṃ vākyaṃ bhrātur uttamam abravīt
variants.southern_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā daśagrīvo mahābalaḥ । deśakālahitaṃ vākyaṃ bhrātur uttamam abravīt ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ paśyantv imaṃ dīnam aṅgavairūpyakarśitam samitrā jñātayaḥ sarve bāndhavāḥ sasuhṛjjanāḥ
variants.southern_text: tataḥ paśyantv imaṃ dīnam aṅgavairūpyakarśitam । sumitrajñātayaḥ sarve bāndhavāḥ sasuhṛjjanāḥ ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rākṣasāḥ kopakarkaśāḥ veṣṭante tasya lāṅgūlaṃ jīrṇaiḥ kārpāsikaiḥ paṭaiḥ
variants.southern_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rākṣasāḥ kopakarkaśāḥ । veṣṭante tasya lāṅgūlaṃ jīrṇaiḥ kārpāsikaiḥ paṭaiḥ ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: tailena pariṣicyātha te 'gniṃ tatrāvapātayan
variants.southern_text: tailena pariṣicyātha te 'gniṃ tatrāvapātayan । lāṅgūlena pradīptena rākṣasāṃs tān apātayat ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: kāmaṃ khalu na me śaktā nibadhasyāpi rākṣasāḥ chittvā pāśān samutpatya hanyām aham imān punaḥ
variants.southern_text: kāmaṃ khalu na me śaktā nibaddhasyāpi rākṣasāḥ । chittvā pāśān samutpatya hanyām aham imān punaḥ ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: yady asti patiśuśrūṣā yady asti caritaṃ tapaḥ yadi cāsty ekapatnītvaṃ śīto bhava hanūmataḥ
variants.southern_text: upatasthe viśālākṣī prayatā havyavāhanam । yady asti patiśuśrūṣā yady asti caritaṃ tapaḥ । yadi vā tv ekapatnītvaṃ śīto bhava hanūmataḥ ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: yadi kaś cid anukrośas tasya mayy asti dhīmataḥ yadi vā bhāgyaśeṣaṃ me śīto bhava hanūmataḥ
variants.southern_text: yadi kaś cid anukrośas tasya mayy asti dhīmataḥ । yadi vā bhāgyaśeṣo me śīto bhava hanūmataḥ ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: yadi māṃ vṛttasaṃpannāṃ tatsamāgamalālasām sa vijānāti dharmātmā śīto bhava hanūmataḥ
variants.southern_text: yadi māṃ vṛttasampannāṃ tatsamāgamalālasām । sa vijānāti dharmātmā śīto bhava hanūmataḥ ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: yadi māṃ tārayaty āryaḥ sugrīvaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ asmād duḥkhān mahābāhuḥ śīto bhava hanūmataḥ
variants.southern_text: yadi māṃ tārayed āryaḥ sugrīvaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ । asmād duḥkhāmbusaṃrodhāc chīto bhava hanūmataḥ ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tīkṣṇārcir avyagraḥ pradakṣiṇaśikho 'nalaḥ jajvāla mṛgaśāvākṣyāḥ śaṃsann iva śivaṃ kapeḥ
variants.southern_text: tatas tīkṣṇārcir avyagraḥ pradakṣiṇaśikho 'nalaḥ । jajvāla mṛgaśāvākṣyāḥ śaṃsann iva śubhaṃ kapeḥ ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: dṛśyate ca mahājvālaḥ karoti ca na me rujam śiśirasyeva saṃpāto lāṅgūlāgre pratiṣṭhitaḥ
variants.southern_text: dṛśyate ca mahājvālaḥ karoti ca na me rujam । śiśirasyeva sampāto lāṅgūlāgre pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥34॥

variants.critical_text: yadi tāvat samudrasya mainākasya ca dhīmatha rāmārthaṃ saṃbhramas tādṛk kim agnir na kariṣyati
variants.southern_text: yadi tāvat samudrasya mainākasya ca dhīmataḥ । rāmārthaṃ sambhramas tādṛk kim agnir na kariṣyati ॥36॥

variants.critical_text: bhūyaḥ sa cintayām āsa muhūrtaṃ kapikuñjaraḥ utpapātātha vegena nanāda ca mahākapiḥ
variants.southern_text: bhūyaḥ sa cintayām āsa muhūrtaṃ kapikuñjaraḥ । katham asmadvidhasyeha bandhanaṃ rakṣasādhamaiḥ ॥38॥

variants.critical_text: sa taṃ gṛhya mahābāhuḥ kālāyasapariṣkṛtam rakṣiṇas tān punaḥ sarvān sūdayām āsa mārutiḥ
variants.southern_text: vīkṣamāṇaś ca dadṛśe parighaṃ toraṇāśritam । sa taṃ gṛhya mahābāhuḥ kālāyasapariṣkṛtam । rakṣiṇas tān punaḥ sarvān sūdayām āsa mārutiḥ ॥43॥

variants.critical_text: sa tān nihatvā raṇacaṇḍavikramaḥ; samīkṣamāṇaḥ punar eva laṅkām pradīptalāṅgūlakṛtārcimālī; prakāśatāditya ivāṃśumālī
variants.southern_text: sa tān nihatvā raṇacaṇḍavikramaḥ । samīkṣamāṇaḥ punar eva laṅkām । pradīptalāṅgūlakṛtārcimālī । prakāśitāditya ivārcimālī ॥44॥

variants.critical_text: mumoca hanumān agniṃ kālānalaśikhopamam
variants.southern_text: tato 'nyat pupluve veśma mahāpārśvasya vīryavān । mumoca hanumān agniṃ kālānalaśikhopamam ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: pradīptam agniṃ pavanas teṣu veśmasu cārayat
variants.southern_text: pradīptam agniṃ pavanas teṣu veśmasu cārayat । tāni kāñcanajālāni muktāmaṇimayāni ca ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: hutāśanajvālasamāvṛtā sā; hatapravīrā parivṛttayodhā hanūmātaḥ krodhabalābhibhūtā; babhūva śāpopahateva laṅkā
variants.southern_text: hutāśanajvālasamāvṛtā sā । hatapravīrā parivṛttayodhā । hanūmataḥ krodhabalābhibhūtā । babhūva śāpopahateva laṅkā ॥41॥

variants.critical_text: sasaṃbhramaṃ trastaviṣaṇṇarākṣasāṃ; samujjvalaj jvālahutāśanāṅkitām dadarśa laṅkāṃ hanumān mahāmanāḥ; svayambhukopopahatām ivāvanim
variants.southern_text: sasambhramaṃ trastaviṣaṇṇarākṣasāṃ । samujjvalajjvālahutāśanāṅkitām । dadarśa laṅkāṃ hanuman mahāmanāḥ । svayambhūroṣopahatām ivāvanim ॥42॥

variants.critical_text: sa rākṣasāṃs tān subahūṃś ca hatvā; vanaṃ ca bhaṅktvā bahupādapaṃ tat visṛjya rakṣo bhavaneṣu cāgniṃ; jagāma rāmaṃ manasā mahātmā
variants.southern_text: sa rākṣasāṃs tān subahūṃś ca hatvā । vanaṃ ca bhaṅktvā bahupādapaṃ tat । visṛjya rakṣobhavaneṣu cāgniṃ । jagāma rāmaṃ manasā mahatmā ॥44॥

variants.critical_text: laṅkāṃ samastāṃ saṃdīpya lāṅgūlāgniṃ mahākapiḥ nirvāpayām āsa tadā samudre harisattamaḥ
variants.southern_text: laṅkāṃ samastāṃ saṃdīpya lāṅgūlāgniṃ mahākapiḥ । nirvāpayām āsa tadā samudre haripuṃgavaḥ ॥49॥

variants.critical_text: saṃdīpyamānāṃ vidhvastāṃ trastarakṣo gaṇāṃ purīm avekṣya hānumāṃl laṅkāṃ cintayām āsa vānaraḥ
variants.southern_text: saṃdīpyamānāṃ vidhvastāṃ trastarakṣāṇaṃ purīm । avekṣya hānumāṃl laṅkāṃ cintayām āsa vānaraḥ ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: dhanyās te puruṣaśreṣṭha ye buddhyā kopam utthitam nirundhanti mahātmāno dīptam agnim ivāmbhasā
variants.southern_text: dhanyāḥ khalu mahātmāno ye buddhyā kopam utthitam । nirundhanti mahātmāno dīptam agnim ivāmbhasā ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: yadi dagdhā tv iyaṃ laṅkā nūnam āryāpi jānakī dagdhā tena mayā bhartur hataṃ kāryam ajānatā
variants.southern_text: yadi dagdhā tv iyaṃ sarvā nūnam āryāpi jānakī । dagdhā tena mayā bhartur hataṃ kāryam ajānatā ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: yadi tad vihataṃ kāryaṃ mayā prajñāviparyayāt ihaiva prāṇasaṃnyāso mamāpi hy atirocate
variants.southern_text: yadi tad vihataṃ kāryaṃ mayā prajñāviparyayāt । ihaiva prāṇasaṃnyāso mamāpi hy adya rocate ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: kim agnau nipatāmy adya āhosvid vaḍavāmukhe śarīram āho sattvānāṃ dadmi sāgaravāsinām
variants.southern_text: kim agnau nipatāmy adya āhosvid vaḍavāmukhe । śarīram iha sattvānāṃ dadmi sāgaravāsinām ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: kathaṃ hi jīvatā śakyo mayā draṣṭuṃ harīśvaraḥ tau vā puruṣaśārdūlau kāryasarvasvaghātinā
variants.southern_text: kathaṃ nu jīvatā śakyo mayā draṣṭuṃ harīśvaraḥ । tau vā puruṣaśārdūlau kāryasarvasvaghātinā ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: mayā khalu tad evedaṃ roṣadoṣāt pradarśitam prathitaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kapitam anavasthitam
variants.southern_text: mayā khalu tad evedaṃ roṣadoṣāt pradarśitam । prathitaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kapitvam anavasthitam ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: na hi dharmān manas tasya bhāryām amitatejasaḥ svacāritrābhiguptāṃ tāṃ spraṣṭum arhati pāvakaḥ
variants.southern_text: na hi dharmātmanas tasya bhāryām amitatejasaḥ । svacāritrābhiguptāṃ tāṃ spraṣṭum arhati pāvakaḥ ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: tapasā satyavākyena ananyatvāc ca bhartari api sā nirdahed agniṃ na tām agniḥ pradhakṣyati
variants.southern_text: tapasā satyavākyena ananyatvāc ca bhartari । asau nirdahed agniṃ na tām agniḥ pradhakṣyati ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: sa tathā cintayaṃs tatra devyā dharmaparigraham śuśrāva hanumān vākyaṃ cāraṇānāṃ mahātmanām
variants.southern_text: sa tathā cintayaṃs tatra devyā dharmaparigraham । śuśrāva hanumāṃs tatra cāraṇānāṃ mahātmanām ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: aho khalu kṛtaṃ karma durviṣahyaṃ hanūmatā agniṃ visṛjatābhīkṣṇaṃ bhīmaṃ rākṣasasadmani
variants.southern_text: aho khalu kṛtaṃ karma durvigāhaṃ hanūmatā । agniṃ visṛjatā tīkṣṇaṃ bhīmaṃ rākṣasasadmani ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: sa nimittaiś ca dṛṣṭārthaiḥ kāraṇaiś ca mahāguṇaiḥ ṛṣivākyaiś ca hanumān abhavat prītamānasaḥ
variants.southern_text: nimittaiś ca dṛṣṭārthaiḥ kāraṇaiś ca mahāguṇaiḥ । ṛṣivākyaiś ca hanumān abhavat prītamānasaḥ ॥34॥

variants.critical_text: tatas taṃ prasthitaṃ sītā vīkṣamāṇā punaḥ punaḥ bhartṛsnehānvitaṃ vākyaṃ hanūmantam abhāṣata
variants.southern_text: tatas taṃ prasthitaṃ sītā vīkṣamāṇā punaḥ punaḥ । bhartuḥ snehānvitaṃ vākyaṃ hanūmantam abhāṣata ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: tad yathā tasya vikrāntam anurūpaṃ mahātmanaḥ bhavaty āhavaśūrasya tattvam evopapādaya
variants.southern_text: tad yathā tasya vikrāntam anurūpaṃ mahātmanaḥ । bhavaty āhavaśūrasya tathā tvam upapādaya ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: tad arthopahitaṃ vākyaṃ praśritaṃ hetusaṃhitam niśamya hanumāṃs tasyā vākyam uttaram abravīt
variants.southern_text: tad arthopahitaṃ vākyaṃ praśritaṃ hetusaṃhitam । niśamya hanumān vīro vākyam uttaram abravīt ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: kṣipram eṣyati kākutstho haryṛkṣapravarair vṛtaḥ yas te yudhi vijityārīñ śokaṃ vyapanayiṣyati
variants.southern_text: kṣipram eṣyati kākutstho haryṛkṣapravarair yutaḥ । yas te yudhi vijityārīñ śokaṃ vyapanayiṣyati ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: tasyoruvegān mathitāḥ pādapāḥ puṣpaśālinaḥ nipetur bhūtale rugṇāḥ śakrāyudhahatā iva
variants.southern_text: tasyoruvegān mathitāḥ pādapāḥ puṣpaśālinaḥ । nipetur bhūtale bhagnāḥ śakrāyudhahatā iva ॥44॥

variants.critical_text: srastavyāviddhavasanā vyākulīkṛtabhūṣaṇā vidyādharyaḥ samutpetuḥ sahasā dharaṇīdharāt
variants.southern_text: srastavyāviddhavasanā vyākulīkṛtabhūṣaṇāḥ । vidyādharyaḥ samutpetuḥ sahasā dharaṇīdharāt ॥46॥

variants.critical_text: vātasaṃghātajātormiṃ candrāṃśuśiśirāmbumat bhujaṃgayakṣagandharvaprabuddhakamalotpalam
variants.southern_text: vātasaṃghātajātormicandrāṃśuśiśirāmbumat । hanūmān apariśrāntaḥ pupluve gaganārnavam ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: grasamāna ivākāśaṃ tārādhipam ivālikhan harann iva sanakṣatraṃ gaganaṃ sārkamaṇḍalam
variants.southern_text: grasamāna ivākāśaṃ tārādhipam ivollikhan । harann iva sanakṣatraṃ gaganaṃ sārkamaṇḍalam ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: mārutasyālayaṃ śrīmān kapir vyomacaro mahān hanūmān meghajālāni vikarṣann iva gacchati
variants.southern_text: apāramapariśrāntaś cāmbudhiṃ samagāhata । hanūmān meghajālāni vikarṣann iva gacchati ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: praviśann abhrajālāni niṣkramaṃś ca punaḥ punaḥ pracchannaś ca prakāśaś ca candramā iva lakṣyate
variants.southern_text: praviśann abhrajālāni niṣkramaṃś ca punaḥ punaḥ । prakāśaś cāprakāśaś ca candramā iva dṛśyate ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: nadan nādena mahatā meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ ājagāma mahātejāḥ punar madhyena sāgaram
variants.southern_text: nadan nadeva mahatā meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ । sa taṃ deśam anuprāptaḥ suhṛddarśanalālasaḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: tasyā bāhūruvegaṃ ca ninādaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ niśamya harayo hṛṣṭāḥ samutpetus tatas tataḥ
variants.southern_text: tasyā bāhūruvegaṃ ca ninādaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ । niśamya harayo hṛṣṭāḥ samutpetur yatas tataḥ ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: te prītāḥ pādapāgreṣu gṛhya śākhāḥ supuṣpitāḥ vāsāṃsīva prakāśāni samāvidhyanta vānarāḥ
variants.southern_text: te prītāḥ pādapāgreṣu gṛhya śākhām avasthitāḥ । vāsāṃsi ca prakāśāni samāvidhyanta vānarāḥ ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tu vegavāṃs tasya girer girinibhaḥ kapiḥ nipapāta mahendrasya śikhare pādapākule
variants.southern_text: tatas tu vegavān vīro girer girinibhaḥ kapiḥ । nipapāta gires tasya śikhare pādapākule ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: tatas te prītamanasaḥ sarve vānarapuṃgavāḥ hanūmantaṃ mahātmānaṃ parivāryopatasthire
variants.southern_text: tatas te prītamanasaḥ sarve vānarapumgavāḥ । hanūmantam mahātmānam parivāryopatasthire ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: parivārya ca te sarve parāṃ prītim upāgatāḥ prahṛṣṭavadanāḥ sarve tam arogam upāgatam
variants.southern_text: parivārya ca te sarve parāṃ prītim upāgatāḥ । prahṛṣṭavadanāḥ sarve tam āgatam upāgaman ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: vinedur muditāḥ ke cic cakruḥ kila kilāṃ tathā hṛṣṭāḥ pādapaśākhāś ca āninyur vānararṣabhāḥ
variants.southern_text: vinedur muditāḥ kecit kecit kilakilāṃ tathā । hṛṣṭāḥ pādapaśākhāś ca āninyur vānararṣabhāḥ ॥34॥

variants.critical_text: hanūmāṃs tu gurūn vṛddhāñ jāmbavat pramukhāṃs tadā kumāram aṅgadaṃ caiva so 'vandata mahākapiḥ
variants.southern_text: hanūmāṃs tu gurūn vṛddhāñ jāmbavatpramukhāṃs tadā । kumāram angadaṃ caiva so 'vandata mahākapiḥ ॥35॥

variants.critical_text: hanūmān abravīd dhṛṣṭas tadā tān vānararṣabhān aśokavanikāsaṃsthā dṛṣṭā sā janakātmajā
variants.southern_text: hanūmān abravīd pṛṣṭas tadā tān vānararṣabhān । aśokavanikāsaṃsthā dṛṣṭā sā janakātmajā ॥38॥

variants.critical_text: diṣṭyā dṛṣṭā tvayā devī rāmapatnī yaśasvinī diṣṭyā tyakṣyati kākutsthaḥ śokaṃ sītā viyogajam
variants.southern_text: diṣṭyā dṛṣṭā tvayā devī rāmapatnī yaśasvinī । diṣṭyā tyakṣyati kākutsthaḥ śokaṃ sītāviyogajam ॥48॥

variants.critical_text: tattvataḥ sarvam etan naḥ prabrūhi tvaṃ mahākape śrutārthāś cintayiṣyāmo bhūyaḥ kāryaviniścayam
variants.southern_text: sammārgitā kathaṃ devī kiṃ ca sā pratyabhāṣata । śrutārthāś cintayiṣyāmo bhūyaḥ kāryaviniścayam ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: sthitaṃ panthānam āvṛtya mene vighnaṃ ca taṃ nagam
variants.southern_text: sthitaṃ panthānam āvṛtya mene vighnaṃ ca taṃ nagam । upasaṃgamya taṃ divyaṃ kāñcanaṃ nagam uttamam ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: kartum arhasi rāmasya sāhyaṃ viṣayavāsini
variants.southern_text: kartum arhasi rāmasya sāhayyaṃ viṣaye satī । atha vā maithilīṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ cākliṣṭakāriṇam ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: tato me buddhir utpannā kiṃ nāma gamane mama īdṛśo vighna utpanno rūpaṃ yatra na dṛśyate
variants.southern_text: atha me buddhir utpannā kiṃ nāma gamane mama । īdṛśo vighna utpanno rūpam atra na dṛśyate ॥37॥

variants.critical_text: adho bhāgena me dṛṣṭiḥ śocatā pātitā mayā tato 'drākṣam ahaṃ bhīmāṃ rākṣasīṃ salile śayām
variants.southern_text: adho bhāge tu me dṛṣṭiḥ śocatā pātitā tadā । tatrādrākṣam ahaṃ bhīmāṃ rākṣasīṃ salile śayām ॥38॥

variants.critical_text: tato 'haṃ vipulaṃ rūpaṃ saṃkṣipya nimiṣāntarāt tasyā hṛdayam ādāya prapatāmi nabhastalam
variants.southern_text: tato 'haṃ vipulaṃ rūpaṃ saṃkṣipya nimiṣāntarāt । tasyā hṛdayam ādāya prapatāmi nabhaḥsthalam ॥43॥

variants.critical_text: śṛṇomi khagatānāṃ ca siddhānāṃ cāraṇaiḥ saha rākṣasī siṃhikā bhīmā kṣipraṃ hanumatā hṛtā
variants.southern_text: śṛṇomi khagatānāṃ ca vācaḥ saumyā mahātmanām । rākṣasī siṃhikā bhīmā kṣipraṃ hanumatā hatā ॥45॥

variants.critical_text: śocatā ca mayā dṛṣṭaṃ prākāreṇa samāvṛtam kāñcanena vikṛṣṭena gṛhopavanam uttamam
variants.southern_text: śocatā ca mayā dṛṣṭaṃ prākāreṇābhisaṃvṛtam । kāñcanena vikṛṣṭena gṛhopavanam uttamam ॥54॥

variants.critical_text: sa prākāram avaplutya paśyāmi bahupādapam
variants.southern_text: saprākāram avaplutya paśyāmi bahupādapam । aśokavanikāmadhye śiṃśapāpādapo mahān ॥55॥

variants.critical_text: tato rāvaṇadārāś ca rāvaṇaś ca mahābalaḥ taṃ deśaṃ samanuprāptā yatra sītābhavat sthitā
variants.southern_text: tato rāvaṇadārāś ca rāvaṇaś ca mahābalaḥ । taṃ deśaṃ samanuprāpto yatra sītābhavat sthitā ॥65॥

variants.critical_text: tām uvāca daśagrīvaḥ sītāṃ paramaduḥkhitām avākśirāḥ prapatito bahu manyasva mām iti
variants.southern_text: tām uvāca daśagrīvaḥ sītāṃ paramaduḥkhitām । avākśirāḥ prapatito bahumanyasva mām iti ॥68॥

variants.critical_text: rākṣasādhama rāmasya bhāryām amitatejasaḥ ikṣvākukulanāthasya snuṣāṃ daśarathasya ca
variants.southern_text: rākṣasādhama rāmasya bhāryām amitatejasaḥ । ikṣvākuvaṃśanāthasya snuṣāṃ daśarathasya ca ॥71॥

variants.critical_text: devagandharvakanyābhir yakṣakanyābhir eva ca sārdhaṃ prabho ramasveha sītayā kiṃ kariṣyasi
variants.southern_text: devagandharvakanyābhir yakṣakanyābhir eva ca । sārdhaṃ prabho ramasveti sītayā kiṃ kariṣyasi ॥79॥

variants.critical_text: tṛṇavad bhāṣitaṃ tāsāṃ gaṇayām āsa jānakī tarjitaṃ ca tadā tāsāṃ sītāṃ prāpya nirarthakam
variants.southern_text: tṛṇavad bhāṣitaṃ tāsāṃ gaṇayām āsa jānakī । tarjitaṃ ca tathā tāsāṃ sītāṃ prāpya nirarthakam ॥82॥

variants.critical_text: vṛthāgarjitaniśceṣṭā rākṣasyaḥ piśitāśanāḥ rāvaṇāya śaśaṃsus tāḥ sītāvyavasitaṃ mahat
variants.southern_text: vṛthā garjitaniśceṣṭā rākṣasyaḥ piśitāśanāḥ । rāvaṇāya śaśaṃsus tāḥ sītāvyavasitaṃ mahat ॥83॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tāḥ sahitāḥ sarvā vihatāśā nirudyamāḥ parikṣipya samantāt tāṃ nidrāvaśam upāgatāḥ
variants.southern_text: tatas tāḥ sahitāḥ sarvā vihatāśā nirudyamāḥ । parikliṣya samastāstā nidrāvaśam upāgatāḥ ॥84॥

variants.critical_text: tasya māṃ viddhi bhṛtyaṃ tvaṃ hanūmantam ihāgatam bhartrāhaṃ prahitas tubhyaṃ rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā
variants.southern_text: tasya māṃ viddhi bhṛtyaṃ tvaṃ hanūmantam ihāgatam । bhartrā samprahitas tubhyaṃ rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ॥98॥

variants.critical_text: etac chrutvā viditvā ca sītā janakanandinī āha rāvaṇam utsādya rāghavo māṃ nayatv iti
variants.southern_text: etac chrutvā viditvā ca sītā janakanandinī । āha rāvaṇam utpāṭya rāghavo māṃ nayatv iti ॥101॥

variants.critical_text: evam uktā varārohā maṇipravaram uttamam prāyacchat paramodvignā vācā māṃ saṃdideśa ha
variants.southern_text: ity uktvā tu varārohā maṇipravaram uttamam । prāyacchat paramodvignā vācā māṃ saṃdideśa ha ॥104॥

variants.critical_text: tato 'vardhata me kāyas tadā parvatasaṃnibhaḥ yuddhakāṅkṣī vanaṃ tac ca vināśayitum ārabhe
variants.southern_text: tato 'vardhata me kāyas tadā parvatasaṃnibhaḥ । yuddhakāṅkṣī vanaṃ tasya vināśayitum ārabhe ॥110॥

variants.critical_text: tad bhagnaṃ vanaṣaṇḍaṃ tu bhrāntatrastamṛgadvijam pratibuddhā nirīkṣante rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ
variants.southern_text: tad bhagnaṃ vanaṣaṇḍaṃ tu bhrāntatrastamṛgadvijam । pratibuddhya nirīkṣante rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ ॥111॥

variants.critical_text: durbuddhes tasya rājendra tava vipriyakāriṇaḥ vadham ājñāpaya kṣipraṃ yathāsau vilayaṃ vrajet
variants.southern_text: tasya durbuddhitā rājaṃs tava vipriyakāriṇaḥ । vadham ājñāpaya kṣipraṃ yathāsau na punar vrajet ॥114॥

variants.critical_text: teṣāṃ tu hataśeṣā ye te gatā laghuvikramāḥ nihataṃ ca mayā sainyaṃ rāvaṇāyācacakṣire
variants.southern_text: teṣāṃ tu hataśiṣtā ye te gatā laghuvikramāḥ । nihataṃ ca mayā sainyaṃ rāvaṇāyācacakṣire ॥117॥

variants.critical_text: tato me buddhir utpannā caityaprāsādam ākramam
variants.southern_text: tato me buddhir utpannā caityaprāsādam ākramam । tatrasthān rākṣasān hatvā śataṃ stambhena vai punaḥ ॥118॥

variants.critical_text: tataḥ prahastasya sutaṃ jambumālinam ādiśat
variants.southern_text: lalāmabhūto laṅkāyā mayā vidhvaṃsito ruṣā । tataḥ prahastasya sutaṃ jambumālinam ādiśat ॥119॥

variants.critical_text: mantriputrān hatāñ śrutvā samare laghuvikramān pañcasenāgragāñ śūrān preṣayām āsa rāvaṇaḥ
variants.southern_text: mantriputrān hatāñ śrutvā samare laghuvikramān । pañca senāgragāñ śūrān preṣayām āsa rāvaṇaḥ ॥123॥

variants.critical_text: tam akṣam āgataṃ bhagnaṃ niśamya sa daśānanaḥ tata indrajitaṃ nāma dvitīyaṃ rāvaṇaḥ sutam
variants.southern_text: tam akṣam āgataṃ bhagnaṃ niśamya sa daśānanaḥ । tataś cendrajitaṃ nāma dvitīyaṃ rāvaṇaḥ sutam ॥127॥

variants.critical_text: brāhmeṇāstreṇa sa tu māṃ prabadhnāc cātivegataḥ rajjūbhir abhibadhnanti tato māṃ tatra rākṣasāḥ
variants.southern_text: brāhmaṇo 'streṇa sa tu māṃ prabaddhvā cātiveginaḥ । rajjūbhiś cāpi badhnanti tato māṃ tatra rākṣasāḥ ॥131॥

variants.critical_text: rāvaṇasya samīpaṃ ca gṛhītvā mām upānayan dṛṣṭvā saṃbhāṣitaś cāhaṃ rāvaṇena durātmanā
variants.southern_text: rāvaṇasya samīpaṃ ca gṛhītvā mām upānayan । dṛṣṭvā sambhāṣitaś cāhaṃ rāvaṇena durātmanā ॥132॥

variants.critical_text: pṛṣṭaś ca laṅkāgamanaṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca tad vadham tat sarvaṃ ca mayā tatra sītārtham iti jalpitam
variants.southern_text: pṛṣṭaś ca laṅkāgamanaṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca tad vadham । tat sarvaṃ ca raṇe tatra sītārtham upajalpitam ॥133॥

variants.critical_text: asyāhaṃ darśanākāṅkṣī prāptas tvadbhavanaṃ vibho mārutasyaurasaḥ putro vānaro hanumān aham
variants.southern_text: tasyās tu darśanākāṅkṣī prāptas tvadbhavanaṃ vibho । mārutasyaurasaḥ putro vānaro hanumān aham ॥134॥

variants.critical_text: rāmadūtaṃ ca māṃ viddhi sugrīvasacivaṃ kapim so 'haṃ dautyena rāmasya tvatsamīpam ihāgataḥ
variants.southern_text: rāmadūtaṃ ca māṃ viddhi sugrīvasacivaṃ kapim । so 'haṃ dautyena rāmasya tvatsakāśam ihāgataḥ ॥135॥

variants.critical_text: vālinā hṛtarājyena sugrīveṇa saha prabhuḥ cakre 'gnisākṣikaṃ sakyaṃ rāghavaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ
variants.southern_text: vālinā hṛtarājyena sugrīveṇa saha prabhuḥ । cakre 'gnisākṣikaṃ sakhyaṃ rāghavaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ ॥140॥

variants.critical_text: tena vālinam utsādya śareṇaikena saṃyuge vānarāṇāṃ mahārājaḥ kṛtaḥ saṃplavatāṃ prabhuḥ
variants.southern_text: tena vālinam āhatya śareṇaikena saṃyuge । vānarāṇāṃ mahārājaḥ kṛtaḥ samplavatāṃ prabhuḥ ॥141॥

variants.critical_text: vānarāṇāṃ prabhavo hi na kena viditaḥ purā devatānāṃ sakāśaṃ ca ye gacchanti nimantritāḥ
variants.southern_text: vānarāṇāṃ prabhavo 'yaṃ na kena viditaḥ purā । devatānāṃ sakāśaṃ ca ye gacchanti nimantritāḥ ॥144॥

variants.critical_text: tena vadhyo 'ham ājñapto rakṣasā raudrakarmaṇā
variants.southern_text: tena vadhyo 'ham ājñapto rakṣasā raudrakarmaṇā । matprabhāvam avijñāya rāvaṇena duratmanā ॥146॥

variants.critical_text: tato vibhīṣaṇo nāma tasya bhrātā mahāmatiḥ tena rākṣasarājo 'sau yācito mama kāraṇāt
variants.southern_text: tato vibhīṣaṇo nāma tasya bhrātā mahāmatiḥ । tena rākṣasarājaś ca yācito mama kāraṇāt ॥147॥

variants.critical_text: dūtavadhyā na dṛṣṭā hi rājaśāstreṣu rākṣasa dūtena veditavyaṃ ca yathārthaṃ hitavādinā
variants.southern_text: dūtavadhyā na dṛṣṭā hi rājaśāstreṣu rākṣasa । dūtena veditavyaṃ ca yathābhihitavādinā ॥149॥

variants.critical_text: sumahaty aparādhe 'pi dūtasyātulavikramaḥ virūpakaraṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ na vadho 'stīha śāstrataḥ
variants.southern_text: sumahaty aparādhe 'pi dūtasyātulavikrama । virūpakaraṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ na vadho 'sti hi śāstrataḥ ॥150॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tasya vacaḥ śrutvā mama pucchaṃ samantataḥ veṣṭitaṃ śaṇavalkaiś ca paṭaiḥ kārpāsakais tathā
variants.southern_text: tatas tasya vacaḥ śrutvā mama pucchaṃ samantataḥ । veṣṭitaṃ śaṇavalkaiś ca paṭṭaiḥ kārpāsakais tathā ॥152॥

variants.critical_text: tato 'haṃ sumahad rūpaṃ saṃkṣipya punar ātmanaḥ vimocayitvā taṃ bandhaṃ prakṛtiṣṭhaḥ sthitaḥ punaḥ
variants.southern_text: tato 'haṃ sumahad rūpaṃ saṃkṣipya punar ātmanaḥ । vimocayitvā taṃ bandhaṃ prakṛtisthaḥ sthitaḥ punaḥ ॥156॥

variants.critical_text: āyasaṃ parighaṃ gṛhya tāni rakṣāṃsy asūdayam tatas tan nagaradvāraṃ vegenāplutavān aham
variants.southern_text: āyasaṃ parighaṃ gṛhya tāni rakṣāṃsy asūdayam । tatas tan nagaradvāraṃ vegena plutavān aham ॥157॥

variants.critical_text: pucchena ca pradīptena tāṃ purīṃ sāṭṭagopurām dahāmy aham asaṃbhrānto yugāntāgnir iva prajāḥ
variants.southern_text: pucchena ca pradīptena tāṃ purīṃ sāṭṭagopurām । dahāmy aham asambhrānto yugāntāgnir iva prajāḥ ॥158॥

variants.critical_text: tato me buddhir utpannā śrutvā tām adbhutāṃ giram punar dṛṣṭā ca vaidehī visṛṣṭaś ca tayā punaḥ
variants.southern_text: ṛṣivākyaiś ca siddhārthair abhavam hṛṣṭamānasaḥ । punar dṛṣṭā ca vaidehī visṛṣṭaś ca tayā punaḥ ॥165॥

variants.critical_text: rāghavasya prabhāvena bhavatāṃ caiva tejasā sugrīvasya ca kāryārthaṃ mayā sarvam anuṣṭhitam
variants.southern_text: rāghavasya prasādena bhavatāṃ caiva tejasā । sugrīvasya ca kāryārthaṃ mayā sarvam anuṣṭhitam ॥168॥

variants.critical_text: etat sarvaṃ mayā tatra yathāvad upapāditam atra yan na kṛtaṃ śeṣaṃ tat sarvaṃ kriyatām iti
variants.southern_text: etat sarvaṃ mayā tatra yathāvad upapāditam । tatra yan na kṛtaṃ śeṣaṃ tat sarvaṃ kriyatām iti ॥169॥

variants.critical_text: etad ākhyānaṃ tat sarvaṃ hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ bhūyaḥ samupacakrāma vacanaṃ vaktum uttaram
variants.southern_text: etad ākhyāya tat sarvaṃ hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ । bhūyaḥ samupacakrāma vacanaṃ vaktum uttaram ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: saphalo rāghavodyogaḥ sugrīvasya ca saṃbhramaḥ śīlam āsādya sītāyā mama ca plavanaṃ mahat
variants.southern_text: saphalo rāghavodyogaḥ sugrīvasya ca saṃbhramaḥ । śīlam āsādya sītāyā mama ca prīṇitaṃ manaḥ ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: sarvathātipravṛddho 'sau rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ yasya tāṃ spṛśato gātraṃ tapasā na vināśitam
variants.southern_text: sarvathātiprakṛṣṭo 'sau rāvaṇo rākṣaseṣvaraḥ । yasya tāṃ spṛśato gātraṃ tapasā na vināśitam ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: na tad agniśikhā kuryāt saṃspṛṣṭā pāṇinā satī janakasyātmajā kuryād utkrodhakaluṣīkṛtā
variants.southern_text: na tad agniśikhā kuryāt saṃspṛṣṭā pāṇinā satī । janakasya sutā kuryād yat krodhakaluṣīkṛtā ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: rākṣasībhiḥ parivṛtā śokasaṃtāpakarśitā meghalekhāparivṛtā candralekheva niṣprabhā
variants.southern_text: rākṣasībhiḥ parivṛtā śokasaṃtāpakarśitā । megharekhāparivṛtā candralekheva niṣprabhā ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: anuraktā hi vaidehī rāmaṃ sarvātmanā śubhā ananyacittā rāme ca paulomīva puraṃdare
variants.southern_text: anuraktā hi vaidehī rāme sarvātmanā śubhā । ananyacittā rāmeṇa paulomīva puraṃdare ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: tad ekavāsaḥsaṃvītā rajodhvastā tathaiva ca śokasaṃtāpadīnāṅgī sītā bhartṛhite ratā
variants.southern_text: tad ekavāsaḥsaṃvītā rajodhvastā tathaiva ca । sā mayā rākṣasīmadhye tarjyamānā muhur muhuḥ ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: niyataḥ samudācāro bhaktir bhartari cottamā
variants.southern_text: rāmasugrīvasakhyaṃ ca śrutvā prītim upāgatā । niyataḥ samudācāro bhaktir bhartari cottamā ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: evam āste mahābhāgā sītā śokaparāyaṇā yad atra pratikartavyaṃ tat sarvam upapādyatām
variants.southern_text: evam āste mahābhāgā sītā śokaparāyaṇā । yad atra pratikartavyaṃ tat sarvam upakālpyatām ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vālisūnur abhāṣata jāmbavatpramukhān sarvān anujñāpya mahākapīn
variants.southern_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā vālisūnur abhāṣata । aśviputrau mahāvegāv etau plavaṃgasattamau ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: dṛṣṭā devī na cānītā iti tatra nivedanam ayuktam iva paśyāmi bhavadbhiḥ khyātavikramaiḥ
variants.southern_text: dṛṣṭā devī na cānītā iti tatra nivedanam । na yuktam iva paśyāmi bhavadbhiḥ khyātavikramaiḥ ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: na hi vaḥ plavate kaś cin nāpi kaś cit parākrame tulyaḥ sāmaradaityeṣu lokeṣu harisattamāḥ
variants.southern_text: na hi vaḥ plavane kaś cin nāpi kaś cit parākrame । tulyaḥ sāmaradaityeṣu lokeṣu harisattamāḥ ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: prītimantas tataḥ sarve vāyuputrapuraḥsarāḥ mahendrāgraṃ parityajya pupluvuḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ
variants.southern_text: prītimantas tataḥ sarve vāyuputrapuraḥsarāḥ । mahendrāgrāt samutpatya pupluvuḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: rāghave cārthanirvṛttiṃ bhartuś ca paramaṃ yaśaḥ samādhāya samṛddhārthāḥ karmasiddhibhir unnatāḥ
variants.southern_text: rāghave cārthanirvṛttiṃ kartuṃ ca paramaṃ yaśaḥ । samādhāya samṛddhārthāḥ karmasiddhibhir unnatāḥ ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: plavamānāḥ kham āplutya tatas te kānanaukṣakaḥ nandanopamam āsedur vanaṃ drumalatāyutam
variants.southern_text: plavamānāḥ kham āplutya tatas te kānanaukṣakaḥ । nandanopamam āsedur vanaṃ drumaśatāyutam ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: yad rakṣati mahāvīryaḥ sadā dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ mātulaḥ kapimukhyasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ
variants.southern_text: yad rakṣati mahāvīraḥ sadā dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ । mātulaḥ kapimukhyasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: te tad vanam upāgamya babhūvuḥ paramotkaṭāḥ vānarā vānarendrasya manaḥkāntatamaṃ mahat
variants.southern_text: te tad vanam upāgamya babhūvuḥ paramotkaṭāḥ । vānarā vānarendrasya manaḥkāntaṃ mahāvanam ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: gāyanti ke cit praṇamanti ke cin; nṛtyanti ke cit prahasanti ke cit patanti ke cid vicaranti ke cit; plavanti ke cit pralapanti ke cit
variants.southern_text: gāyanti ke cit prahasanti ke cin । nṛtyanti ke cit praṇamanti ke cit । patanti ke cid pracaranti ke cit । plavanti ke cit pralapanti ke cit ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: parasparaṃ ke cid upāśrayante; parasparaṃ ke cid atibruvante drumād drumaṃ ke cid abhiplavante; kṣitau nagāgrān nipatanti ke cit
variants.southern_text: parasparaṃ ke cid upāśrayanti । parasparaṃ ke cid atibruvanti । drumād drumaṃ ke cid abhidravanti । kṣitau nagāgrān nipatanti ke cit ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: mahītalāt ke cid udīrṇavegā; mahādrumāgrāṇy abhisaṃpatante gāyantam anyaḥ prahasann upaiti; hasantam anyaḥ prahasann upaiti
variants.southern_text: mahītalāt ke cid udīrṇavegā । mahādrumāgrāṇy abhisampatanti । gāyantam anyaḥ prahasann upaiti । hasantam anyaḥ prarudann upaiti ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: sa taiḥ pravṛddhaiḥ paribhartsyamāno; vanasya goptā harivīravṛddhaḥ cakāra bhūyo matim ugratejā; vanasya rakṣāṃ prati vānarebhyaḥ
variants.southern_text: sa taiḥ pravṛddhaiḥ paribhartsyamāno । vanasya goptā harivṛddhavīraḥ । cakāra bhūyo matim ugratejā । vanasya rakṣāṃ prati vānarebhyaḥ ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: uvāca kāṃś cit paruṣāṇi dhṛṣṭam; asaktam anyāṃś ca talair jaghāna sametya kaiś cit kalahaṃ cakāra; tathaiva sāmnopajagāma kāṃś cit
variants.southern_text: uvāca kāṃś cit paruṣāṇy abhītam । asaktam anyāṃś ca talair jaghāna । sametya kaiś cit kalahaṃ cakāra । tathaiva sāmnopajagāma kāṃś cit ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: sa tair madāc cāprativārya vegair; balāc ca tenāprativāryamāṇaiḥ pradharṣitas tyaktabhayaiḥ sametya; prakṛṣyate cāpy anavekṣya doṣam
variants.southern_text: sa tair madād aprativāryavegair । balāc ca tenāprativāryamāṇaiḥ । pradharṣane tyaktabhayaiḥ sametya । prakṛṣyate cāpy anavekṣya doṣam ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: nakhais tudanto daśanair daśantas; talaiś ca pādaiś ca samāpnuvantaḥ madāt kapiṃ taṃ kapayaḥ samagrā; mahāvanaṃ nirviṣayaṃ ca cakruḥ
variants.southern_text: nakhais tudanto daśanair daśantas । talaiś ca pādaiś ca samāpayantaḥ । madāt kapiṃ te kapayaḥ samantān । mahāvanaṃ nirviṣayaṃ ca cakruḥ ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: utpatya ca tataḥ sarve vanapālān samāgatāḥ tāḍayanti sma śataśaḥ saktān madhuvane tadā
variants.southern_text: utpatya ca tataḥ sarve vanapālān samāgatān । te tāḍayantaḥ śataśaḥ saktā madhuvane tadā ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: madhūni droṇamātrāṇi bahubhiḥ parigṛhya te ghnanti sma sahitāḥ sarve bhakṣayanti tathāpare
variants.southern_text: madhūni droṇamātrāṇi bahubhiḥ parigṛhya te । pibanti kapayaḥ kecit saṃghaśas tatra hṛṣṭavat ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: hanūmatā dattavarair hataṃ madhuvanaṃ balāt vayaṃ ca jānubhiḥ kṛṣṭā devamārgaṃ ca darśitāḥ
variants.southern_text: abruvan paramodvignā gatvā dadhimukhaṃ vacaḥ । hanūmatā dattavarair hataṃ madhuvanaṃ balāt । vayaṃ ca jānubhiḥ ghṛṣṭā devamārgaṃ ca darśitāḥ ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: etāgacchata gacchāmo vānarān atidarpitān balenāvārayiṣyāmo madhu bhakṣayato vayam
variants.southern_text: etāgacchata gacchāmo vānarān atidarpitān । balenāvārayiṣyāmi prabhuñjānān madhūttamam ॥19॥

variants.critical_text: madhye caiṣāṃ dadhimukhaḥ pragṛhya sumahātarum samabhyadhāvad vegenā te ca sarve plavaṃgamāḥ
variants.southern_text: madhye caiṣāṃ dadhimukhaḥ supragṛhya mahātarum । samabhyadhāvan vegenā te ca sarve plavaṃgamāḥ ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: te śilāḥ pādapāṃś cāpi pāṣāṇāṃś cāpi vānarāḥ gṛhītvābhyāgaman kruddhā yatra te kapikuñjarāḥ
variants.southern_text: te śilāḥ pādapāṃś caiva pāṣāṇān api vānarāḥ । gṛhītvābhyāgaman kruddhā yatra te kapikuñjarāḥ ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: atha dṛṣṭvā dadhimukhaṃ kruddhaṃ vānarapuṃgavāḥ abhyadhāvanta vegena hanūmatpramukhās tadā
variants.southern_text: atha dṛṣtvā dadhimukhaṃ kruddhaṃ vānarapuṃgavāḥ । abhyadhāvanta vegena hanumatpramukhās tadā ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: taṃ savṛkṣaṃ mahābāhum āpatantaṃ mahābalam āryakaṃ prāharat tatra bāhubhyāṃ kupito 'ṅgadaḥ
variants.southern_text: savṛkṣaṃ taṃ mahābāhum āpatantaṃ mahābalam । vegavantaṃ vijagraha bāhubhyāṃ kupito 'ṅgadaḥ ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: madāndhaś a na vedainam āryako 'yaṃ mameti saḥ athainaṃ niṣpipeṣāśu vegavad vasudhātale
variants.southern_text: madāndho na kṛpāṃ cakre āryako 'yaṃ mameti saḥ । athainaṃ niṣpipeṣāśu vegena vasudhātale ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: sa bhagnabāhur vimukho vihvalaḥ śoṇitokṣitaḥ mumoha sahasā vīro muhūrtaṃ kapikuñjaraḥ
variants.southern_text: sa bhagnabāhūrumukho vihvalaḥ śoṇitokṣitaḥ । pramumoha mahāvīro muhūrtaṃ kapikuñjaraḥ ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: sa kathaṃ cid vimuktas tair vānarair vānararṣabhaḥ uvācaikāntam āgamya bhṛtyāṃs tān samupāgatān
variants.southern_text: sa kathaṃ cid vimuktas tair vānarair vānararṣabhaḥ । uvācaikāntam āgatya svān bhṛtyān samupāgatān ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: ete tiṣṭhantu gacchāmo bhartā no yatra vānaraḥ sugrīvo vipulagrīvaḥ saha rāmeṇa tiṣṭhati
variants.southern_text: etāgacchata gacchāmo bhartā no yatra vānaraḥ । sugrīvo vipulagrīvaḥ saha rāmeṇa tiṣṭhati ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: sarvaṃ caivāṅgade doṣaṃ śrāvayiṣyāmi pārthiva amarṣī vacanaṃ śrutvā ghātayiṣyati vānarān
variants.southern_text: sarvaṃ caivāṅgade doṣaṃ śrāvayiṣyāma pārthive । amarṣī vacanaṃ śrutvā ghātayiṣyati vānarān ॥30॥

variants.critical_text: vadhyā hy ete durātmāno nṛpājñā paribhāvinaḥ amarṣaprabhavo roṣaḥ saphalo no bhaviṣyati
variants.southern_text: vadhyā hy ete durātmāno nṛpājñāparipanthinaḥ । amarṣaprabhavo roṣaḥ saphalo no bhaviṣyati ॥33॥

variants.critical_text: sa dīnavadano bhūtvā kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim sugrīvasya śubhau mūrdhnā caraṇau pratyapīḍayat
variants.southern_text: sa dīnavadano bhūtvā kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim । sugrīvasyāśu tau mūrdhnā caraṇau pratyapīḍayat ॥38॥

variants.critical_text: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha kasmāt tvaṃ pādayoḥ patito mama abhayaṃ te bhaved vīra satyam evābhidhīyatām
variants.southern_text: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha kasmāt tvaṃ pādayoḥ patito mama । abhayaṃ te pradāsyāmi satyam evābhidhīyatām ॥2॥

variants.critical_text: sa tu viśvāsitas tena sugrīveṇa mahātmanā utthāya ca mahāprājño vākyaṃ dadhimukho 'bravīt
variants.southern_text: sa samāśvāsitas tena sugrīveṇa mahātmanā । utthāya ca mahāprājño vākyaṃ dadhimukho 'bravīt ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: naivarkṣarajasā rājan na tvayā nāpi vālinā vanaṃ nisṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hi bhakṣitaṃ tat tu vānaraiḥ
variants.southern_text: naivarkṣarajasā rājan na tvayā na ca vālinā । vanaṃ nisṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hi nāśitaṃ tat tu vānaraiḥ ॥5॥

variants.critical_text: ebhiḥ pradharṣitāś caiva vāritā vanarakṣibhiḥ madhūny acintayitvemān bhakṣayanti pibanti ca
variants.southern_text: ebhiḥ pradharṣaṇāyāṃ ca vāritaṃ vanapālakaiḥ । mām apy acintayantayan deva bhakṣyanti vanaukasaḥ ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: śiṣṭam atrāpavidhyanti bhakṣayanti tathāpare nivāryamāṇās te sarve bhruvau vai darśayanti hi
variants.southern_text: śiṣṭam atrāpavidhyanti bhakṣayanti tathāpare । nivāryamāṇās te sarve bhrūkuṭiṃ darśayanti hi ॥8॥

variants.critical_text: ime hi saṃrabdhatarās tathā taiḥ saṃpradharṣitāḥ vārayanto vanāt tasmāt kruddhair vānarapuṃgavaiḥ
variants.southern_text: ime hi saṃrabdhatarās tadā taiḥ sampradharṣitāḥ । nivārayante vanāt tasmāt kruddhair vānarapuṃgavaiḥ ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tair bahubhir vīrair vānarair vānararṣabhāḥ saṃraktanayanaiḥ krodhād dharayaḥ saṃpracālitāḥ
variants.southern_text: tatas tair bahubhir vīrair vānarair vānararṣabhāḥ । saṃraktanayanaiḥ krodhād dharayaḥ sampracālitāḥ ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: pāṇibhir nihatāḥ ke cit ke cij jānubhir āhatāḥ prakṛṣṭāś ca yathākāmaṃ devamārgaṃ ca darśitāḥ
variants.southern_text: pāṇibhir nihatāḥ ke cit ke cij jānubhir āhatāḥ । prakṛṣṭāś ca tadā kāmaṃ devamārgaṃ ca darśitāḥ ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: evam ete hatāḥ śūrās tvayi tiṣṭhati bhartari kṛtsnaṃ madhuvanaṃ caiva prakāmaṃ taiḥ prabhakṣyate
variants.southern_text: evam ete hatāḥ śūrās tvayi tiṣṭhati bhartari । kṛtsnaṃ madhuvanaṃ caiva prakāmaṃ taiś ca bhakṣyate ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: evaṃ vijñāpyamānaṃ tu sugrīvaṃ vānararṣabham apṛcchat taṃ mahāprājño lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā
variants.southern_text: evaṃ vijñāpyamānaṃ taṃ sugrīvaṃ vānararṣabham । apṛcchat taṃ mahāprājño lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: kim ayaṃ vānaro rājan vanapaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ kaṃ cārtham abhinirdiśya duḥkhito vākyam abravīt
variants.southern_text: kim ayaṃ vānaro rājan vanapaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ । kiṃ cārtham abhinirdiśya duḥkhito vākyam abravīt ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: ārya lakṣmaṇa saṃprāha vīro dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ aṅgadapramukhair vīrair bhakṣitaṃ madhuvānaraiḥ
variants.southern_text: ārya lakṣmaṇa samprāha vīro dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ । aṅgadapramukhair vīrair bhakṣitaṃ madhu vānaraiḥ ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: naiṣām akṛtakṛtyānām īdṛśaḥ syād upakramaḥ vanaṃ yathābhipannaṃ taiḥ sādhitaṃ karma vānaraiḥ
variants.southern_text: naiṣām akṛtakāryāṇām īdṛśaḥ syād vyatikramaḥ । vanaṃ yad abhipannās te sādhitaṃ karma tad dhrūvam ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: na cāpy adṛṣṭvā vaidehīṃ viśrutāḥ puruṣarṣabha vanaṃ dātta varaṃ divyaṃ dharṣayeyur vanaukasaḥ
variants.southern_text: na cāpy adṛṣṭvā vaidehīṃ viśrutāḥ puruṣarṣabha । vanaṃ dāttavaraṃ divyaṃ dharṣayeyur vanaukasaḥ ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: prāhṛṣyata bhṛśaṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇaś ca mahāyaśāḥ śrutvā dadhimukhasyedaṃ sugrīvas tu prahṛṣya ca
variants.southern_text: prāhṛṣyata bhṛśaṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇaś ca mahāyaśāḥ । śrutvā dadhimukhasyaivaṃ sugrīvas tu prahṛṣya ca ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: icchāmi śīghraṃ hanumatpradhānān; śākhāmṛgāṃs tān mṛgarājadarpān draṣṭuṃ kṛtārthān saha rāghavābhyāṃ; śrotuṃ ca sītādhigame prayatnam
variants.southern_text: icchāmi śīghraṃ hanumatpradhānān । śākhāmṛgāṃs tān mṛgarājadarpān । praṣṭuṃ kṛtārthān saha rāghavābhyāṃ । śrotuṃ ca sītādhigame prayatnam ॥32॥

variants.critical_text: sa yathaivāgataḥ pūrvaṃ tathaiva tvarito gataḥ nipatya gaganād bhūmau tad vanaṃ praviveśa ha
variants.southern_text: sa yathaivāgataḥ pūrvaṃ tathaiva tvaritaṃ gataḥ । nipatya gaganād bhūmau tad vanaṃ praviveśa ha ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: saumya roṣo na kartavyo yad ebhir abhivāritaḥ ajñānād rakṣibhiḥ krodhād bhavantaḥ pratiṣedhitāḥ
variants.southern_text: saumya roṣo na kartavyo yad ebhir parivāraṇam । ajñānād rakṣibhiḥ krodhād bhavantaḥ pratiṣedhitāḥ ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: śaṅke śruto 'yaṃ vṛttānto rāmeṇa hariyūthapāḥ tat kṣamaṃ neha naḥ sthātuṃ kṛte kārye paraṃtapāḥ
variants.southern_text: ayaṃ ca harṣadākhyāti tena jānāmi hetunā । tat kṣamaṃ neha naḥ sthātuṃ kṛte kārye paraṃtapāḥ ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: pītvā madhu yathākāmaṃ viśrāntā vanacāriṇaḥ kiṃ śeṣaṃ gamanaṃ tatra sugrīvo yatra me guruḥ
variants.southern_text: pītvā madhu yathākāmaṃ vikrāntā vanacāriṇaḥ । kiṃ śeṣaṃ gamanaṃ tatra sugrīvo yatra vānaraḥ ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: sarve yathā māṃ vakṣyanti sametya hariyūthapāḥ tathāsmi kartā kartavye bhavadbhiḥ paravān aham
variants.southern_text: sarve yathā māṃ vakṣyanti sametya haripuṃgavāḥ । tathāsmi kartā kartavye bhavadbhiḥ paravān aham ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: bruvataś cāṅgadaś caivaṃ śrutvā vacanam avyayam prahṛṣṭamanaso vākyam idam ūcur vanaukasaḥ
variants.southern_text: bruvataś cāṅgadasyaivaṃ śrutvā vacanam uttamam । prahṛṣṭamanaso vākyam idam ūcur vanaukasaḥ ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: tava cedaṃ susadṛśaṃ vākyaṃ nānyasya kasya cit saṃnatir hi tavākhyāti bhaviṣyac chubhabhāgyatām
variants.southern_text: tava cedaṃ susadṛśaṃ vākyaṃ nānyasya kasya cit । saṃnatir hi tavākhyāti bhaviṣyacchubhayogyatām ॥20॥

variants.critical_text: evaṃ tu vadatāṃ teṣām aṅgadaḥ pratyabhāṣata bāḍhaṃ gacchāma ity uktvā utpapāta mahītalāt
variants.southern_text: evaṃ tu vadatāṃ teṣām aṅgadaḥ pratyabhāṣata । sādhu gacchāma ity uktvā kham utpetur mahābalāḥ ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: utpatantam anūtpetuḥ sarve te hariyūthapāḥ kṛtvākāśaṃ nirākāśaṃ yajñotkṣiptā ivānalāḥ
variants.southern_text: utpatantam anūtpetuḥ sarve te hariyūthapāḥ । kṛtvākāśaṃ nirākāśaṃ yantrotkṣiptā ivopalāḥ ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: na matsakāśam āgacchet kṛtye hi vinipātite yuvarājo mahābāhuḥ plavatāṃ pravaro 'ṅgadaḥ
variants.southern_text: na matsakāśam āgacchet kṛtye hi vinipātite । yuvarājo mahābāhuḥ plavatām aṅgado varaḥ ॥29॥

variants.critical_text: pitṛpaitāmahaṃ caitat pūrvakair abhirakṣitam na me madhuvanaṃ hanyād ahṛṣṭaḥ plavageśvaraḥ
variants.southern_text: pitṛpaitāmahaṃ caitat pūrvakair abhirakṣitam । na me madhuvanaṃ hanyād adṛṣṭvā janakātmajām ॥31॥

variants.critical_text: mā bhūś cintā samāyuktaḥ saṃpraty amitavikrama
variants.southern_text: hanūmāṃś cāpy adhiṣṭhātā na tatra gatir anyathā । mā bhūś cintāsamāyuktaḥ saṃpraty amitavikrama ॥35॥

variants.critical_text: prītyā ca ramamāṇo 'tha rāghavaḥ paravīrahā bahu mānena mahatā hanūmantam avaikṣata
variants.southern_text: prītyā ca parayopeto rāghavaḥ paravīrahā । bahumānena mahatā hanūmantam avaikṣata ॥45॥

variants.critical_text: rāvaṇāntaḥpure rodhaṃ rākṣasībhiś ca tarjanam rāme samanurāgaṃ ca yaś cāpi samayaḥ kṛtaḥ
variants.southern_text: rāvaṇāntaḥpure rodhaṃ rākṣasībhiś ca tarjanam । rāme samanurāgaṃ ca yathā ca niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: etad ākhyānti te sarve harayo rāma saṃnidhau vaidehīm akṣatāṃ śrutvā rāmas tūttaram abravīt
variants.southern_text: etad ākhyāya te sarvaṃ harayo rāmasaṃnidhau । vaidehīm akṣatāṃ śrutvā rāmas tūttaram abravīt ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ uvāca vākyaṃ vākyajñaḥ sītāyā darśanaṃ yathā
variants.southern_text: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ । praṇamya śīrasā devyai sītāyai tāṃ diśaṃ prati ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: vijñāpyaś ca nara vyāghro rāmo vāyusuta tvayā akhileneha yad dṛṣṭam iti mām āha jānakī
variants.southern_text: vijñāpyaḥ punar apy eṣa rāmo vāyusuta tvayā । akhilena yathā dṛṣṭam iti mām āha jānakī ॥21॥

variants.critical_text: idaṃ cāsmai pradātavyaṃ yatnāt suparirakṣitam bruvatā vacanāny evaṃ sugrīvasyopaśṛṇvataḥ
variants.southern_text: ayaṃ cāsmai pradātavyo yatnāt suparirakṣitaḥ । bruvatā vacanāny evaṃ sugrīvasyopaśṛṇvataḥ ॥22॥

variants.critical_text: eṣa cūḍāmaṇiḥ śrīmān mayā te yatnarakṣitaḥ manaḥśilāyās tikalas taṃ smarasveti cābravīt
variants.southern_text: eṣa cūḍāmaṇiḥ śrīmān mayā te yatnarakṣitaḥ । manaḥśilāyās tilakaṃ tat smarasveti cābravīt ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: eṣa niryātitaḥ śrīmān mayā te vārisaṃbhavaḥ etaṃ dṛṣṭvā pramodiṣye vyasane tvām ivānagha
variants.southern_text: eṣa niryātitaḥ śrīmān mayā te vārisambhavaḥ । enaṃ dṛṣṭvā pramodiṣye vyasane tvām ivānagha ॥24॥

variants.critical_text: iti mām abravīt sītā kṛśāṅgī dharma cāriṇī rāvaṇāntaḥpure ruddhā mṛgīvotphullalocanā
variants.southern_text: iti mām abravīt sītā kṛśāṅgī dharmacāriṇī । rāvaṇāntaḥpure ruddhā mṛgīvotphullalocanā ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: tau jātāśvāsau rājaputrau viditvā; tac cābhijñānaṃ rāghavāya pradāya devyā cākhyātaṃ sarvam evānupūrvyād; vācā saṃpūrṇaṃ vāyuputraḥ śaśaṃsa
variants.southern_text: tau jātāśvāsau rājaputrau viditvā । tac cābhijñānaṃ rāghavāya pradāya । devyā cākhyātaṃ sarvam evānupūrvyād । vācā sampūrṇaṃ vāyuputraḥ śaśaṃsa ॥28॥

variants.critical_text: yathaiva dhenuḥ sravati snehād vatsasya vatsalā tathā mamāpi hṛdayaṃ maṇiratnasya darśanāt
variants.southern_text: yathaiva dhenuḥ sravati snehād vatsasya vatsalā । tathā mamāpi hṛdayaṃ maṇiśreṣṭhasya darśanāt ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: itas tu kiṃ duḥkhataraṃ yad imaṃ vārisaṃbhavam maṇiṃ paśyāmi saumitre vaidehīm āgataṃ vinā
variants.southern_text: itas tu kiṃ duḥkhataraṃ yad imaṃ vārisambhavam । maṇiṃ paśyāmi saumitre vaidehīm āgataṃ vinā ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: kathaṃ sā mama suśroṇi bhīru bhīruḥ satī tadā bhayāvahānāṃ ghorāṇāṃ madhye tiṣṭhati rakṣasām
variants.southern_text: kathaṃ sā mama suśroṇi bhīrubhīruḥ satī tadā । bhayāvahānāṃ ghorāṇāṃ madhye tiṣṭhati rakṣasām ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: śāradas timironmukho nūnaṃ candra ivāmbudaiḥ āvṛtaṃ vadanaṃ tasyā na virājati rākṣasaiḥ
variants.southern_text: śāradas timironmukto nūnaṃ candra ivāmbudaiḥ । āvṛto vadanaṃ tasyā na virājati sāmpratam ॥13॥

variants.critical_text: madhurā madhurālāpā kim āha mama bhāminī madvihīnā varārohā hanuman kathayasva me
variants.southern_text: madhurā madhurālāpā kim āha mama bhāminī । madvihīnā varārohā hanuman kathayasva me । duḥkhād duḥkhataraṃ prāpya kathaṃ jīvati jānakī ॥15॥

variants.critical_text: sukhasuptā tvayā sārdhaṃ jānakī pūrvam utthitā vāyasaḥ sahasotpatya virarāda stanāntare
variants.southern_text: sukhasuptā tvayā sārdhaṃ jānakī pūrvam utthitā । vāyasaḥ sahasotpatya virarāda stanāntaram ॥3॥

variants.critical_text: paryāyeṇa ca suptas tvaṃ devyaṅke bharatāgraja punaś ca kila pakṣī sa devyā janayati vyathām
variants.southern_text: paryāyeṇa ca suptas tvaṃ devyaṅke bharatāgraja । punaś ca kila pakṣī sa devyā janayati vyathā ॥4॥

variants.critical_text: vāyasena ca tenaiva satataṃ bādhyamānayā bodhitaḥ kila devyās tvaṃ sukhasuptaḥ paraṃtapa
variants.southern_text: vāyasena ca tenaivaṃ satataṃ bādhyamānayā । bodhitaḥ kila devyā tvaṃ sukhasuptaḥ paraṃtapa ॥6॥

variants.critical_text: tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā mahābāho rāditāṃ ca stanāntare āśīviṣa iva kruddho niḥśvasann abhyabhāṣathāḥ
variants.southern_text: tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā mahābāho dāritāṃ ca stanāntare । āśīviṣa iva kruddhas tato vākyaṃ tvam ūcivān ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: nirīkṣamāṇaḥ sahasā vāyasaṃ samavaikṣatāḥ nakhaiḥ sarudhirais tīkṣṇair mām evābhimukhaṃ sthitam
variants.southern_text: nirīkṣamāṇaḥ sahasā vāyasaṃ samudaikṣathāḥ । nakhaiḥ sarudhirais tīkṣṇais tām evābhimukhaṃ sthitam ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: sutaḥ kila sa śakrasya vāyasaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ dharāntaracaraḥ śīghraṃ pavanasya gatau samaḥ
variants.southern_text: sutaḥ kila sa śakrasya vāyasaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ । dharāntaragataḥ śīghraṃ pavanasya gatau samaḥ ॥10॥

variants.critical_text: tatas tasmin mahābāho kopasaṃvartitekṣaṇaḥ vāyase tvaṃ kṛtvāḥ krūrāṃ matiṃ matimatāṃ vara
variants.southern_text: tatas tasmin mahābāho kopasaṃvartitekṣaṇaḥ । vāyase tvaṃ vyadhāḥ krūrāṃ matiṃ matimatāṃ vara ॥11॥

variants.critical_text: sa darbhaṃ saṃstarād gṛhya brahmāstreṇa nyayojayaḥ sa dīpta iva kālāgnir jajvālābhimukhaḥ khagam
variants.southern_text: sa darbhasaṃstarād gṛhya brahmāstreṇa nyayojayaḥ । sa dīpta iva kālāgnir jajvālābhimukhaḥ khagam ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: sa pitrā ca parityaktaḥ suraiḥ sarvair maharṣibhiḥ trīṃl lokān saṃparikramya trātāraṃ nādhigacchati
variants.southern_text: bhītaiś ca samparityaktaḥ suraiḥ sarvaiś ca vāyasaḥ । trīṃl lokān samparikramya trātāraṃ nādhigacchati ॥14॥

variants.critical_text: yathā ca sa mahābāhur māṃ tārayati rāghavaḥ asmād duḥkhāmbusaṃrodhāt tat samādhātum arhasi
variants.southern_text: yathā ca sa mahābāhur māṃ tārayati rāghavaḥ । asmād duḥkhāmbusamrodhāt tat tvam ākhyātum arhasi ॥42॥

variants.critical_text: etat tavāryā nṛparājasiṃha; sītā vacaḥ prāha viṣādapūrvam etac ca buddhvā gaditaṃ mayā tvaṃ; śraddhatsva sītāṃ kuśalāṃ samagrām
variants.southern_text: etat tavāryā nṛpa saṃyatā sā । sītā vacaḥ prāha viṣādapūrvam । etac ca buddhvā gaditaṃ mayā tvaṃ । śraddhatsva sītāṃ kuśalāṃ samagrām ॥44॥

variants.critical_text: athāham uttaraṃ devyā punar uktaḥ sasaṃbhramam tava snehān naravyāghra sauhāryād anumānya ca
variants.southern_text: athāham uttaraṃ devyā punar uktaḥ sasambhramam । tava snehān naravyāghra sauhāryād anumānya ca ॥1॥

variants.critical_text: ayaṃ tu vīrasaṃdehas tiṣṭhatīva mamāgrataḥ sumahāṃs tvatsahāyeṣu haryṛkṣeṣu asaṃśayaḥ
variants.southern_text: ayaṃ tu vīra saṃdehas tiṣṭhatīva mamāgrataḥ । sumahāṃs tvatsahāyeṣu haryṛkṣeṣu harīśvara ॥7॥

variants.critical_text: trayāṇām eva bhūtānāṃ sāgarasyāsya laṅghane śaktiḥ syād vainateyasya vāyor vā tava vānagha
variants.southern_text: trayāṇām eva bhūtānāṃ sāgarasyāsya laṅghane । śaktiḥ syād vainateyasya vāyor vā tava cānagha ॥9॥

variants.critical_text: balaiḥ samagrair yadi māṃ hatvā rāvaṇam āhave vijayī svāṃ purīṃ rāmo nayet tat syād yaśaskaram
variants.southern_text: balaiḥ samagrair yadi māṃ hatvā rāvaṇam āhave । vijayī svapurīṃ rāmo nayet tat syād yaśaskaram ॥12॥

variants.critical_text: tad arthopahitaṃ vākyaṃ praśritaṃ hetusaṃhitam niśamyāhaṃ tataḥ śeṣaṃ vākyam uttaram abruvam
variants.southern_text: tad arthopahitaṃ vākyaṃ praśritaṃ hetusaṃhitam । niśamyāhaṃ tataḥ śeṣaṃ vākyam uttaram abravam ॥16॥

variants.critical_text: devi haryṛkṣasainyānām īśvaraḥ plavatāṃ varaḥ sugrīvaḥ sattvasaṃpannas tavārthe kṛtaniścayaḥ
variants.southern_text: devi haryṛkṣasainyānām īśvaraḥ plavatāṃ varaḥ । sugrīvaḥ sattvasampannas tvadarthe kṛtaniścayaḥ ॥17॥

variants.critical_text: tasya vikramasaṃpannāḥ sattvavanto mahābalāḥ manaḥsaṃkalpasaṃpātā nideśe harayaḥ sthitāḥ
variants.southern_text: tasya vikramasampannāḥ sattvavanto mahābalāḥ । manaḥsaṃkalpasadṛśā nideśe harayaḥ sthitāḥ ॥18॥

variants.critical_text: tad alaṃ paritāpena devi manyur vyapaitu te ekotpātena te laṅkām eṣyanti hariyūthapāḥ
variants.southern_text: tad alaṃ paritāpena devi manyur apaitu te । ekotpātena te laṅkām eṣyanti hariyūthapāḥ ॥23॥

variants.critical_text: arighnaṃ siṃhasaṃkāśaṃ kṣipraṃ drakṣyasi rāghavam lakṣmaṇaṃ ca dhanuṣpāṇiṃ laṅkā dvāram upasthitam
variants.southern_text: arighnaṃ siṃhasaṃkāśaṃ kṣipraṃ drakṣyasi rāghavam । lakṣmaṇaṃ ca dhanuṣpāṇiṃ laṅkādvāram upāgatam ॥25॥

variants.critical_text: nakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhān vīrān siṃhaśārdūlavikramān vānarān vānarendrābhān kṣipraṃ drakṣyasi saṃgatān
variants.southern_text: nakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhān vīrān siṃhaśārdūlavikramān । vānarān vāraṇendrābhān kṣipraṃ drakṣyasi saṃgatān ॥26॥

variants.critical_text: śailāmbudan nikāśānāṃ laṅkāmalayasānuṣu nardatāṃ kapimukhyānām acirāc choṣyase svanam
variants.southern_text: śailāmbudanikāśānāṃ laṅkāmalayasānuṣu । nardatāṃ kapimukhyānāṃ nacirāc chroṣyase svanam ॥27॥

variants.critical_text: tato mayā vāgbhir adīnabhāṣiṇī; śivābhir iṣṭābhir abhiprasāditā jagāma śāntiṃ mama maithilātmajā; tavāpi śokena tathābhipīḍitā
variants.southern_text: tato mayā vāgbhir adīnabhāṣiṇī । śivābhir iṣṭābhir abhiprasāditā । uvāha śāntiṃ mama maithilātmajā । tavātiśokena tathābhipīḍitā ॥29॥
